name: Can Arte
tagline: Can Arte – Your Ultimate Group Escape
summary: Welcome to Can Arte – Where Celebrations and Relaxation Meet!
description: Welcome to Can Arte – Where Celebrations and Relaxation Meet!

Discover the perfect getaway for large groups celebrating birthdays, retreats, or family reunions at Can Arte Ibiza. With accommodation for up to 28 guests, this spacious villa is ideal for everyone, from children to grandparents.

Featuring family suites and apartments, many with private kitchens and terraces Can Arte offers the perfect balance of communal and private spaces. Enjoy serene surroundings, breathtaking sunset sea views, and the convenience of easy accessibility. Unwind in our luxurious spa, complete with a sauna and hammam.
Explore, Unwind, and Indulge at Can Arte

Nestled near the stunning beaches of Cala Cracioneta and Cala Salada, and close to the charming village of Sant Agnes, Can Arte is your gateway to adventure. Sip sunset cocktails at nearby Hostal la Torre, or savor exquisite cuisine with our private chef service for dinners and breakfasts. For retreat enthusiasts, our spacious outdoor areas feature a yoga platform, lounge spaces, an open cinema, and a rejuvenating spa.

name: Can Anna Grande
tagline: Private estate in a rural haven
summary: Located in the middle of the Mediterranean sea lies the natural beauty of the island of Ibiza and located at the heart of it sits Can Anna Grande. Can Anna Grande, an old ibizencan finca (traditional farmhouse) was…
description: Located in the middle of the Mediterranean sea lies the natural beauty of the island of Ibiza and located at the heart of it sits Can Anna Grande. Can Anna Grande, an old ibizencan finca (traditional farmhouse) was restored with love and care over the last few years, incorporating the latest technologies like inbuilt sound system and underfloor heating, without sacrificing any of it’s traditional and rural magic. This charming finca offers a breakfast service for the comfort of its guests

Sitting in the midst of aromatic herb gardens and fruit trees and overlooking the spectacular ibizan coast, Can Anna Grande can offer guests a unique countryside vista and direct access to the gentle rural ambience of the north coast of Ibiza.

The grounds include a lovely lawn with spectacular sea views, the signature infinity pool, the herb gardens full of aromatic plants and bushes, an outdoor dining area and barbecue and lots of small shaded relaxation spots with armchairs and hammocks.
Next to the large modern kitchen is a beautiful dining area with large windows opening to the garden and seaview and views to the garden.

The main villa has a total of 5 double bedrooms, 3 of which have an en-suite bathroom and one is a family room consisting of 2 bedrooms and one bathroom. 
Annexe: From 2026, the property is offering four brand-new, spacious suites, each offering 50 m² of comfort with private terraces, ensuite bathrooms, and stunning sea views. Every suite is thoughtfully designed with air conditioning, fiber optic Wi-Fi, and a king-size bed, while the private outdoor patios include green spaces and exterior rain showers for a refreshing experience in nature.

In addition to the new suites, the villa now offers a fully equipped, air-conditioned indoor gym. Guests will be able to enjoy a range of cardio equipment and free weights, making it easy to stay active while embracing the tranquility of the surroundings.

name: Finca Utopia Xarraca
tagline: Exclusive Frontline Luxury Villa in Ibiza with Stunning Sea Views and Private Beach Access
summary: Welcome to Finca Utopia Xarraca, a captivating seaside finca nestled in the stunning northern region of Ibiza. With its exclusive private access to the sea and arguably the most coveted waterfront setting on the island,…
description: Welcome to Finca Utopia Xarraca, a captivating seaside finca nestled in the stunning northern region of Ibiza. With its exclusive private access to the sea and arguably the most coveted waterfront setting on the island, this nine-bedroom coastal estate (one of the bedrroms has two bedrooms and two bathrooms - more for family oriented familes) epitomizes genuine barefoot luxury. Experience seamless indoor-outdoor living, bask in the luminous all-season salons and indulge in sweeping sea vistas from every angle. Finca Utopia Xarraca embodies the essence of authentic Mediterranean opulence, offering an unparalleled experience throughout the year.

Steeped in history and allure, Finca Utopia Xarraca stands as one of Ibiza's most iconic properties. Originally constructed in the mid-19th century, it became a hub of vibrant social gatherings in the 1970s, attracting Hollywood luminaries, European royalty, and the era's most glamorous and free-spirited personalities. Its fame soared in 1978 when the renowned society photographer Slim Aarons immortalized it on film.

Today, Finca Utopia Xarraca stands as a resplendent eight-bedroom coastal sanctuary, seemingly suspended above the azure waters below. Offering unrivalled ocean panoramas from every window and exclusive beach access, it provides a relaxed Riviera haven where guests can immerse themselves in authentic Ibiza living year-round.

Cala Xarraca, the pristine natural beach nearby, offers a serene escape with its white sands and pebbles meeting the tranquil turquoise waters. Guests can access the sea through a private doorway, opening up a world of aquatic adventures, from sailing and kayaking to snorkelling and fishing. During the summer months, the bay becomes a magnet for yachts, drawn to its crystal-clear waters and charming seaside fish restaurant.

Perched on Ibiza's captivating sunset coast, Finca Utopia Xarraca exudes decadent seaside allure, blending retro beach vibes, classic coastal glamour, and the rustic charm of a traditional finca. The interior spaces, adorned with creamy lime wash finishes, evoke the ambience of a seventies beach retreat, interconnected by softly curving stairwells reminiscent of a yacht.

The eight luxurious bedroom suites, each boasting magnificent sea views, offer private indoor/outdoor living spaces and entertainment areas. The split-level indoor salons, with their open fireplaces and panoramic Mediterranean vistas, provide an ideal setting for both intimate gatherings and grand celebrations. The Ocean Room, with its glass walls, serves as a versatile space for private events, yoga sessions, or cinematic experiences.

Finca Utopia Xarraca's grounds are equally enchanting, featuring multi-level outdoor living spaces cascading towards the sea. The panoramic pool deck, adorned with Royal Botania beds and vintage-inspired furnishings, invites relaxation and leisure. An outdoor dining area and cocktail bar offer the perfect setting for al-fresco dining and sunset celebrations.

The property's amenities cater to every need, with luxurious bedroom suites, a saltwater swimming pool, direct beach access, multiple outdoor lounging areas, and a fully equipped kitchen garden for hosting large-scale events. Additional features include a hammam, yoga spaces, a state-of-the-art gym, water sports equipment, and a bespoke pool table.

Indoors, the living and dining areas exude warmth and comfort, with sea-view libraries, inviting fireplaces, and bespoke furnishings reflecting Ibiza's rich heritage and contemporary flair. The kitchen, with its playful design and modern amenities, is a haven for culinary enthusiasts, stocked with premium tableware and refreshments.

The club room, adorned with vintage accents and luxurious furnishings, offers a versatile space for entertainment, fitness, or relaxation. Tower rooms, reminiscent of fairy-tale towers, provide a romantic retreat with private terraces and mesmerizing sea views, ideal for families or couples seeking seclusion and serenity.
Escape to Finca Utopia Xarraca and immerse yourself in the timeless allure of authentic Mediterranean luxury, where every moment is a celebration of life's finest pleasures.

name: Finca Utopia
tagline: Finca Utopia – A Private Ibicencan Estate with 9 En-Suite Suites
summary: Hidden deep in the heart of Ibiza’s beautiful countryside, Finca Utopia is an extraordinary private estate offering an exceptional setting for luxury escapes, celebrations, wellness retreats, and unforgettable…
description: Hidden deep in the heart of Ibiza’s beautiful countryside, Finca Utopia is an extraordinary private estate offering an exceptional setting for luxury escapes, celebrations, wellness retreats, and unforgettable experiences. Set within an authentic 300-year-old Ibicencan farmstead and surrounded by approximately 20 acres of land, this unique property combines complete privacy, breathtaking countryside and distant sea views, and a wonderfully peaceful atmosphere.

More than just a luxury villa, Finca Utopia has been thoughtfully designed as a free-flowing sanctuary where guests can embrace outdoor living, reconnect with nature, and enjoy an effortless blend of relaxation, entertainment, and wellbeing. Despite its secluded location, the estate remains within easy reach of Ibiza’s charming villages, beautiful beaches, and island attractions.

Finca Utopia offers nine beautifully appointed en-suite suites, accommodating up to 18 guests. The accommodation is thoughtfully distributed between the main farmhouse, a distinctive private tower, and two independent garden casitas. Each suite provides generous living space, privacy, and its own unique connection to the surrounding landscape.

The main finca houses six elegant suites, including first-floor bedrooms with private terraces, Juliet balconies, and picturesque countryside views. The ground-floor garden suites offer an additional sense of seclusion, with private entrances, outdoor showers, luxurious bathtubs, and peaceful garden spaces.

One of the estate’s most distinctive features is its remarkable Tower Suite, occupying two levels of a private tower. This exceptional accommodation features a circular king-size bed, a private lounge, and an exclusive rooftop terrace offering spectacular 360-degree views across the Ibiza countryside.

A short stroll of approximately 40 metres from the main house leads to two independent garden casitas. These beautifully designed suites enjoy private entrances, raised bathtubs, open-air showers, and secluded gardens, making them ideal for guests seeking an extra level of independence and tranquillity.
All nine suites are equipped with air conditioning, heating, personal safes, blackout blinds or traditional wooden shutters, and high-quality finishes to ensure comfort throughout the year.

At Finca Utopia, the living spaces have been designed to encourage connection while allowing every guest the freedom to find their own peaceful corner. The impressive open-plan lounge and dining area features soaring ceilings, thoughtfully curated interiors, and comfortable seating for up to 18 guests. Iconic design pieces blend seamlessly with contemporary luxury and Ibiza’s distinctive artistic character, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels both sophisticated and relaxed.

Throughout the estate, a variety of indoor and outdoor dining and lounge areas provide beautiful settings for everything from leisurely breakfasts and long lunches to intimate dinners and lively evening gatherings.

For guests seeking relaxation and rejuvenation, a dedicated wellness and massage area features its own private entrance, showers, changing facilities, and a tranquil garden chill-out space. This makes Finca Utopia particularly well suited to wellness retreats, restorative holidays, and extended stays.

Outdoor living lies at the heart of the Finca Utopia experience. The estate's expansive gardens and beautifully designed entertaining spaces invite guests to enjoy Ibiza’s Mediterranean lifestyle from morning until late into the evening.

A spectacular outdoor dining and entertainment pergola, featuring an original Ibicencan mill, provides a memorable setting for gatherings and alfresco dining. This impressive space includes a fully equipped bar, a traditional stone pizza oven, and a professional Josper oven, creating the perfect environment for exceptional culinary experiences.

Elsewhere, an enchanting open-air dining area is centred around an original Ibicencan well, adding an authentic touch of island heritage. The lower garden offers another atmospheric gathering space, complete with a fire pit and Ofyr barbecue, ideal for relaxed dinners and conversations beneath the stars.

One of Finca Utopia’s most extraordinary features is its private cave nightclub, a truly unique addition that brings Ibiza’s legendary entertainment culture into the privacy of the estate. Carved into the natural landscape, this soundproofed and air-conditioned space features a high-specification sound system, home cinema, stone-walled bar, and comfortable chill-out areas.

The cave club provides an exceptional setting for private celebrations, intimate parties, music experiences, and special gatherings, allowing guests to enjoy a distinctive Ibiza nightlife experience without leaving the property.

The estate’s impressive natural saltwater oval swimming pool is surrounded by beautifully maintained terraces and lush Mediterranean gardens. Designed for both relaxation and enjoyment, the main pool also offers access for guests with reduced mobility.

A separate children’s pool provides a dedicated space for younger guests, making the property particularly appealing to families and multigenerational groups. Luxurious sun loungers, parasols, outdoor showers, and numerous shaded chill-out terraces are thoughtfully positioned throughout the grounds, ensuring plenty of space to unwind, enjoy the sunshine, or simply take in the peaceful surroundings.

A defining feature of Finca Utopia is its commitment to sustainable living and its remarkable farm-to-table philosophy. The estate is home to an extensive greenhouse covering more than 1,100 square metres, alongside beautiful edible gardens integrated throughout the grounds.

Dedicated on-site gardeners cultivate fresh seasonal produce using permaculture, biodynamic, and electroculture farming methods. This exceptional approach allows the estate's culinary team to incorporate freshly harvested ingredients into the dining experience, celebrating the natural flavours of Ibiza and creating a genuine connection between the land and the table.

For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the estate offers an excellent variety of recreational and wellness facilities. Guests can enjoy a game of pétanque, make use of the grass football pitch, or practise yoga and meditation on the beautiful open-air yoga deck surrounded by nature.

Younger guests will love exploring the dedicated children's playground, complete with a treehouse and miniature cave. A traditional wooden boat installation in the lower garden adds another distinctive and playful element to the estate's unique character.

Finca Utopia offers a comprehensive staffing service designed to ensure guests enjoy a seamless and relaxing stay. The professional team includes a concierge manager, a private chef for eight hours per day, food and beverage service, housekeeping, and maintenance support.

Additional amenities include estate-wide Wi-Fi, a discreet integrated sound system throughout the grounds, solar panels, extensive guest parking, and video surveillance for added security and peace of mind.

With its remarkable combination of privacy, beautifully designed accommodation, exceptional entertaining facilities, wellness spaces, and expansive natural surroundings, Finca Utopia is an outstanding choice for luxury family holidays, private celebrations, milestone occasions, wellness and yoga retreats, creative gatherings, and corporate escapes.

Whether guests are seeking complete relaxation, meaningful time with family and friends, or an unforgettable occasion in an extraordinary setting, Finca Utopia offers the freedom and flexibility to create a truly personalised Ibiza experience.
Finca Utopia is far more than a place to stay. It is a private world of natural beauty, creativity, comfort, and authentic island character, designed to be experienced, shared, and remembered.
Please note that private events are subject to an additional fee, with pricing available upon request.

name: Villa Espada
tagline: Your Exclusive Summer Retreat in Ibiza
summary: Escape to Villa Espada, a hidden sanctuary in the heart of Ibiza’s tranquil San Lorenzo area. Nestled within a 16,000 sqm private pine forest, this stunning retreat offers an unparalleled blend of authentic Ibizan charm…
description: Escape to Villa Espada, a hidden sanctuary in the heart of Ibiza’s tranquil San Lorenzo area. Nestled within a 16,000 sqm private pine forest, this stunning retreat offers an unparalleled blend of authentic Ibizan charm and modern luxury—the perfect setting for an unforgettable summer getaway.

A Haven of Comfort & Elegance
Designed for those seeking relaxation, nature, and exclusivity, Villa Espada features three beautifully restored fincas, each exuding traditional Ibizan character while providing the finest comforts. With 9 exquisite bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathroom, this estate accommodates up to 17 adults and 6 children, making it ideal for families, groups of friends, or special gatherings.

Indulge in:
✔ Two pools (one saltwater) for cooling off under the Mediterranean sun
✔ Open-air yoga space for mindfulness and relaxation
✔ Outdoor cinema for magical movie nights under the stars
✔ Lush chill-out areas for unwinding amidst nature
✔ Outdoor bar for sunset cocktails and social evenings

A Perfect Venue for Every Occasion
Whether you're dreaming of a private event, wedding, or wellness retreat, Villa Espadat provides a breathtaking backdrop where moments turn into cherished memories. Our dedicated catering and concierge services ensure every detail is tailored to your needs—from private chefs and restaurant reservations to car and boat rentals, so you can explore Ibiza in style.

Discover the Magic of Ibiza
Located just 5 minutes from the nearest beach, 20 minutes from the airport, and a short drive to Santa Gertrudis and Marina Botafoch, you’ll have the perfect balance of seclusion and accessibility.

name: Villa Gina
tagline: A contemporary and stylish villa in the heart of the beautiful countryside
summary: Villa Gina is a spacious and privileged villa located in the heart of the countryside, peaceful and tranquil. It is just a short distance from the bohemian village of San Juan, famous for its hippy market, located in…
description: Villa Gina is a spacious and privileged villa located in the heart of the countryside, peaceful and tranquil. It is just a short distance from the bohemian village of San Juan, famous for its hippy market, located in the town square every Sunday, and close by to some of the most spectacular beaches of the North, including Portinatx, Cala Xarraca, and the stunning Benirrás beach, known worldwide for its unforgettable sunsets.

This contemporary chic home is set over two floors affording space and privacy for all guests. On the ground floor, indoor spaces feature large windows, with an 80m2 living area that opens out to both sides of the building and a fully equipped kitchen. All areas have access to beautiful grounds. On this floor, are 4 bedrooms, each of which with a large terrace and views of the countryside. Two of them are en-suite, and the other two are sharing a bathroom.

The master bedroom is found on the first floor, with a resplendent bathroom complete with a hydromassage bath, a large dressing room and an outdoor terrace with beautiful views of the pool and the rest of the property. We also find a second suite on this first floor, beautifully furnished, offering the same level of luxury and style

The charming 80m2 guest house is located to the side of the magnificent garden. It offers two double suites and it’s own living area with mini-fridge and coffee machine, making it ideal for those seeking a little exra privacy.

Beautifully finished and superbly equipped, Villa Gina is supremely stylish throughout. The interior décor is of an exceptionally high standard, effortlessly combining traditional features with contemporary chic and luxury. An air of opulence abounds in each and every room. Splashes of colour from expertly chosen decorations, artworks and soft furnishings accentuate the neutral tones and contemporary chic is most certainly the order of the day here.

Step outside into the grounds of Villa Gina and delight in the vast space of private lands, where you will find a delightful pool, multiple chill-out areas, outdoor Jacuzzi, dining area with barbecue and some wonderful Mediterranean gardens with fragrant fruit trees orange, lemon, cherry, apple trees, quince, carob and centuries-old olive trees.

name: Villa Magnifique
tagline: Beautiful villa with lush gardens and sea views
summary: Villa Magnifique is located in the highly sought-after and exclusive area of Porroig between Cala Jondal and Es Cubells. The property has two magnificent swimming pools, exquisite gardens, sea views and perfectly…
description:
Villa Magnifique is located in the highly sought-after and exclusive area of Porroig between Cala Jondal and Es Cubells. The property has two magnificent swimming pools, exquisite gardens, sea views and perfectly positioned, 5 minutes walking distance to the beach Playa Porroig and a short drive to the beaches of Es Cubells, Es Torrents and Cala Jondal. 
Villa Magnifique is distributed across two houses totalling 600m2 on a 4100m2 plot. The main house consists of five bedrooms and a guest house with 3 bedrooms.

The house has been recently renovated and designed to the highest standard with full attention to natural materials and a calm austere.
Harmonious gardens meander through the property and offer privacy with secluded sun traps and outdoor entertainment. Three outdoor eating areas that seat 10-14 people, furnished terraces with sea views and two swimming pools. The garden area has been designed using corten steel to create a grand entrance and step features in the land. House contains lots of grass area and mature planting. House is magical at night with controlled lighting throughout the exterior space. 
There is a separate outdoor games area with ping pong, fooze ball and seating area. The property has two entrances with internal parking spots for at least four cars.
Villa Magnifique contains a gym with the latest Technogym equipment and spin bikes, sea toys such as stand up paddle boards and kayaks.

name: Villa Eliza
tagline: Front line villa with unforgettable views
summary: Villa Eliza is a flawless front-line 7 bedroom property with direct access to the sea. This amazing exclusive home is located in Vista Alegre, one of the most sought after gated urbanisations on the island of Ibiza and…
description: Villa Eliza is a flawless front-line 7 bedroom property with direct access to the sea. This amazing exclusive home is located in Vista Alegre, one of the most sought after gated urbanisations on the island of Ibiza and is perfectly situated close to the beaches of Cala Jondal, Es Torrent and Es Cubells. The property benefits from a superb south facing position where you can relax and enjoy the uninterrupted sea views towards the bay of Porroig and the sister island of Formentera.

Finished to a fabulously high standard and with spectacular interior design throughout, both the lounge and dining areas are resplendent with unforgettable views through the floor to ceiling sliding doors, and each room is complete with sophisticated design features and excellent attention to detail. Villa Eliza boast two kitchens (one of them designed exclusively for a private chef) and a fully equipped fitness gym overlooking the sea. Each bedroom is flooded with natural light, stylishly furnished and complete with king size bed, en-suite bathroom and of course, the seemingly endless seaviews.

The spacious outdoor area is spread over a sprawling plot of land, and features several luxurious chill-out area, vast terraces, a front line, perfectly landscaped garden with an abundance of green lush tropical plants and trees and a fabulous infinity pool with heated water and Jacuzzi from where you can truly appreciate the coastline views.
SERVICES INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

FULL HOUSEKEEPING - 4 STAFF (8 HRS/DAY) 
BUTLER (16HRS/DAY)
WAITRESS (16 HRS/DAY)
CHEF + CHEF ASSISTANT (16 HRS/DAY) 
PRIVATE CHAUFFEUR (10HRS/DAY)
NIGHT TIME SECURITY GUARD (10HRS/DAY)

name: Belantara
tagline: Bright Mediterranean Villa in a Prime Location
summary: Villa Belantara is a spacious, bright, and well-connected property located in Sant Antoni, set within a quiet residential area that offers privacy while remaining within walking distance of the beach, the town center,…
description: Villa Belantara is a spacious, bright, and well-connected property located in Sant Antoni, set within a quiet residential area that offers privacy while remaining within walking distance of the beach, the town center, and Ibiza’s famous sunsets.
From the villa, it is easy to reach some of the island’s most iconic spots, including Ocean Beach (1.8 km), Es Paradís and Edén (2.1 km), as well as Café Mambo and Café del Mar (2.5 km).

The interior of the villa features six bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, three full bathrooms, and one guest toilet, along with a fully equipped kitchen and a comfortable dining area designed for shared moments with family or friends.

Recently renovated, the outdoor areas offer a magnificent swimming pool, a chill-out zone with sun loungers, a barbecue area, and a large garden with private parking. The property is equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and an alarm system, ensuring comfort and peace of mind throughout the stay.
Villa Belantara is an ideal choice for enjoying Ibiza in a relaxed setting, combining comfort, outdoor living, and proximity to the island’s most vibrant locations.

name: Can Ariel
tagline: Six Bedrooms, Valley Views, and the Soul of Old Ibiza
summary: Discover Villa Can Ariel, an exquisitely renovated 6-bedroom estate nestled in Ibiza’s tranquil countryside, offering breathtaking panoramic views of lush valleys and the island’s iconic pastoral beauty. Ideally…
description: Discover Villa Can Ariel, an exquisitely renovated 6-bedroom estate nestled in Ibiza’s tranquil countryside, offering breathtaking panoramic views of lush valleys and the island’s iconic pastoral beauty. Ideally positioned near the charming village of San Rafael, this property combines secluded serenity with effortless access to Ibiza’s vibrant hotspots—just a short drive from the airport, the electrifying nightlife of Ibiza Town, and the island’s pristine beaches.

Bathed in natural light from floor-to-ceiling glass doors, the villa’s open-plan living spaces exude a refined, minimalist elegance. Neutral tones and organic textures—think natural wood accents, crisp white walls, and plush linen furnishings—create a calming, contemporary ambiance. The seamless flow between the lounge, dining area, and a fully equipped authentic kitchen invites effortless indoor-outdoor living, with direct access to sun-drenched terraces perfect for alfresco dining or leisurely mornings.

Each of the six bedrooms is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring en-suite bathrooms and thoughtfully curated decor. Two lavish master suites boast private terraces, ideal for savoring sunrise coffees or starlit evenings. A versatile wellness room, currently styled as a serene relaxation or treatment space, can easily be converted into an additional bedroom, catering to the needs of every guest.

Set within fragrant, landscaped gardens, Villa Can Ariel offers a wealth of outdoor amenities designed for indulgence and rejuvenation. Two shimmering swimming pools—one flanked by an elegant outdoor bathroom—anchor the property, while a floodlit tennis court promises daytime activity and evening entertainment. Dine under the stars at the al-fresco BBQ area, unwind in chic lounging zones, or embrace tranquility in the enchanting Mongolian Yurt, a unique space tailored for yoga, meditation, or wellness retreats. Expansive terraces adorned with sumptuous furnishings invite guests to linger amid the sights and scents of Ibiza’s natural splendor.

Perfectly balancing privacy and accessibility, Villa Can Ariel sits moments from San Rafael’s quaint cafes and artisan boutiques, yet remains a peaceful haven surrounded by rolling hills and Mediterranean flora. Whether seeking vibrant coastal energy or countryside calm, this estate offers the ultimate Ibiza experience.

A masterpiece of modern design and timeless charm, Villa Can Ariel redefines luxury living—a destination where relaxation, adventure, and sophistication converge. Ideal for large families, groups, or wellness-focused escapes, this villa promises an unforgettable retreat in one of the Mediterranean’s most coveted locations.

name: Can Beso
tagline: Charming outstanding quality finca tucked away in the hills of San Jose
summary: This romantic finca, surrounded by a beautiful garden, sits atop a 185m hill overlooking a stunning valley with a refreshing breeze, even on the hottest summer days. The house, once a typical Ibicencan ruin, has been…
description: This romantic finca, surrounded by a beautiful garden, sits atop a 185m hill overlooking a stunning valley with a refreshing breeze, even on the hottest summer days. The house, once a typical Ibicencan ruin, has been fully restored to modern standards, providing a comfortable stay and a perfect getaway from the world. The villa features a chill-out area with hammocks, an infinity pool, and a private tennis court, making it an ideal place to relax and enjoy your stay in Ibiza.

Located only 2 km from the village of San Josep, 18 minutes from the airport, and 35 minutes from Ibiza town, this villa offers easy access to the amenities of the island while maintaining the privacy and tranquility of the countryside. It is also just a 15-minute drive from the beautiful beaches of the south and close to many exceptional restaurants.

The main house comprises four double bedrooms, each with its bathroom or shower room. Bedroom one offers a queen bed, bedroom two has two single beds measuring 100cm each, and bedrooms three and four have two single beds measuring 90cm each. The main house also includes a living room, a studio with a TV, and a fully equipped kitchen. Additionally, there is a separate room with a 1.40m double bed and a shower room, and a charming apartment with a separate path from the garage, offering a double queen bed, bathroom, living area, and pantry.

The whole finca can accommodate up to 12 guests and offers an array of amenities, including a pool and tennis court, as well as fast internet. The villa features a TV in five of the six bedrooms and another in the studio. With a land area of 2.5 hectares and a living area of approximately 300m2, this villa is perfect for a memorable stay in Ibiza.
Pool heating available in winter months for an additional fee.

name: Can Captur
tagline: An oasis well connected to everything.
summary: Nestled in a charming oasis of tranquility just minutes away from Ibiza town, this sumptuous 6-bedroom villa offers a serene escape surrounded by rolling hills and verdant vegetation. The property boasts a striking…
description: Nestled in a charming oasis of tranquility just minutes away from Ibiza town, this sumptuous 6-bedroom villa offers a serene escape surrounded by rolling hills and verdant vegetation. The property boasts a striking contrast between its vast azure pool and the lush greenery enveloping it, creating a picturesque and inviting atmosphere.

The villa's expansive patio is a standout feature, with ample seating and a dining table for twelve, providing the perfect space for alfresco dining and relaxation. Inside, the villa comfortably accommodates up to twelve guests, ensuring everyone can find their own corner of tranquility and privacy.

Despite its secluded feel, the villa's privileged location ensures easy access to shops, restaurants, and the vibrant attractions of Ibiza. Just a six-minute drive brings you to local bars, supermarkets, restaurants, and a pharmacy, while the airport and Ibiza town are only a few kilometers away, making this an oasis well-connected to everything.

Surrounded by nature, this villa offers both tranquility and privacy, making it an ideal retreat for those seeking a peaceful and comfortable getaway on the enchanting island of Ibiza. This is a home with a pure Ibizan soul, perfect for living and enjoying the best of what the island has to offer.

name: Can Cecilia
tagline: Eight-bedroom San Lorenzo farmhouse where old Ibiza endures
summary:
Set among the quiet orchards and terracotta tracks of San Lorenzo, this newly built six-bedroom villa channels the unhurried soul of rural Ibiza with rare architectural conviction. 
Thick whitewashed walls,…
description:
Set among the quiet orchards and terracotta tracks of San Lorenzo, this newly built six-bedroom villa channels the unhurried soul of rural Ibiza with rare architectural conviction. 
Thick whitewashed walls, timber-beamed ceilings and hand-selected fixtures speak to the island's vernacular tradition, while the generous scale of the interiors — flowing living rooms, a sophisticated library gallery, a dedicated dining room, a wine cellar and a fully equipped Siemens kitchen — offers every comfort a large family or group of friends could ask for. 
Santa Eulalia's restaurants and the wild northern beaches are both within easy reach, yet once inside these walls, the outside world recedes gracefully. Picture an unhurried morning: coffee in the sun-warmed courtyard, the hills of San Lorenzo perfectly still, nowhere you need to be.

SHORT STAY POLICY: Please note that for stays shorter than one week, a higher daily rate will apply when permitted. An empty calendar does not ensure automatic availability for short stays, and confirmation with the property is always required. PLEASE CHECK WITH YOUR AGENT TO CONFIRM FINAL PRICE AND AVAILABILITY.

name: Can Danza
tagline: Lavishly built and uniquely equipped finca
summary: Can Danza is a magnificent property, where each of the 6 bedrooms has been meticulously crafted to provide the utmost comfort and style. The expansive living space invites you to unwind and socialize in an atmosphere of…
description: Can Danza is a magnificent property, where each of the 6 bedrooms has been meticulously crafted to provide the utmost comfort and style. The expansive living space invites you to unwind and socialize in an atmosphere of opulence, while the state-of-the-art 'Miele' kitchen stands ready to inspire culinary masterpieces.

Outside, the allure continues with a heated pool beckoning you to relax and rejuvenate amidst the lush surroundings. Dine al fresco under the stars, savoring delectable meals prepared in the open air kitchen, or challenge yourself with a workout session using the dedicated Crossfit Rack, ensuring your stay is as invigorating as it is indulgent.

For moments of pure bliss, retreat to the spa where you can indulge in a range of luxurious treatments, or simply immerse yourself in the tranquility of Ibiza's natural beauty. Whether you seek adventure or relaxation, this villa promises to fulfill your every desire, offering the ultimate escape from the ordinary.

Nestled in the picturesque southwest of Ibiza, the vibrant area of San Jose awaits exploration. Discover the breathtaking beauty of the island's renowned coves and beaches, with highlights including the pristine Ses Salines Natural Park and the mystical d'es Vedrà nature reserve. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of San Jose, where charming cafes, boutiques, and galleries await your discovery.

As the day fades into night, experience the vibrant energy of Ibiza's nightlife scene, or simply bask in the tranquility of your private oasis. With its perfect blend of natural beauty and modern amenities, this idyllic location promises an unforgettable escape, where every moment is infused with luxury and relaxation. Your ultimate retreat awaits amidst the newly upgraded outdoor space of Ibiza Island.

name: Can Ellie
tagline: Clifftop seclusion above Cala Salada's shimmering turquoise waters
summary:
Perched above one of Ibiza's most coveted coastlines, Can Ellie commands sweeping views over the glittering west coast from its privileged position near Cala Salada. 
The architecture speaks a language of quiet…
description:
Perched above one of Ibiza's most coveted coastlines, Can Ellie commands sweeping views over the glittering west coast from its privileged position near Cala Salada. 
The architecture speaks a language of quiet confidence — whitewashed walls and clean contemporary lines softened by traditional Ibizan detail, where wide terraces dissolve into sky and sea. Inside, light moves freely through open-plan living spaces framed by generous windows, connecting every room to the landscape beyond. 
Six private bedroom suites offer genuine sanctuary: deep, well-dressed beds, considered lighting, and en-suite bathrooms finished with care. Outside, the saltwater pool catches the afternoon sun as the coastline turns gold and the day slows to the rhythm Ibiza does best. 
Whether you gather here with people you love or simply let the evenings stretch out over the horizon, Can Ellie rewards those who know exactly what they're looking for.
amenities: Eco Tax on arrival 2.20€ per day per adult over 15

name: Can Gabriel
tagline: Beautiful countryside modern Finca
summary: Nestled in the serene northern countryside of Ibiza, Can Gabriel is a masterclass in modern rustic luxury. Built in 2018, this exquisite country finca is perfectly positioned near Santa Eulalia, San Carlos, and the…
description: Nestled in the serene northern countryside of Ibiza, Can Gabriel is a masterclass in modern rustic luxury. Built in 2018, this exquisite country finca is perfectly positioned near Santa Eulalia, San Carlos, and the idyllic beaches of Cala Nova, Aguas Blancas, and Cala Leña. Surrounded by one hectare of private land with sweeping sea views, this property is a sanctuary of tranquility and sophistication.

Can Gabriel beautifully blends contemporary comfort with timeless charm. The interiors are a celebration of understated elegance, featuring ethnic-inspired decor that feels authentic yet refined. Every room is bathed in natural light, enhancing the finca’s airy, open feel. The living area is a masterpiece of coziness and style, inviting you to relax in its thoughtfully designed sitting space.

Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Living:
The main house boasts two kitchens, including an outdoor kitchen perfect for effortless al-fresco dining. Multiple dining spaces cater to every occasion, with the star attraction being the stunning wooden table set beneath the open sky. Paired with a professional BBQ, it creates the ultimate setting for long, leisurely meals with loved ones.

Sumptuous Sleeping Quarters:
Each of the six bedrooms has been curated with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring restful nights and luxurious comfort:

Bedroom 1: Queen bed
Bedroom 2: Queen bed
Bedroom 3: King bed
Bedroom 4: Queen bed
Bedroom 5: Queen bed
Bedroom 6 (Private Annex): Queen bed

The Art of Relaxation:
Can Gabriel is designed for those who appreciate the finer things in life. Its expansive outdoor spaces provide the perfect backdrop for relaxation, whether you’re soaking in the sea views from the terrace or lounging in the shade of ancient olive trees.
A harmonious blend of style and substance, this finca offers an authentic Ibizan experience with all the modern luxuries. Can Gabriel isn’t just a place to stay—it’s a lifestyle.

name: Can Josie
tagline: A chic bohemian property close to Ibiza’s most beautiful beaches
summary: Can Josie is an exquisitely designed 6 bedroom villa located within a short few minutes to the bay of Cala Jondal home to the famed Blue Marlin Beach Club. Set in the hill of San Jose, you can enjoy spectacular sea…
description: Can Josie is an exquisitely designed 6 bedroom villa located within a short few minutes to the bay of Cala Jondal home to the famed Blue Marlin Beach Club. Set in the hill of San Jose, you can enjoy spectacular sea views and the surrounding countryside.

The interiors have mastered a ethnic boho-chic style that offers plenty of spacious yet welcoming open plan living spaces and direct access to an exterior terrace from where you can enjoy the spectacular sea views. Authentic stone masonry blends seamlessly with Balinese wall hangings creating an eclectic ambiance. This stylish property combines a truly authentic Mediterranean feel with touches of the Far East making it an inspiring holiday home. Furnished throughout to a supremely stylish standard, you will find opulent decorations and artworks to complement the theme of this unique villa.

Can Josie is distributed over three levels with the master bedroom having its own private roof terrace, 2 further double bedrooms in the main villa, and the latter 3 located on the lower floor with their own private access.

The property is ideally settled among well maintained and lush gardens with a child-friendly swimming pool, a large terrace with chill out beds and sun loungers. The exteriors also offer a fully lit tennis court for those who wish to maintain their fitness levels whilst holidaying in Ibiza. The outside dining area and BBQ space is perfect for entertaining, taking you easily from breakfast through to starlit dinners as you soak up the unforgettable sea views.

name: Can Koi
tagline: A Stunning Finca in an Oasis of Tranquility
summary: This stunning house located between Ibiza Town and San Rafael sits in a plot of 25000 square metres of pristine land offering the perfect place to unwind surrounded by nature for you and your family. A traditional…
description:
This stunning house located between Ibiza Town and San Rafael sits in a plot of 25000 square metres of pristine land offering the perfect place to unwind surrounded by nature for you and your family. A traditional Ibizan property which has been lovingly restored to ensure its guests have the most comfortable vacation.
As you enter the villa you find the large open plan living room filled with natural light, featuring a large seating area, pool table and 120cm projector, there is also a second chillout as you make your way through the the large fully equiped kitchen. The living area opens out to the pool terrace with views of the forest and the kitchen patio offers al fresco dining while sitting next to the Koi pond enjoying the sounds of the surrounding nature. 
The property features 5 bedrooms with 4 bathrooms. The two large masters are both ensuite with two more bedrooms off the living area which share a bathroom and the final 2 bedrooms in the courtyard. All are finished to a high standard and are fully air conditioned.
The pool offers day beds, sun loungers and a chill out to maximize your time spent enjoying this wonderful area. You will also find the bbq and the bar in the garden. The perfect place to spend time with family and friends making memories. 
For those looking to stay fir during their stay there is a small area with some fitness equipment, full size tennis court and also a table tennis table as well as lots of land to explore. Fresh eggs can even be found from the properties free range chickens.
With ample private parking, an alarm system for added piece of mind and the perfect location to enjoy the island but still escape to the tranquility of your own private oasis, Can Koi is truely a wonderful choice for your stay in Ibiza.
This property offers daily cleaning.

name: Can Leilani
tagline: Hidden in the hills of the north
summary:
Can Leilani is an idyllic property located in a quiet residential area of San Joan, in the picturesque north of the island surrounded with forestry and nature.
Staying true to its traditional Ibizan roots, the newly…
description:
Can Leilani is an idyllic property located in a quiet residential area of San Joan, in the picturesque north of the island surrounded with forestry and nature.
Staying true to its traditional Ibizan roots, the newly constructed 450-meter villa resonates the island’s traditional farmhouse architecture and has been meticulously designed to provide the perfect balance between modern comforts and island ambiance.
The property is perfectly situated within just a short drive to some of the best beaches on the island; such as Benirras, Puerto San Miguel, Cala San Vicente, Cala Xarraca and Portinatx.

The home is conveniently built across one level and the interiors are bright and airy with a welcoming atmosphere throughout all of the living spaces. An air of sophistication abounds throughout each room of this beautifully decorated home which is a true treasure trove of eclectic furnishings, lighting and ornaments which all add to the overall ambience. The air of elegance is maintained throughout the house extending to the 6 large bedroom suites, all of which are supremely stylish and complete with en suite bathrooms and access to an exterior terrace space, making the most of the countryside views.

The sleeping arrangements:
Master bedroom with four poster bed has an en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto the terrace.
Bedroom 2 a twin/double with en-suite bathroom with shower
Bedroom 3 a twin/double with en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto the terrace
Bedroom 4 double with en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto the terrace
Bedroom 5 a twin/double with en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto the terrace
Bedroom 6 double with en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto the terrace

This recently built and spacious villa is surrounded by superb countryside views. 
Set within a private plot of beautiful gardens Can Leilani offers plenty of outdoor spaces to relax, from the stunning salt water pool, the main exterior lounging porch to a second covered porch with an alfresco dining area, a bar and a BBQ overlooking the magnificent landscape views.
A separate self-contained apartment offers a private entrance, living room, dining area, small kitchen, a bathroom and a double bedroom for those who seek an extra level of privacy.

name: Can Nemo
tagline: Ibiza’s most iconic super villa with unparalleled service
summary: Ibiza’s most iconic super villa, Can Nemo is a masterpiece of modern design, complete with 6-bedroom and 5 bathrooms, an estate set over sprawling acres of lush green gardens.
description: Ibiza’s most iconic super villa, Can Nemo is a masterpiece of modern design, complete with 6-bedroom and 5 bathrooms, an estate set over sprawling acres of lush green gardens.

Located in the exclusive area of Cap Martinet, with majestic sweeping sea views extending to Formentera, the idyllic situation offers easy access to the capital Ibiza Town and many other desirable locations and is just 450m from the sea.

Contemporary design combined with unrivalled views and an abundance of space, plus guaranteed privacy and exceptional service make this the most enchanting villa on the island Can Nemo encapsulates the very essence of Ibiza’s magical spirit.

Indoor Living
As you enter the house via the elegant courtyard, you cannot help but be instantly enchanted by the abundance of space and natural light which floods each room, all of which are designed from the heart, with contemporary class and luxury at every turn.

Each and every living space within the exquisitely designed house offers complete comfort with opulent touches. With the highest quality soft furnishings, fabrics and artwork, plus state-of-the-art smart home technology, you cannot help but let the spirit of the house embrace and enchant you.

An air of elegance abounds throughout each space, inviting you to enjoy the carefully created vibe, whilst an abundance of perfectly primed chill out areas are just begging to be enjoyed. Enjoy the spectacular sea views from the comfort of the living spaces, which are flooded with natural light

Entering the sleeping areas instantly brings a sense of relaxation and calm. With each one as equally enchanting as the next, the bedrooms provide your very own oasis, offering privacy, space and complete comfort, combined with contemporary chic and luxury throughout.

Each suite benefits from personal aircon systems, Wi-Fi, blackout blinds and smart home technology giving complete control of lighting and ambience, amd is complete with a 2 x 2m bed for your comfort.

The Main Suite
The Main Suite is the largest of all the bedroom suites and boasts a Hollywood style dressing room, private sun terrace and freestanding bathtub from where you can enjoy the sumptuous sea views.

Master suite 2
Located separately from the main house. This master suite rivals the main suite in the property. Comprising beautiful decorations and furniture, this suite has stunning views that sweep down over the lush lawn towards the stunning waters of Ibiza.
With large windows and elegant design, it is easy to see why this room is considered the second master.

Suite 1
Mirrored walls add an essence of extra space in this contemporary chic double room offering views over the pool and the sea with direct access to the sun terraces and a large en-suite shower room plus ample storage space.

Suite 2
Another masterpiece of modern design, the monochrome furnishings are elegant and guests can relax and soak up the views, or walk directly out to the pool and gardens from this welcoming space. Complete with an en-suite bathroom.

Suite 3
Flooded with natural sunlight, and the same flow of subtle yet stylish design, this room also offers an en-suite shower room, extensive sea views and is a most delightful, spacious and bright place to rest and relax.

Suite 4
Located inside the main house, guests can also enjoy the sea view from the carefully designed room, which shares a large bathroom with the adjacent room, making it ideal for families or those travelling with children.
Step outside and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of your surroundings from the comfort of the several sun terraces, and soak up the unrivalled sea views.

Breathe in the scent of the perfectly manicured gardens from one of the many chill out areas, providing both sun and shade. Dive deep into the large rectangular pool and soak up the healing rays of the Ibizan sunshine from the luxurious loungers.

The sublime sea views and unforgettable vistas across the skyline and sea will stay with you for a lifetime. Peace and Privacy is assured as the expansive grounds offer space for all guests to enjoy at their leisure.
Dining and Entertaining

We take dining seriously at Can Nemo. Both our indoor and outdoor dining areas have been designed to accommodate you and your guests, seating up to 22 people in comfort and luxury, taking great care to ensure your mealtimes are always memorable
Designed personally by Jose, our head chef to enhance every sitting, our kitchens are perfectly prepared to take you seamlessly from sun kissed breakfasts to starlit dinners, and our bespoke bar areas provide the perfect place to enjoy sun downers with your guests.
Providing the perfect place to eat throughout the year, our dining areas are welcoming and spacious, meaning you always have the right place whatever the occasion. Indulge your senses and choose your favorite tipple whenever it suits you, all the while soaking up the views over the shoreline.
Fitness & Spa
Maintain your physical prime with our state-of-the-art Peloton machines, free weights and fitness technology to be found in the bespoke gymnasium.

A tranquil treatment room provides a space for whatever your heart desires, with a team of wellness available on request to offer every kind of treatment you could wish for.
The dedicated yoga deck offers the perfect place to practice your yoga poses and maintain your daily practice whilst on your holiday.
Can Nemo is now allowing weddings - events of up to 30 guests during April, May, June, September and October with a supplement of 10,000€ for the gathering that covers bar staff and night security.
Wedding duration us for a minimum of 1 week and must comply with local noise regulations and respect to the surrounding neighborhood
Can Nemo includes 6 staff with 48 hours per week, 6 days Villa Manager, 2 Cleaners, Gardener, and villa maintenance caretaker.

Multifunction room.
The Multifunction room of Villa Can Nemo is available for guests to watch movies or play play play station.

Security:
Villa Can Nemo does not have security personnel, if the client requires this service we can arrange it, the cost being borne by the client.

name: Can Nora
tagline: A beautifully renovated country house with charm throughout
summary: Elegantly restored farmhouse conveniently located in the rural heart of the island, just a short walk to the village of Santa Gertrudis, a vibrant and popular place full of lively bars, cafes and excellent restaurants.…
description: Elegantly restored farmhouse conveniently located in the rural heart of the island, just a short walk to the village of Santa Gertrudis, a vibrant and popular place full of lively bars, cafes and excellent restaurants. The 600-year-old Hacienda offers a truly authentic Ibiza experience and is set in a large olive plantation and surrounded by green mountains.

Contemporary interiors enliven and compliment this magnificent 600 year-old historic house. A truly unique and authentic property infused with history and Ibicenca tradition, artfully complemented by spectacular interior design features. The spacious lounge and living areas are flooded with natural light and all benefit from charming furnishings, decoration and sophisticated style. The rooms are set out to ensure that everyone has privacy. The sprawling estate offers a true sense of space and freedom.

Each of the 6 bedrooms are equally stylish and furnished to the same exceptional standard. Effortless elegance abounds throughout this charming home, and you will find your every creature comfort catered for. The lounge area offers a reading selection and is served by a traditional style well appointed kitchen.

Step outside into the lavish grounds of Can Nora and enjoy the beautiful vista from the glorious pool or hide yourself away in one of the secluded outdoor chill out areas. The property has excellent facilities for hosting large events, including a spacious and beautifully designed patio with the adjoining barn, which has been converted as a space to host celebrations and events. Expansive, fragrant gardens are blooming with ancient trees, cactuses and flowers.
BEDROOM BREAKDOWN:

Built with traditional sabina wooden ceilings and cal-white stone walls, each of the 6 large bedrooms are decorated in its own definitive style. Four bedrooms are located in the main house, while the other two are external rooms with their own entrance. All rooms are fully equipped and have high-speed wifi.

#1 King size bed 180×200- Ensuite bathroom
#2 has 2 large single beds 120×190 -shared bathroom with room number 6
#3 Queen sized bed 160×190- En suite bathroom with shower
#4 King-sized bed 190×200 or 2x singles- En-suite bathroom with shower
#5 King-sized bed 190×200 or 2x singles- En-suite bathroom with shower
#6 King-sized bed 190×200 or 2x singles bathroom with shower room number 2

name: Can Nuri
tagline: Modern finca with amazing sea views and large outdoor space for relaxing.
summary: This wonderful finca located above Sa Caleta has uninterrupted views over the sea to Formentera and Cap des Falcó.
description: This wonderful finca located above Sa Caleta has uninterrupted views over the sea to Formentera and Cap des Falcó.
With its saltwater infinity pool, you can relax surrounded by the constantly changing colours of the mountains that surround you and the uninterrupted sea views in front of you.
This recently reformed finca has an open-plan kitchen living area, that spillss out onto the sprawling terraces and then onto the lush green grass of this perfectly manicured lawn area.

Elegantly decorated and furnished with comfortable sofas along with a stylish dining area, Can Nuri also has spacious living areas that features multiple modern accessories to enjoy while chilling out during your well-earned holiday.
The lower floor features a laundry room, a spacious pantry, a storage room and a large games' room of 60m², as well as one of the bedrooms.

In addition, the house is perfect for sports lovers, the sports facilities have been designed with the objective of providing entertainment options to the whole family. The 40m² gym comes with an exercise bike, elliptical trainer, treadmill, rowing machine, weights and punching bag. While outdoors, there is the paddle court with night lighting and a pétanque court.
*Please note: this property is located close to the airport.

name: Can Octavia
tagline: A beautifully restored finca with tennis in the heart of Ibiza's countryside!
summary: Can Octavia is a 6 bedroom traditional finca which has been lovingly restored and transformed into a captivating home, retaining all of its authenticity and charm, yet refurbished to ensure that your every luxury and…
description: Can Octavia is a 6 bedroom traditional finca which has been lovingly restored and transformed into a captivating home, retaining all of its authenticity and charm, yet refurbished to ensure that your every luxury and comfort is catered for. Situated in the heart of the lush green countryside of San Lorenzo, the location offers easy access to the beautiful beaches of the North, including Benirras, Cala Xarraca and Portinatx. Located only a short drive from the capital, Ibiza Town with its dazzling array of dancing and dining destinations.

Each room within Can Octavia exudes local style and charm, with whitewashed walls and traditional features such as stone mason walls being perfectly complemented by Bohemian chic style furnishings and decorations. The interior design is exceptional with careful attention to detail throughout. The welcoming living room is complete with an open fireplace and flooded with natural light, and is served by a stylish and well appointed kitchen. There are several places to relax and reflect within this charming home.
The 6 bedrooms are all decorated as the living areas, with beautiful furnishings throughout and you will find your every need catered for in all of the sleeping and bathroom areas.
Main house – 3 bedrooms, 2 bathroom, Living room, Dinning room, Bar, Kitchen
Side house – 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Living room, Dinning room, Kitchen
Annex – 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Living room, separate Entrance
Pool house – 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Living room, separate Entrance

Step outside into the gardens of Can Octavia and immerse yourself in the beauty of the nature which surrounds, you, the gardens are perfectly landscaped and full of fragrant flowers and plants, with an inviting pool surrounded by various sun terraces and an alfresco shaded dining area which takes you from breakfast to starlit dinners easily. A private tennis court is available for those who like to remain active whilst holidaying in this most romantic of homes.
The owners prefer families rather than groups of friends.

name: Can Paloma
tagline: Effortless luxury in stunning setting
summary: Can Paloma is a fully renovated Blakstad-style finca, designed in collaboration with leading architects and interior specialists. The result is refined, high-end living with warmth and personality, polished without…
description: Can Paloma is a fully renovated Blakstad-style finca, designed in collaboration with leading architects and interior specialists. The result is refined, high-end living with warmth and personality, polished without feeling pretentious.

Completely private yet just minutes from Sant Josep de sa Talaia and close to beautiful beaches like Cala Bassa and Cala Tarida, the location offers both seclusion and easy access to everything Ibiza is known for.
The landscaped 3,000 m² garden features palm trees, clean-lined pathways, and a heated pool (optional). Spacious terraces include sun loungers, a shaded pergola dining area, an outdoor kitchen with BBQ, and a rooftop lounge with sweeping valley views. Smart home technology runs seamlessly throughout.

Original wooden beams and traditional finca elements blend effortlessly with natural stone, warm wood, and soft neutral tones, creating a relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere.
The main house includes a fully equipped designer kitchen, generous indoor and outdoor dining areas for up to 12 guests, two ground-floor bedrooms, and an upstairs master suite with a freestanding bath and private rooftop terrace.
A separate guest casita offers three additional en-suite bedrooms with terrace access, ideal for added privacy.

Extras include a Sonos sound system and table tennis.
Stylish, private, and quietly luxurious; exactly how Ibiza living should feel.

name: Can Sahara
tagline: Grandiose villa exuding Hollywood Hills elegance
summary: Perched high on the hill of Sa Carroca, Can Sahara enjoys breathtaking panoramic views over the Salinas Natural Park, the historic skyline of Dalt Vila, and the sparkling Mediterranean stretching toward Formentera.…
description: Perched high on the hill of Sa Carroca, Can Sahara enjoys breathtaking panoramic views over the Salinas Natural Park, the historic skyline of Dalt Vila, and the sparkling Mediterranean stretching toward Formentera. Surrounded by fragrant pine forests, this exceptional villa sits at the very top of the hill, offering total privacy with no overlooking neighbors, yet it remains just a five-minute drive from Ibiza Town and the airport. The location perfectly combines convenience with seclusion in one of the island’s most desirable areas.

Over the past two years the property has undergone an extensive renovation, with the final stages of this ambitious transformation scheduled for completion in 2026. Every bedroom and en-suite bathroom has been redesigned to the highest standards. A brand-new pool has been created with improved access and expanded terraces, while the spacious sunbathing areas will be finished in elegant travertine stone. The result is a refined and contemporary residence that balances comfort, style, and effortless luxury.

The main house has been comprehensively upgraded, including a brand-new air-conditioning system, complete electrical rewiring, and the installation of a modern home automation system. Seven beautifully designed bathrooms feature fittings by Agape, Inbani, and Ritmonio. The custom-built iroko kitchen is finished with quartzite countertops and equipped with premium Gaggenau appliances. Throughout the villa, furnishings and decorative pieces from renowned design houses such as Flexform, Baxter, Knoll, Tacchini, Hermès, Ochre, Bocci, Rotganzen, and Vi-Spring create a sophisticated yet welcoming atmosphere.

The open-plan living area is designed for entertaining, with a pool table and a bespoke fully stocked bar that opens directly onto the pool terrace, framing spectacular sea views. In the garden, a 144-inch retractable outdoor cinema screen adds a striking feature, delivering crystal-clear viewing both in daylight and after dark. Several outdoor lounges, dining areas, and sun terraces, furnished with high-end pieces, invite guests to relax and soak in the Mediterranean setting.

Fitness and wellbeing are also at the heart of Can Sahara. The villa includes a beautifully designed gym featuring equipment from the exclusive brand Pent, a Technogym Kinesis wall trainer, and additional Technogym machines, along with a dedicated area for boxing and free weights. Further wellness facilities are planned, including a jacuzzi, sauna, cold plunge, and an upgraded gym area with a new air-conditioning system and integrated invisible speakers.

name: Can Sandra
tagline: An ideal family property with easy access to the most idyllic beaches
summary: Can Sandra is a charming Bohemian style finca that beckons you into a world of tranquility and natural beauty. This exquisite property offers 6 bedrooms and is ideally situated walking distance to the beach, ensuring…
description: Can Sandra is a charming Bohemian style finca that beckons you into a world of tranquility and natural beauty. This exquisite property offers 6 bedrooms and is ideally situated walking distance to the beach, ensuring both seclusion and convenience for your island getaway. Just a short drive away lie some of the most beloved beaches on the west coast, including the renowned Cala Bassa and Cala Conta, where you can bask in the sun and witness the mesmerizing sunset views that the island is famous for.

Step inside this haven to discover beautifully spacious living areas adorned with a contemporary bohemian style. The large open plan lounge seamlessly merges with a fully equipped kitchen, boasting high wooden Sabina beamed ceilings and a comfortable sofa area. These spaces effortlessly flow onto an inviting outside porch, featuring a grand-sized exterior dining table and a chillout area, where you can enjoy delightful moments with your loved ones while surrounded by nature's serenity.

Can Sandra is not just a villa; it's an oasis tailored for couples, families, and wellness retreats alike. With its six bedrooms, this property offers ample space and comfort for everyone. Moreover, the villa is equipped with heating, ensuring a cozy ambiance during any season, making it the perfect destination year-round.
The sleeping arrangements at the property are:
In the main villa you will find Bedroom 1, the Master bedroom offers a king size bed, en-suite bathroom (bathtub & shower), sofa area and sliding doors opening out onto a private terrace.

The villa then offers 5 guest bedrooms, these not interconnected with the main villa and have private entrances. 
Bedroom 2, a double bedroom with en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto the pool terrace.
Bedroom 3, a double bedroom split over two levels, As you enter the room you have the en-suite with shower and then down stairs a double bedroom with small window and tv. (the Ac unit is located in the bathroom area)
Bedroom 4, a double bedroom with en-suite bathroom with shower. 
Bedroom 5, a double bedroom with en-suite bathroom with shower. 
Bedroom 6, a double bedroom with en-suite bathroom with shower and opens onto a a private terrace.

Escape to Can Sandra and experience it's charm, where every moment is infused with the essence of Ibiza's natural splendor and hospitality. Book your stay now and immerse yourself in the magic of this idyllic retreat.

name: Can Senna
tagline: Stylish Scandinavian design with sea and coastal views
summary: Can Senna is a fabulous new addition in Ibiza’s exclusive residential South Coast spot Es Cubells. Situated on a sunbaked hillside in the heart of the island’s famed ‘Golden Triangle’, this wonderful 5 bedroom luxury…
description: Can Senna is a fabulous new addition in Ibiza’s exclusive residential South Coast spot Es Cubells. Situated on a sunbaked hillside in the heart of the island’s famed ‘Golden Triangle’, this wonderful 5 bedroom luxury villa combines the exclusive vibe of a boutique hotel with the pleasure of seclusion and privacy in a divine location close to some of the islands most desirable beaches, including Cala Tarida and Cala Conte, famed for their spectacular sunsets, and Cala Bassa, with its eponymous beachclub.

Can Senna has a truly unique design with various levels, terraces and stand-alone platforms which offers incredible bayside views, while the high-end interior design including the use of exclusive and authentic natural materials makes this diamond also shine from within its glorious white walls. Splashes of colour from expertly chosen decorations, artworks and soft furnishings accentuate the neutral tones and contemporary chic is most certainly the order of the day here.
The effortless elegance flows easily to the sleeping areas and each of the 5 bedroom suites are equally exquisite, with superb design features and your every creature comfort catered for.

Step outside and immerse yourself in the beauty of your surroundings. Can Senna is full of fragrant pine trees, plants and flowers to add to the overall tropical vibe of this wonderful estate. Chillout poolside or entertain guests in the spacious terrace areas whilst you soak up the exceptional views.

name: Can Tehani
tagline: A wonderfully designed, contemporary villa with exceptional views
summary: Can Tehani is a modern design masterpiece, a contemporary style 6 bedroom mansion which sits majestically on a hillside with views to the surrounding green hills and the bay of Cala Jondal, home to the world famous Blue…
description: Can Tehani is a modern design masterpiece, a contemporary style 6 bedroom mansion which sits majestically on a hillside with views to the surrounding green hills and the bay of Cala Jondal, home to the world famous Blue Marlin beachclub. The picturesque village of San Jose is within easy reach and celebrates a lively cafe culture, as is the capital of the island Ibiza Town with its many dancing and dining destinations.

Can Tehani was designed by the famous architect Jaime Serra who has studios in Ibiza and Barcelona and is a truly exceptionally styled property. The interior decoration features vintage 50’s and 60’s pieces bought in Madrid and Paris antique shops that give an edgy touch, as well as beautiful contemporary photographs and paintings A fully equipped kitchen is fitted with every modern day appliance you would expect and the stylish, spacious lounge areas afford you the chance for a quiet moment of reflection
There are a total of six bedrooms dispatched between the main house with four bedrooms and a separate guest house with two bedrooms.

Set on a large private plot, the exquisite landscaped garden have a mediterranean theme, and lush green lawn with olive trees, mimosas, lavenders, and a wonderfully mature garden complete with a fountain surrounded by orange trees.
From the pool you can enjoy the spectacular sea views to Cala Jondal. A large chill out pavilion nearby and sun beds are available for relaxation.

name: Can Vina
tagline: Can Vina , an exceptional luxury villa nestled amidst the serene mountains of San Lorenzo ,a unique haven in the heart of Ibiza.
summary: Can Vina , an exceptional luxury villa nestled amidst the serene mountains of San Lorenzo, offers a unique haven in the heart of Ibiza. This conveniently located yet secluded gem provides unparalleled privacy and…
description: Can Vina , an exceptional luxury villa nestled amidst the serene mountains of San Lorenzo, offers a unique haven in the heart of Ibiza. This conveniently located yet secluded gem provides unparalleled privacy and breathtaking vistas of the valley. A mere 5-minute drive to Santa Gertrudis, 15 minutes to Ibiza Town, and just 20 minutes from the airport, it's the perfect gateway to the island's pristine beaches in every direction.

Combining modern luxury with architectural influences from around the world, Can Vina maintains the rustic Mediterranean charm of Ibiza. Comprising 800 square meters of living space, 600 square meters of terraces, and a sprawling 15,000 square meters of lush gardens, Can Vina is the ultimate holiday retreat. Designed to seamlessly blend indoor and outdoor living, this elegant sanctuary effortlessly fuses comfort and opulence.

The villa boasts a luxurious infinity pool complete with an outdoor bar, shower, and bathroom, along with multiple tranquil chill-out areas. Adjacent to the pool, you'll find a fully equipped private gym. The extensive garden surrounding the villa features a tennis court, a bountiful vegetable garden, tranquil fish ponds, a remarkable treehouse crafted by the renowned Pete Nelson, a whimsical forest play area for children, and tranquil Asian gazebos tucked away in the garden for meditation, yoga, or massages.

Spanning two floors, Can Vina accommodates 12 guests across its 6 bedrooms, each equipped with its own bathroom, closet, and air-conditioning. The ground floor hosts a spacious kitchen and living area featuring the latest in advanced kitchen appliances. The expansive living room encompasses various seating areas, a cozy fireplace, and a generously sized dining table. The outdoor dining space is equipped with a professional Uruguayan barbecue and a traditional stone oven for authentic Italian pizza preparation.
Can Vina stands as the ideal choice for your dream retreat in paradise, where luxury, privacy, and natural beauty converge to create an unforgettable experience.

name: Can Xarraca
tagline: Divine villa surrounded by pine forests in the North of Ibiza
summary: Can Xarraca is a spectacular hideaway with breathtaking sea views, lush private gardens and direct access to the beach. The property is situated near the village of Portinax and consists of 2 separate living areas…
description: Can Xarraca is a spectacular hideaway with breathtaking sea views, lush private gardens and direct access to the beach. The property is situated near the village of Portinax and consists of 2 separate living areas divided by a covered courtyard.

The more recently-build part was designed by the famous Blakstad and consists of the main living room with high beamed ceilings, fireplace and comfortable sofas. French doors open on the terrace overlooking the sea and on the other side to the Moroccan courtyard garden.   Double doors at end of the living room lead to a central hall, the kitchen and the bedrooms. The master suite is located on the first floor, with a four-poster bed and a large private terrace with a fountain and views to the sea and coastal cliffs. There are two more bedrooms, a double and a twin bedroom, located on the ground floor that share a bathroom and have French doors opening to another terrace.

There is a dining area adjoining the kitchen but during the warmer months meals are usually taken outside on the terrace next to the Moroccan garden which is planted with formal box hedges and herbs. There are several other terraces at various spots around the house and gardens.

The second house is a centuries-old finca with beautiful Sabina wood ceilings and many preserved original features. On the ground floor there is a double bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, a twin bedroom, a second kitchen and a small sitting area with a fireplace. Upstairs, there is a double room with a private terrace facing the sea.   Next to the main house there is a large lawn dominated by two enormous palm trees and the 10 metre swimming pool, at the far end of which is a large chill-out area with lots of comfortable cushions and a canvas sunshade.
The house is air-conditioned and there is central heating for the cooler months. There is wireless Internet, satellite TV and a high-spec music system.

Access to the property from the coast road is via a remotely-controlled gate and the grounds extend right down to the seashore – it’s about 800 metres walk down to the pebble beach at Cala Xuclar or 1km to the sandy beach at Cala Xarraca. There is a private parking area with space for several vehicles.
Suitable for weddings & events. Events fee apply.

name: Cana Serena
tagline: Comfortable home in a private urbanisation
summary: Escape to pure calm at Villa Cana Serena, a beautiful home in the exclusive and secure Roca Llisa community. Private, stylish and designed for easy island living, it’s the perfect place to switch off and enjoy Ibiza…
description: Escape to pure calm at Villa Cana Serena, a beautiful home in the exclusive and secure Roca Llisa community. Private, stylish and designed for easy island living, it’s the perfect place to switch off and enjoy Ibiza with family or friends.
The villa has 6 spacious double bedrooms and 7 bathrooms, giving plenty of space and privacy.

Days here are made for relaxing — by the large private pool, listening to music through the indoor and outdoor sound system, or enjoying a movie night in the comfy living room with its cinema setup. If you want to move a bit more, there’s also a sauna, steam room, small gym, and rooftop spaces perfect for yoga or stretching with open views. The house gets sun all day, with shaded corners when you need a break.

In the evening, grab a drink from the outdoor bar and watch the sunset — one of the best parts of the house. With green mountain views and the golf course around you, it feels peaceful and private, yet still close to everything.
Seasonal home-grown fruit and vegetables are available when nature allows.
EVERYTHING WITHIN REACH

— 7 min to Jesús (bakery, supermarkets, restaurants)
— 7 min to Cala Llonga beach
— 10 min walk to Roca House
— 12 min to Ibiza Town
— 5 min to Ibiza Golf
— 20 min to Cala Olivera
— 20 min to Amante Restaurant
— 15–20 min to Ibiza Airport (approx.)
IDEAL FOR
Groups and families looking for a relaxed, comfortable Ibiza stay with lots of space, privacy and sunshine — but still close to beaches, restaurants and everything the island has to offer.

tagline: Authentic countryside villa surrounded by natural beauty
summary: Casa Yolanda is a luxurious Ibiza rental villa with incredible views from its lavish terrace. This exclusive villa is filled with Ibizan charm and has a contemporary yet warm ambience.
description: Casa Yolanda is a luxurious Ibiza rental villa with incredible views from its lavish terrace. This exclusive villa is filled with Ibizan charm and has a contemporary yet warm ambience.

This spacious stylishly presented 6-bedroom Ibiza holiday home has a large private pool with plenty of shaded and un-shaded day beds for all the family. There are additional rooms allocated for staff.

Surrounded by lush landscaped gardens where children can play or family and friends can relax, its impressive terrace captures the dazzling Ibiza sun from sunset to sundown. An alfresco dining and barbeque area can easily host up to twelve for guests to while away the evenings soaking up the magnificent views.
Stylishly presented throughout, this prestige Ibiza rental property is perfect for larger families or groups of friends.

This immaculate Ibiza rental holiday home boasts a fully equipped kitchen with all the appliances a family or group of friends could ever need which truly makes it a home from home property. The beautiful rustic feel of the lounge area features an upscale open fireplace for cozy Ibizan evenings or intimate gatherings with soft comfortable seating. All the ground level rooms have the added bonus of opening onto the property’s magnificent terrace.

Each crisp, clean and beautifully presented bedroom has its own bathroom as there are an impressive seven bathrooms in this beautiful Ibiza rental villa. Each include a complimentary hairdryer and towels for guests to use. This is ideal if you are travelling with groups or other families for complete privacy.
Each bathroom include showers with hydro-massage shower heads and/or deep soaking baths, perfect for unwinding after a day in the dazzling sunshine.
Guests can surf the web using the property’s complimentary wireless internet access.
