name: Finca Lucia
tagline: A herb-scented finca where Can Furnet meets Ibiza Town's pulse
summary: Set on the sun-warmed hillside of Can Furnet, Finca Lucia sits just five minutes from the cobbled lanes and candlelit terraces of Ibiza Town — close enough to feel the energy, far enough to exhale.
description: Set on the sun-warmed hillside of Can Furnet, Finca Lucia sits just five minutes from the cobbled lanes and candlelit terraces of Ibiza Town — close enough to feel the energy, far enough to exhale.

The property is a true Ibizan finca: thick whitewashed walls, terracotta underfoot, and a garden where rosemary, lavender and wild herbs scent the afternoon air. Six generous bedrooms and four bathrooms make it a natural gathering place for families or a close group of friends, while two separate salons offer room to spread out after long, sunlit days. The kitchen is built for proper cooking — think late breakfasts that stretch toward lunch, and slow evenings around the barbecue as the island cools. The pool catches the last of the evening light.
Picture yourself there: a glass in hand, the distant glow of Dalt Vila on the horizon, nowhere else to be.

name: Finca Palmeras
tagline: Where Ibiza's Soul Meets Timeless Luxury
summary: Rooted in the heart of Ibiza's verdant countryside, this magnificent restored finca is a rare marriage of raw island soul and refined modern living. Ancient whitewashed walls, hand-hewn wooden beams and terracotta-toned…
description: Rooted in the heart of Ibiza's verdant countryside, this magnificent restored finca is a rare marriage of raw island soul and refined modern living. Ancient whitewashed walls, hand-hewn wooden beams and terracotta-toned stone speak the language of the land, while every interior detail has been carefully curated to deliver the comfort and elegance that discerning guests expect. The result is a home that feels both deeply authentic and effortlessly luxurious — a place where the island's spirit lives in every room.

Set across generous landscaped grounds with sweeping panoramic views that roll from lush Mediterranean hills to the glittering sea beyond, Villa Terra Blanca accommodates up to 12 guests across six individually styled bedrooms. Whether you're gathering a family, celebrating a milestone with friends, or simply seeking an extraordinary private escape, this is your stage.

Living Spaces
The heart of the villa is its spectacular open-plan living and dining area — flooded with natural light, anchored by exposed wooden ceiling beams and dressed in handcrafted furnishings that feel simultaneously rustic and refined. Curated art pieces dot the whitewashed walls, and the flow between lounge, dining and kitchen makes the space feel both grand and warmly liveable.

The fully equipped contemporary kitchen is a pleasure to cook in — designed for the chef who wants to work with the finest local produce from Ibiza's markets, yet equally suited to catering for a crowd. The separate dining room, with its polished hardwood furniture and vintage sideboard, sets the scene for long, wine-filled evenings that drift effortlessly into the night.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms
Six beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own distinct character, offer the perfect sanctuary after a day exploring the island. Four bedrooms feature private en-suite bathrooms, while a fifth shared bathroom serves the remaining rooms — ensuring that every guest enjoys their own private space.

Expect crisp white linen, premium mattresses, ample wardrobe storage and garden views from most rooms. The bathrooms are finished to a spa-like standard: contemporary fixtures, rainfall showers and plush towels combine to make the daily ritual of getting ready feel like an indulgence in itself.

Pool & Outdoor Living
Step outside and the magic truly begins.

The centrepiece of Villa Terra Blanca's outdoor world is its large private swimming pool, set against a backdrop of pine-covered hillsides and open sky. Premium sun loungers line the terrace, perfectly positioned for those long, golden Ibizan afternoons when time seems to slow to a welcome standstill.

The surrounding landscaped gardens — lush, secluded and immaculately maintained — create a sense of complete privacy. A fully equipped BBQ area and multiple shaded terraces invite alfresco dining at its finest: fresh fish, local cheeses, chilled rosé, and the scent of jasmine in the evening air. This is outdoor living elevated to an art form.

Location
Nestled in the Ibizan countryside with panoramic views of both the green interior and the Mediterranean Sea, Villa Terra Blanca offers the perfect balance of seclusion and access. The island's iconic beaches, world-class restaurants and legendary nightlife are all within easy reach — yet the moment you step through the villa gates, the outside world simply falls away.

name: Lovella
tagline: Clifftop seclusion above Cala Vadella's shimmering western waters
summary: Set atop a spectacular clifftop on Ibiza’s coveted southwest coast, Villa Lovella is an exceptional six-bedroom private estate where contemporary luxury meets the island’s natural beauty. Surrounded by 10,000 m² of…
description: Set atop a spectacular clifftop on Ibiza’s coveted southwest coast, Villa Lovella is an exceptional six-bedroom private estate where contemporary luxury meets the island’s natural beauty. Surrounded by 10,000 m² of Mediterranean woodland and overlooking the shimmering coastline, the villa offers complete privacy, breathtaking sunsets, and an unforgettable setting just moments from Cala Vadella and Cala Carbó.

Recently renovated to the highest standards, the 450 m² residence blends authentic Mediterranean architecture with refined modern design. Natural stone walls, elegant marble flooring, bespoke furnishings, and carefully curated interiors create a sophisticated yet welcoming atmosphere. Throughout the villa, premium amenities—including 4K Smart TVs and a Bose sound system—ensure every comfort is effortlessly catered for.

The spacious open-plan living areas are designed for both relaxation and entertaining. A fully equipped professional kitchen connects seamlessly with the indoor dining space, where floor-to-ceiling views of the Mediterranean provide a stunning backdrop from sunrise to sunset.

Villa Lovella accommodates up to twelve guests across six beautifully appointed en-suite bedrooms. The elegant master suite enjoys direct access to the gardens and uninterrupted sea views, creating a truly serene retreat. A second bedroom is located within the main house, while three additional guest suites and a separate self-contained studio apartment are positioned around the pool terrace, each with its own private entrance to provide maximum independence and privacy for guests.

Outside, the villa has been designed to embrace Ibiza’s outdoor lifestyle. Expansive wooden terraces surround a striking infinity pool that appears to merge seamlessly with the sea beyond. Multiple lounge areas invite guests to unwind in the sun, while generous covered terraces provide the perfect setting for alfresco dining and sunset cocktails. A fully equipped barbecue area completes the experience, making every meal an occasion.

Whether enjoying peaceful mornings overlooking the Mediterranean, hosting unforgettable evenings with friends and family, or celebrating a special occasion, Villa Lovella offers an extraordinary setting. The estate is also perfectly suited for intimate weddings, private events, and bespoke celebrations, combining spectacular scenery with exceptional comfort in one of Ibiza’s most sought-after locations.
Villa Lovella is more than a luxury villa—it’s an exclusive Mediterranean sanctuary designed for unforgettable experiences.

name: Villa Allison
tagline: Stunning property in the most desired area of Ibiza
summary: Villa Allison is a beautifully reformed finca that offers an exceptional blend of rustic charm and modern luxury, perched on a hillside to take full advantage of its expansive views. Guests can savor breathtaking…
description: Villa Allison is a beautifully reformed finca that offers an exceptional blend of rustic charm and modern luxury, perched on a hillside to take full advantage of its expansive views. Guests can savor breathtaking panoramas of the deep blue Mediterranean Sea, the charming silhouette of Dalt Vila (Ibiza's iconic old town), and the rugged hills of nearby Formentera Island. These stunning vistas provide the perfect backdrop for a serene and luxurious escape.

You can enjoy these magnificent views from multiple outdoor spaces throughout the villa. The 10m x 5m saltwater swimming pool is a highlight, providing a refreshing place to relax and take in the surroundings. Whether lounging by the pool on a sunny day or unwinding under the shade of the terrace, you will find the perfect spot to enjoy the views. The shaded terrace features an elegant al-fresco dining area that can comfortably seat up to 14 guests, making it the perfect setting for memorable meals shared with friends and family.

Villa Allison also features an upper terrace, nestled amidst fragrant lavender, where you can enjoy another dining area for 12 guests, alongside comfortable lounge seating, all while taking in even more stunning sea and countryside views. A barbecue and summer kitchen by the poolside add another layer of convenience for outdoor entertaining, creating an ideal space for relaxed meals in the open air.

Inside, the villa offers sleek, minimalist interiors, with an open-plan design that maximizes natural light and seamlessly connects the living areas with the surrounding terraces. The main living space is designed for comfort and style, featuring generous pale sofas arranged to enhance the incredible sea views. The open-plan layout extends into the spacious dining area and well-equipped kitchen, which combines pale wood and cool marble countertops, offering both elegance and functionality for those who enjoy cooking.

For additional relaxation, there’s a second lounge space located downstairs, which opens directly onto the pool terrace. This cozy den includes a home cinema system for movie nights, as well as a small gym for those looking to stay active during their stay.

The villa’s six spacious bedrooms all maintain the same chic aesthetic, with white-walled rooms and polished floors that create a calm and airy ambiance. Each bedroom is en-suite and furnished with a king-size bed, ensuring a comfortable and restful stay. The master suite is particularly luxurious, offering private access to a sun terrace equipped with loungers, where you can enjoy sweeping views of the sea. One of the unique features of Villa Allison is the bedroom distribution whereas only one bedroom offers internal access from the living areas on the ground floor while all of the remain 5 bedrooms offers external entrance to add to the privacy needed when traveling with groups of friends.

Villa Allison is located in a tranquil residential neighborhood, making it an ideal retreat for those seeking peace and privacy. The property is subject to strict noise and loud music regulations between 11 pm and 10 am, ensuring a serene environment for all guests. For families with young children, the villa is well-equipped with a selection of toys, cots, and highchairs to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible.

This fabulous villa is not only a peaceful sanctuary but also perfectly positioned to explore the best of Ibiza. Ibiza Town is less than a ten-minute drive away, offering a wealth of dining, shopping, and cultural experiences. The beautiful golden sands of Playa Talamanca are even closer, providing a perfect spot for beach lovers to enjoy the island's sun, sand, and sea.

Villa Allison is a luxurious retreat with unparalleled sea views and an ideal location for exploring the charms of Ibiza. Whether you are looking to relax by the pool, entertain in the outdoor spaces, or explore the island, this villa offers an unforgettable experience.

BREAKFAST CHEF 
breakfast 5 days/week (only from 23rd May till 5th September)

name: Villa Alyssa

summary: Villa Alyssa is a truly impressive newly built 8 bedroom property, with outstanding sea, town and countryside views. This villa is perfectly located close to Ibiza Town and the Marina Botafoch with their abundance of…
description: Villa Alyssa is a truly impressive newly built 8 bedroom property, with outstanding sea, town and countryside views. This villa is perfectly located close to Ibiza Town and the Marina Botafoch with their abundance of restaurants and nightlife scene. The house has been designed to the highest of specifications throughout and is one of the desirable villas in Ibiza.

An ingenious blend of contemporary style blended seamlessly with traditional touches makes Villa Alyssa unique and enchanting. The interior is elegant, chic and modern throughout, each detail has been carefully considered to ensure that your every comfort is catered for, and the quality of the furnishings and fittings are exceptional, from the sumptuous lounges to the extensive open plan kitchen with breakfast bar, opening out onto the terrace where you can delight in the uninterrupted views of the sparkling sea. All of the bedrooms are of course decorated to the same high standard, the two master suites benefit from their own private terrace and king size beds, with all other rooms complete with double beds and ensuite bathrooms, plus three separate guest houses with spectacular seaviews.

Set over expansive grounds, the gardens are equally impressive, with a private tennis court, mini football pitch, fresh water swimming pool with outdoor bathrooms, lush landscaped gardens, various terraces for lounging, large day beds, a hot tub and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with the choice of a cocktail bar and various outdoor al fresco dining spaces to choose from, allowing you to dine in style and comfort whilst soaking up the unforgettable seaviews.

name: Villa Amaris
tagline: Frontline property with exceptional sea views and elegance throughout
summary: Villa Amaris is an exceptional 6 bedroom modern villa located inside the sought after gated community of Vista Alegre which offers direct beach access. This superb villa ranks as one of Ibiza's most desirable luxury…
description: Villa Amaris is an exceptional 6 bedroom modern villa located inside the sought after gated community of Vista Alegre which offers direct beach access. This superb villa ranks as one of Ibiza's most desirable luxury hideaways, perfectly positioned with unrivalled seaviews.

Step inside Villa Amaris and be instantly enchanted by the expansive living areas which boast welcoming and luxurious sofas where you can kick back and enjoy the fabulous views of the crystalline sea through huge floor to ceiling sliding windows which open out onto the terrace by the pool. An unusual yet attractive ceiling mounted wood burning stove adds to the overall elegance of this sweeping, multi floored property. An inviting dining area and well appointed bright and modern kitchen is equipped with all the modern day appliances you would expect from a villa of this standard. Each of the 6 bedrooms are sublimely furnished in their own unique style, and are spacious double rooms, each benefitting from their own en-suite bathrooms and unforgettable sea views.

However, without doubt, the jewel in the crown of Villa Amaris is the breathtaking infinity pool, which overlooks the cliff edge offering you the most idyllic seaviews, and is surrounded by a fully decked terrace. Complete with ample sun loungers, this leads you to a shaded dedicated chill out area with vast outdoor daybeds and sofas just made for lounging. In addition, you can find complete peace and tranquility in a second, more expansive covered luxury outdoor lounge area complete with a splendid al fresco dining space, again offering uninterrupted seaviews perfect for entertaining family and friends or to take a quiet moment to reflect on yet another idyllic Ibizan day.

name: Villa Amaya
tagline: Open skies, and the heart of Ibiza within reach
summary: Set among the pine-covered hills of San Lorenzo, Villa Amaya occupies a generous private plot where the silence is broken only by birdsong and the distant shimmer of the countryside stretching toward Santa Eulalia. The…
description:
Set among the pine-covered hills of San Lorenzo, Villa Amaya occupies a generous private plot where the silence is broken only by birdsong and the distant shimmer of the countryside stretching toward Santa Eulalia. The architecture is clean and considered — sharp lines softened by warm natural materials — with interiors that feel both polished and genuinely liveable. 
Six bedroom suites, all within the main house, are finished to a consistent standard with king-size beds, quality linens, and a calm, uncluttered aesthetic that encourages rest. Living spaces flow naturally toward the outside, where expansive terraces invite long, unhurried meals and the kind of afternoons that blur into evenings without anyone noticing. A fully equipped kitchen handles everything from a quiet breakfast to a full group dinner with ease. 
The mountain views at dusk, all amber and violet, make it very hard to go inside.

name: Villa Brielle
tagline: Recently renovated with amazing sea and sunset views
summary: Villa Brielle is an exceptional and exclusive Ibizan retreat, ideally located close to some of the island’s most desirable sunset beaches on the stunning west coast of Ibiza. This supremely stylish 6-bedroom villa sits…
description: Villa Brielle is an exceptional and exclusive Ibizan retreat, ideally located close to some of the island’s most desirable sunset beaches on the stunning west coast of Ibiza. This supremely stylish 6-bedroom villa sits just a stone's throw away from the pristine white sands of Cala Tarida and Cala Moli, two of the most sought-after beaches in Ibiza, and is only a short drive from the charming village of San Jose. The villa is positioned to take full advantage of breathtaking panoramic views over the sparkling turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea and the lush, undulating countryside that defines this part of the island. Offering an unparalleled combination of privacy, luxury, and an enviable location, Villa Brielle is the ultimate destination for those looking to experience the best of Ibiza.

The light-filled interiors of the villa are a true masterpiece, blending modern luxuries and high-tech features with a calming, contemporary style. Designed with impeccable attention to detail, each room is beautifully appointed to create a harmonious environment where guests can unwind and relax. The airy, open-plan living areas flow effortlessly from one space to the next, creating a welcoming atmosphere throughout. The villa is designed to make the most of its stunning natural surroundings, with expansive windows allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the interiors and offering sweeping views of the surrounding landscape. The spacious living and dining areas are perfect for both intimate gatherings and larger groups, while a dedicated breakfast room provides a cozy spot to start the day. The modern, fully equipped kitchen is a chef’s dream, with state-of-the-art appliances and ample space for preparing gourmet meals.

The villa’s tranquil, neutral color palette extends seamlessly into the bedrooms, creating serene retreats for every guest. The main villa’s entrance level is home to the spacious and opulent Master bedroom, which is a true sanctuary. This expansive room boasts not one, but two en-suite bathrooms—one featuring a luxurious shower, the other with a relaxing bathtub—ensuring ultimate comfort and convenience. Adjacent to the Master bedroom is Bedroom 2, a charming twin room, with a sleek shower room just across the hall. Both rooms are flooded with natural light, offering guests a restful environment in which to relax and rejuvenate.

Descending to the lower level, you will find two additional spacious bedrooms—Bedrooms 3 and 4. These double rooms can be configured as either twin beds or double beds (each 90x2) to accommodate different preferences. Both rooms have their own en-suite bathrooms, which include a shower, sink area, and a shared toilet located just over the hall, providing a perfect setup for families or friends traveling together. These bedrooms offer a private and peaceful retreat, complete with ample space and natural light.

In addition to the main villa, Villa Brielle also features two separate annexes, each with its own private entrance. These annexes offer an extra layer of privacy and flexibility, making them ideal for guests seeking a bit more space and independence. Bedrooms 5 and 6 are both comfortable double rooms, which can also be arranged as twin rooms (2 x single beds, each 90x2), and each room comes with its own en-suite bathroom. These annexes provide the perfect escape for guests looking to enjoy a more secluded experience, while still being able to enjoy the luxurious amenities of the main house.

Set within vast, perfectly landscaped grounds, Villa Brielle is surrounded by an array of tropical plants, palm trees, and manicured lawns, creating a serene and private environment. The expansive outdoor spaces offer an abundance of options for relaxation, entertainment, and outdoor living. The highlight of the grounds is the stunning infinity pool, which seems to merge seamlessly with the horizon, offering panoramic views of the sparkling sea and the lush landscape. The villa’s outdoor spaces are designed to maximize comfort and enjoyment, with multiple terraces, shaded lounging areas, and soft-seated chill-out spots scattered throughout the garden. A beautiful sunset-facing al-fresco dining area provides the perfect setting for enjoying meals while taking in the world-renowned Ibizan sunset, one of the island's most iconic and spectacular sights.

Villa Brielle is perfectly positioned to enjoy the captivating beauty of Ibiza’s west coast sunsets. As the sun sets over the horizon, the sky is transformed into a vibrant canvas of colors, creating a magical atmosphere that must be seen to be believed. The villa’s prime location offers guests the unique opportunity to experience this breathtaking natural spectacle from the comfort of their own villa, whether they are lounging by the pool, dining al-fresco, or relaxing in one of the many cozy garden chill-out areas.

From its luxurious interiors to its expansive grounds and stunning views, Villa Brielle offers a truly luxurious setting for those seeking to unwind and indulge in the best of Ibiza. Whether you're spending the day by the pool, enjoying an evening sunset, or simply relaxing in one of the villa’s many peaceful spaces, this exquisite property provides everything you need for an unforgettable holiday experience.

name: Villa Centelleo
tagline: A supremely stylish villa with fabulous sea views
summary: Villa Centelleo is an exceptionally stylish mountain top property, perfectly secluded in the hillsides of San Jose, with spectacular views of the Mediterranean Sea and the exquisite beaches of Salinas, Formentera, Cala…
description: Villa Centelleo is an exceptionally stylish mountain top property, perfectly secluded in the hillsides of San Jose, with spectacular views of the Mediterranean Sea and the exquisite beaches of Salinas, Formentera, Cala Jondal and Porroig.

This modern home is defined by its opulent furniture and furnishings and comes complete with a spacious and luxurious open plan lounge, formal dining area, a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and an in-house entertainment system. The excellent attention to details and incredibly well designed interior makes this house truly stand out.

All of the six bedrooms follow the theme of sublime sophistication, with tasteful and admirable artworks, soft furnishings and decoration. Each offers guests the privacy of an en-suite bathroom and direct terrace access.

The pristine gardens and surrounding terraces are delightfully lined with several waterfalls and an incredible infinity pool from where you can marvel at the views of the sparkling sea and breathtaking coastline. The elegant sun terrace and swimming pool area is complemented with an array of sun-loungers and chill-out beds as well as an under-covered al fresco dining space and gas barbecue. At night the lights of Ibiza come to life making it the perfect setting for entertaining special guests.

name: Villa Charo
tagline: Tasteful home in a tranquil countryside with distant sea and sunset views
summary:
Villa Charo is a stunning countryside villa situated in the heart of the island on a 4-hectare plot providing loads of privacy and peace. 
This six-bedroom property is made to suit the Mediterranean climate with many…
description:
Villa Charo is a stunning countryside villa situated in the heart of the island on a 4-hectare plot providing loads of privacy and peace. 
This six-bedroom property is made to suit the Mediterranean climate with many sun-drenched or shaded chill-out areas, a fully fitted outdoor kitchen, a lounge corner, and, situated a few more meters away- a sunset view chillout area, perfect for an evening cocktail while enjoying a spectacular sunset ceremony.

Inside, the tasteful decor features natural materials like wood and stone and blends with the highest quality furnishings and fittings. The living room that features a TV corner opens up to the dining area and a fully equipped kitchen. From the kitchen door, you can access another shaded sitting area and garden. Four spacious suites are located in the main house, one of them with additional external access. Two more ample and tasteful suites are located in the lower grounds across the pool area. Each of the bedrooms is equipped with a safety box and an alarm. The property is fully air-conditioned and has ceiling fans too, including a fan in the outdoor lounge. The sparkling mosaic pool invites for a refreshing dip followed by a tanning session or a break under one of the parasols. The pool can also be heated on request in the cooler months.

Villa Charo is perfect for family groups with loads of grounds for children to play, a basketball hoop and a tennis table. 
The guests will enjoy the tranquility of the area while being a short drive away from the village of San Rafael with some of the best restaurants on the island including Coto and El Clodenis. The central location of the property will allow the guests to reach all main towns: Santa Gertrudis, Ibiza Town and San Antonio in a 10 minutes ride.

At the heart of the villa lies a magnificent 12m x 4.5m private pool, framed by tall palms, fragrant pines and serene woodland views. Landscaped gardens, secluded terraces and luxurious chill-out areas invite long, languid days in the Mediterranean sun. On the upper terrace, an al fresco dining table for up to 12 guests sets the stage for unforgettable dinners beneath Ibiza’s legendary sunsets and star-filled skies.

Inside, light-filled living spaces combine contemporary elegance with breathtaking views. The lounge opens onto a private balcony with direct access to the pool terrace, while the dining room offers a sophisticated setting for entertaining. description: Villa Ivy is the ultimate 6 bedroom Mediterranean escape. Cala Tarida is just a few minutes stroll away with its famed Cotton Beach Club restaurant and a short drive will bring you to the charming village of San Jose.

Inside Villa Ivy cool cottons and bleached wood create a contemporary coastal ambiance perfectly complemented by chic, contemporary furniture, artwork and lighting. description: Villa Katherine is a sophisticated and stylish 6-bedroom property offering breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea and the picturesque hillside of San José, nestled in a private and secluded location. This modern villa, located on the west side of the island, is spread across three individual buildings, making it the perfect retreat for families or groups of friends. The superb location provides easy access to some of Ibiza's most stunning beaches, including Cala Vadella, Cala Bassa, Cala Comte, and Cala Tarida.

The main house is spread over two floors and is designed with sleek, contemporary décor and natural wooden finishes. On the ground floor, you’ll find a spacious open-plan living and dining area flooded with natural light, offering panoramic sea and coastline views. The modern, fully equipped kitchen includes all the essential appliances for your convenience. This area flows out to a large, sun-drenched terrace with a sublime outdoor dining space, perfect for enjoying meals while taking in the surrounding beauty.

The ground floor also features the master bedroom, a double room with an en-suite bathroom, which opens onto a private terrace with stunning sea views. Upstairs, there are two additional bedrooms—a twin and a double—both with sea views and sharing a bathroom.

Adjacent to the main house, the poolside casita offers two bedrooms, one twin and one double, each with its own en-suite bathroom. A lower casita provides a double bedroom with an en-suite bathroom. Both casitas feature separate living spaces and private outdoor terraces equipped with beautiful Balinese day beds, providing an extra level of privacy for those seeking a tranquil retreat.

The lush, well-maintained grounds of Villa Katherine are a true highlight. The magnificent swimming pool is surrounded by luxurious sun loungers, offering an ideal spot to relax while enjoying Ibiza's famous sunsets. The spacious terrace is complete with a stylish chill-out area and shaded dining space, providing the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining or simply unwinding with family and friends.

description: Villa Larish is a spacious and beautifully curated Mediterranean residence where Ibiza’s energy meets the warm, earthy spirit of Tulum. Every corner of the property reflects a refined sense of design, comfort, and natural textures, creating an atmosphere that immediately feels inviting. With capacity for up to 16 guests, the villa is ideal for families, retreat groups, or friends looking for a central and private hideaway without sacrificing style.
Design & Indoor Living

The interior of Villa Larish has been designed with great care. The villa features six uniquely decorated bedrooms, each with a generous wardrobe and air conditioning that can cool or heat, making the property perfect for stays throughout the year. The master bedroom includes a private ensuite bathroom, while three additional bathrooms serve the remaining rooms with elegance and convenience.
The top floor offers two extra bedrooms and a second relaxation space complete with a fireplace and direct access to a large terrace overlooking the surrounding nature.

On the ground floor, guests will find a welcoming living room filled with cosy seating corners, natural elements, and a stylish fireplace. A long dining table creates the perfect setting for shared meals, complemented by a fully equipped kitchen that also includes an additional dining area.
Next to the kitchen, a dedicated billiard room adds an entertaining social hub for late-night games and relaxed gatherings.
Outdoor Spaces & Pool

Villa Larish truly shines outdoors. The property features several terraces, each designed to capture the Mediterranean sun at different times of the day. The atmosphere is calm, lush, and laid-back, with tropical plants and Bali-inspired décor creating the perfect environment for slow mornings and sunset cocktails.

The main terrace includes a robust outdoor dining table, shaded lounge areas, and a BBQ station ideal for long summer dinners. The outdoor chill-out area, complete with a Bali bed, invites guests to disconnect and unwind.
The highlight of the exterior is the large swimming pool, surrounded by comfortable sun loungers and natural parasols. Whether for refreshing morning swims, sunny afternoons, or peaceful evening stargazing, the pool area delivers a true Ibiza experience.
Location & Convenience

Perfectly positioned in San Rafael, Villa Larish offers exceptional access to the island. It sits between iconic clubs like Amnesia and UNVRS, and is less than 15 minutes from both the west coast beaches (such as Cala Gració) and the southeast coastline (including Talamanca). Ibiza Town is only an 8-minute drive away, and the airport approximately 10 minutes.
The villa includes private parking inside the property and additional free parking on the street, making it practical and comfortable for groups renting multiple vehicles.

name: Villa Lino
tagline: The perfect private hideaway in nature
summary: This large superb villa is spread across 574 square meters on a beautiful corner plot of over 35000 square meters (8 acres) of woodland and forest. 100% privacy is guaranteed, and the villas unique build design which…
description: This large superb villa is spread across 574 square meters on a beautiful corner plot of over 35000 square meters (8 acres) of woodland and forest. 100% privacy is guaranteed, and the villas unique build design which drops over numerous levels down to the pool area, is perfect for either large families or a number of friends to stay here together. Located within walking distance of the Atzaro Agroturismo the villa is surrounded by wonderful nature on all sides, and one can also benefit from the facilities in Atzaro such as the spa, gym, pool and restaurant, making this a perfect for a quiet family or friends getaway.

In the main house there are 6 large double bedrooms in the main house, all with ensuite bathrooms and 5 of the bedrooms have separate private outdoor patio areas with outdoor showers. Guests enter the villa through huge wooden doors into an extremely spacious reception area, and the large living room to the left. Also to the left is the equally large fully equipped open plan kitchen, which looks across the indoor and outdoor areas out to the pool area.

The centerpiece of the living room/entertaining area is a large open log fire (for the rare chilly winter nights only of course!), and surrounding the whole living area are floor to ceiling windows and sliding doors leading out onto the terrace for outdoor dining and chilling out. This large outdoor terrace, with huge dining table that seats at least 12 people comfortably, plus a separate corner of sofas and a drinks table, runs along the length of the living area, and overlooks the pool area from an elevated spot, which when lit up during the evening creates a beautiful ambiance whilst dining.

There are 3 double bedrooms on the ground floor, one of which is a separate master suite area, leading off from the kitchen area, with a courtyard and office space area. The other 3 double bedrooms can be found on the right hand side of the villa leading down to the pool area, almost hotel style in it´s design.

The villa surrounds the pool area like a glove, and the outdoor areas are equally spacious, with the huge pool measuring 123 square meters with its own changing rooms, toilet and shower along with a separate covered BBQ, and rest area. There is an 800 meter running track around the house and through the woods and an enchanting grassy area for playing football or sports.

It cannot be stressed enough how perfect this villa and it´s outdoor areas are for relaxing tranquil family and friends holidays, hidden away in the woods but also close to the second largest town on the island, Santa Eulalia. Guests never come away disappointed!

Also there are 3 staff included in any rental - the villa manager/housekeeper, the gardener and a swimming pool maintenance man. Cleaning included is 3 hours every day Monday to Saturday in the Summer months May to September and she does a complete linen and towel change every Wednesday.
The property is open to hosting smaller scale events, weddings and gatherings upon request.
LOCATION - CENTRAL in Morna Valley
Recommended Beaches : The beauty of being in the centre of the island is that most of the beaches are no more than a 15 minute drive away.

The heart of the island is spread across and between four of its towns, running from San Rafael in the southern part, through Santa Gertrudis and San Lorenzo, across to Santa Eulalia on the North East coast. Virtually all of the beaches are less than half an hour’s drive away.

Each of these towns has their own characteristics and identity, and of course gastronomic feasts galore, with the San Juan road which links them and is effectively the spine of the island, being known as ‘Restaurant Road’. This 7-8 km stretch of modernized road hosts none other than at least 10 must-try eateries, serving up anything from Mediterranean fusion and Thai, to Italian, Japanese and traditional Ibicenco fare. Pristine white washed churches, local schools, farms, and orange groves stretch across the Morna Valley, together with historic ruins and numerous Agroturismo hotels.

Of the four towns, Santa Gertrudis is perhaps the most picturesque to tourists and locals alike , growing hugely in popularity over the last few years or so with Northern Europeans moving to Ibiza for the sun and relaxed island life, but also wanting to stay a little bit apart from the slightly more hedonistic south. Centered around a beautiful square surrounded by bars, restaurants, auction houses, and sports facilities, and just two minutes from the rapidly growing UK private school Morna International College, Santa Gertrudis provides a busy yet relaxed and positive vibe 365 days a year. Santa Eulalia is the second largest town in Ibiza, almost as bustling in the Winter as it is in the Summer, with its own W hotel, theatre and festival centre, cinema, and all mod cons expected of a major town, as well as it´s own highly rated beaches.

description: Set within 30,000 square metres of private grounds, Villa Margo is a magnificent six-bedroom estate where two centuries of history meet contemporary luxury. This lovingly restored 200-year-old farmhouse is arranged as two distinct yet harmoniously connected houses, with breathtaking views across the Mediterranean, the UNESCO-protected Ses Salinas Natural Park and the shores of Formentera. Secluded and serene, it is also just minutes from the airport and the island’s most coveted beaches, including Salinas and Es Cavallet.

The main house pairs rustic character with sleek, modern design. Sunlit living spaces are furnished with sumptuous lounging areas, a pool table and a stylish bar, while the bright, contemporary kitchen is perfect for anything from relaxed family meals to dinners prepared by a private chef. For truly unforgettable evenings, the estate boasts its own private nightclub, complete with a state-of-the-art sound system, DJ booth and dynamic lighting, available by prior arrangement.

The master suite occupies its own 300-square-metre casita, a private sanctuary with a grand round bed, a lavish en-suite bathroom, a dedicated massage room and a private terrace overlooking the infinity pool, with sweeping views of Formentera and the Salinas salt flats. Five further double bedrooms, three of them en-suite, are elegantly spread across both houses, offering every guest comfort and privacy.

Outdoors, the grounds unfold like a Mediterranean paradise. The infinity pool takes centre stage, surrounded by manicured lawns, fragrant gardens and sun-drenched terraces. Shaded pergolas set the scene for long al fresco lunches, tranquil corners invite quiet meditation, and the club lounge, with its oversized sofas, pool table and table football, is made for laid-back afternoons.

Spend your days on the golden sands of Es Cavallet, at the glamorous beach clubs of Salinas or exploring the natural beauty of Ses Salinas, then dance the night away in Ibiza Town or at home in your own club. Villa Margo is a rare and remarkable retreat, where history, nature and indulgence come together in perfect harmony.

name: Villa Meghan

description: Located near Ibiza's south-east coast, Villa Meghan is a stunning 6 bedroom villa boasting breathtaking views of the Mediterranean sea and the picturesque beaches of Playa den Bossa, Cap des Falco, and the Las Salinas salt flats. The villa is situated on a vast expanse of private land, providing guests with ample space to relax and unwind.

This exceptional villa is elegantly furnished with a sophisticated and luxurious decor that creates a sumptuous and palatial ambiance. The main living area features cool white walls and polished concrete floors, which are complemented by inviting decor. The sleek contemporary kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances, and the formal dining room offers a peaceful view of the hacienda-style courtyard.

The villa consists of the main house and a separate guest house, with four pristine bedrooms in the former, each with a luxurious en-suite, and two large bedrooms in the latter that share a fully-equipped bathroom. Guests can also take advantage of the light-filled gym, which comes equipped with a range of exercise equipment.

Outside, Villa Meghan's exteriors are polished and sleek, with white terraces and a freshwater pool surrounded by soft lounge seating. Beyond the pool terrace, palm-filled fragrant gardens, lush lawns, and shady courtyards provide additional spaces to relax. Closer to the house, on the upper terrace, guests can enjoy alfresco dining with a barbecue while taking in the stunning sea views.

The outside space offers a large terrace and a tranquil wraparound garden, allowing privacy, and stunning garden views with a grassed area for kids to play. A large swimming pool and additional kitchen ensure this is a fabulous family friendly environment on the outskirts of Santa Eulalia.

name: Villa Nizra
tagline: An exceptional Modern Villa With Panoramic Sea Views
summary: With sweeping panoramic views over Cap des Falco and across to Formentera, and set amid lush Mediterranean vegetation, Villa Nizra is a refined Ibiza retreat offering privacy, space, and a strong connection to its…
description: With sweeping panoramic views over Cap des Falco and across to Formentera, and set amid lush Mediterranean vegetation, Villa Nizra is a refined Ibiza retreat offering privacy, space, and a strong connection to its natural surroundings. Located just a short drive from Cala Jondal, the villa enjoys one of the island’s most desirable locations, combining peaceful seclusion with easy access to Ibiza’s iconic beaches and beach clubs.

The villa’s modern architecture is defined by generous volumes throughout the living areas and bedrooms, creating a feeling of openness and comfort while maintaining privacy across the house. Large windows and terraces frame the views, allowing the natural beauty of Ibiza to flow seamlessly into the interior spaces.

Designed for true outdoor living, the property features a spectacular 20m x 9.5m infinity pool with a pool bar, an outdoor massage table, and an inviting lounge area ideal for entertaining from day to night. For guests seeking an active lifestyle, the villa offers a sea-view gym on the upper terrace, fully equipped with a boxing bag, power plate, treadmill, free weights, and Pilates and yoga accessories. Completing the experience, a brand-new padel court responds to a modern lifestyle essential, making Villa Nizra perfectly suited to both relaxation and sport. Drinkable tap water is available throughout the villa, adding an extra level of comfort to this exceptional Ibiza home.

name: Villa Paradis
tagline: A stunning restored countryside finca
summary: Villa Paradis is a typical renovated Ibizan finca over 200 years old decorated with antique pieces from India, Nepal, Tibet and Africa that give this house a special and unique combination of style. The tasteful,…
description: Villa Paradis is a typical renovated Ibizan finca over 200 years old decorated with antique pieces from India, Nepal, Tibet and Africa that give this house a special and unique combination of style. The tasteful, romantic Provencal and rustic style furnishing with all high-tech installations such as Apple TV, SONOS, WiFi, heating and air conditioning in all rooms leaves no other desire for a peaceful and relaxing holiday all year round in luxury and total comfort in the countryside.
This hillside property is East facing with a stunning view over the valley of Santa Gertrudis, virgin fields with almond and olive trees, pine forest and lush lawns.
Inside the main finca you have 2 bedrooms, the original finca style kitchen with chimney and small cosy living room and then 4 separate guest bedrooms.

The main living room with an open plan kitchen is located in the outer building between the main finca and pool area. With its three glass paneled sides, the room is bright and enjoy entertaining family and friends sweeping views over the pool and valley.

The salt water pool is located on the lower grounds and surrounded with lush lawns and places to chill and relax. You also find a covered chillout with sofas, floor cousins and coffee table next to the bar area perfect for serving refreshments while enjoying days laying and splashing around in the pool.
Enjoy the seasonal vegetables from the ecological garden and fruit trees such as oranges, lemons, clementins and apricots.

The secluded estate offers the opportunity for soul-searching, walks around the finca, the sense of freedom and of well-being in nature, the ideal environment for a recovery from our more stressful lives. A charming holiday home that will give you peace of mind and immerse you in the true spirit of Ibiza.

The sleeping arrangements:
BEDROOM 1 = Kind bed located upstairs in the old finca and has bathroom with shower.
BEDROOM 2 = Twin bedroom located on the ground floor of the finca has an ensuite bathroom with shower.

A further 4 guest bedrooms are located in the grounds with no access to the main finca. 
BEDROOM 3 = A double bed and ensuite bathroom with shower.
BEDROOM 4 = A double bed and ensuite bathroom with shower.
BEDROOM 5 = A double bed and ensuite bathroom with shower.
BEDROOM 6 = A double bed and ensuite bathroom with shower.

This property makes for a perfect holiday for families and friends and the lush gardens and grounds also make this property the perfect location for weddings and events. Cleaning included 6 days a week for 10 hours.

Location Description:
Villa Paradis is centrally located in a peaceful and secluded countryside location around a 15 minutes drive to Ibiza town, Marina Botafoch, the airport and just 3 minutes drive to the popular village of Santa Gertrudis or 10 minute walk. Centrally located you will find most beaches are within a 20 or 30 minute drive away.

name: Villa Parque
tagline: Peaceful hideway blended with luxurious lifestyle
summary: Villa Parque is a beautiful Ibizan villa located in the tranquil northern hills of the island, surrounded by lush countryside and aromatic pine forests. A peaceful hideaway with expansive views, the villa offers the…
description: Villa Parque is a beautiful Ibizan villa located in the tranquil northern hills of the island, surrounded by lush countryside and aromatic pine forests. A peaceful hideaway with expansive views, the villa offers the perfect balance of modern comfort and rustic charm. Built in the style of a traditional finca, it exudes understated elegance, with whitewashed walls, warm wood tones, and an emphasis on natural light and open living spaces that flow effortlessly between indoors and outdoors.

The villa is designed with a strong sense of privacy and space, comfortably sleeping up to twelve guests across six individually styled bedrooms. Each room features its own bathroom and opens out onto terraces or gardens, allowing guests to connect with nature from the moment they wake. The interiors are a harmonious blend of minimalist design and local character, creating a serene atmosphere ideal for relaxation.

At the heart of Villa Parque lies a spacious kitchen and dining area, perfect for social cooking and long, leisurely meals. The lounge invites you to unwind with generous seating, a fireplace, and views out to the surrounding greenery. Beyond the walls, the property reveals a stunning outdoor area with a large swimming pool, several lounging zones, and peaceful gardens full of olive trees and native plants. The pool house includes a covered outdoor kitchen and dining space, ideal for al fresco meals under the Ibizan sky.

Families and friends alike will feel at home in Villa Parque. Whether you’re soaking in the sun by the pool, exploring the nearby beaches and villages, or simply enjoying the calm of your private retreat, this villa offers an unforgettable setting for your Ibiza experience.
Pool size 18x6m

name: Villa Puma
tagline: Beautiful villa with amazing sea views in a Gated Community
summary: Located within the prestigious and secure gated community of Vista Alegre, this six-bedroom house offers a rare combination of privacy, peace of mind, and a prime location. With 24/7 monitored access and convenient…
description: Located within the prestigious and secure gated community of Vista Alegre, this six-bedroom house offers a rare combination of privacy, peace of mind, and a prime location. With 24/7 monitored access and convenient parking, it is ideally positioned just minutes from Es Cubells and San José, with Ibiza Town only a short drive away. Recently renovated, the property exudes a warm and refined modern ambiance, with six bedrooms and six bathrooms that are bathed in natural light. The interiors are tastefully decorated with high-quality materials, combining elegance and comfort throughout.

Outside, the house enjoys uninterrupted views of Formentera and sunshine from morning to evening. Whether by the inviting swimming pool, stretched out on a sunbed, or gazing at the horizon, every moment spent here carries a sense of serenity and well-being. Thoughtfully designed to provide comfort, privacy, and convivial spaces, the villa is perfect for family holidays or entertaining friends. It is a home where you feel instantly at ease, a timeless retreat embraced by the natural beauty of Ibiza.

name: Villa Reina
tagline: A 150-Year Finca Where Ibicenco Soul Meets Bohemian Grace
summary: Villa Reina is a beautiful countryside villa located just outside of the fashionable village of Santa Gertrudis which is renowned for its vibrant, trendy collection of bars and restaurants and international community.…
description: Villa Reina is a beautiful countryside villa located just outside of the fashionable village of Santa Gertrudis which is renowned for its vibrant, trendy collection of bars and restaurants and international community. The central location means you are just a short drive from all of the beautiful beaches on the island, and you have easy access to the centre of Ibiza Town with its dazzling array of nightlife venues

The Finca was build more than 150 years ago and was fully renovated recently keeping the typical "ibicenco" style. The house has been restored to carefully retain the original charm and it has a truly bohemian chic ambience throughout, which each room boasting its own unique style and character. The eclectic feel is artfully blended with modern day luxuries to ensure your every need is catered for. Spacious living areas are drenched in natural sunlight and there are plenty of quiet corners where you can kick back and relax after another perfect Ibizan day, The living and dining areas are served by a modern and well-equipped kitchen which is complete with all the state-of-the-art appliance you would expect.

The main villa has 6 double bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, there are plenty outdoor places to sit and enjoy the sun, a swimming pool, different terraces with amazing view, ideal at sunrise and moonrise. The indoor yoga shala has a smooth wooden floor and is heated for spring and autumn, and in the summer you can enjoy your practise at the outside wooden deck.

The peaceful grounds offer guests plenty of exterior spots to relax and soak up the surrounding landscapes. The pool terrace has a large daybed, alfresco dining area for entertaining and numerous secluded, shaded spots with comfy seated furnishings under the trees to relax . Villa Reina is a contemporary property with beautifully designed spaces both inside and out.

The prices include a “refreshment cleaning” in the midweek, the final cleaning upon check-out as well as water and electricity consumption, unlimited drinking water, high speed Wi-Fi throughout the properties (Befree), Netflix access, laundry facilities, pool towels.

tagline: An exquisitely designed modern villa in Vista Alegre
summary: Located in the desirable urbanization of Vista Alegre, Villa Serenity is an exquisite contemporary villa featuring six spacious suites and stunning island views across the turquoise sea. With 24-hour security, this…
description: Located in the desirable urbanization of Vista Alegre, Villa Serenity is an exquisite contemporary villa featuring six spacious suites and stunning island views across the turquoise sea. With 24-hour security, this gated development is an ideal base for exploring nearby beaches such as Cala Jondal, Es Xarco, and Cala D'Hort.

Inside, the villa boasts stylish interiors of a classic contemporary design and polished finishes. The living room and modern kitchen open up directly onto the poolside terrace, creating an abundance of natural light that floods through the floor-to-ceiling sliding doors.

One of the most unique features of Villa Serenity is the indoor pool space, complete with a private treatment spa area and a relaxing chill-out zone. 
Each bedroom is furnished to the highest standards, with a king-size bed and en-suite bathroom. The master suite offers a jacuzzi bathtub with uninterrupted panoramic views of the sparkling sea.
The Master bedroom along with bedrooms 2 & 3 are located on the top floor.
Bedroom 4 is located at the main entrance level and bedrooms 5 & 6 are located on the lower level. All the bedrooms are En-Suite.

Step out onto the elegantly decked terrace, where the contemporary chi style continues, and spend the day poolside with ample sun loungers and daybeds. An alfresco dining area offers the perfect place to entertain friends from sunrise to sundown. Villa Serenity is quite simply a minimalist paradise in one of Ibiza's most sought-after areas.
The gym also features technogym equipment, sonos an exterior bbq kitchen and secure off street parking for 4 cars.
Cleaning is included for 6 hours per dar day, 6 days per week. (Not on Sundays)

name: Villa Serenya
tagline: Beautiful villa near San Carlos with large pool, BBQ, outdoor kitchen, garden and yoga hall
summary: Villa Serenya is an authentic Ibizan rural estate set in the heart of the Morna Valley, near San Carlos and San Lorenzo. Originally a farmhouse with more than 300 years of history, the property retains the timeless…
description: Villa Serenya is an authentic Ibizan rural estate set in the heart of the Morna Valley, near San Carlos and San Lorenzo. Originally a farmhouse with more than 300 years of history, the property retains the timeless character of traditional Ibiza architecture combined with modern-day comfort.

Positioned within an expansive 90,000 m² private plot, the villa offers exceptional privacy and open countryside views. The estate consists of a main house and a separate annex, comfortably accommodating up to 12 guests. All bedrooms are equipped with air conditioning, while many preserve original wooden ceilings, reinforcing the villa’s historic charm.

The interiors include a traditional Ibizan kitchen featuring a distinctive Sabina wood ceiling and full equipment for extended stays. Two separate living rooms provide varied living spaces: a smaller, cosy lounge and a larger main living area that naturally connects with the outdoor terraces.
OUTDOOR LIVING

The outdoor spaces are designed for relaxed rural living. At the front of the property, a 13 m x 5 m infinity-edge swimming pool overlooks the surrounding countryside. The pool area includes nine sun loungers and a spacious daybed. A large covered dining and seating area provides welcome shade during the warmest hours and features generous Balinese-style sofas, creating an ideal setting for entertaining or quiet relaxation. A barbecue area completes the outdoor experience.
SETTING & GROUNDS

The mature gardens form a private oasis with a mix of Mediterranean landscaping, including palm trees, cacti, flowering plants, and areas of lush lawn. The scale of the grounds and natural environment create a peaceful, secluded atmosphere while remaining within convenient reach of Ibiza’s northern villages and beaches.
CONFIGURATION

• Main house: 4 bedrooms
 – Two bedrooms with en suite bathrooms
 – Two bedrooms sharing one bathroom
• Annex: 2 bedrooms
 – One shared bathroom
• Total capacity: 12 guests

name: Villa Solvista
tagline: Stunning reformed villa with fantastic sea and sunset views
summary: Perched high above the picturesque village of San Agustín, Villa Solvista commands one of the most privileged vantage points on the island of Ibiza. From this elevated sanctuary, panoramic views stretch across verdant…
description: Perched high above the picturesque village of San Agustín, Villa Solvista commands one of the most privileged vantage points on the island of Ibiza. From this elevated sanctuary, panoramic views stretch across verdant pine forests to the shimmering Mediterranean Sea, where the horizon melts into endless skies of deep blue by day and fiery hues by dusk. Every evening, nature puts on a show as timeless sunsets bathe the landscape in golden light—a daily ritual that feels both sacred and surreal.

This traditional Ibicencan finca has been lovingly restored and thoughtfully modernised, preserving its authentic architectural charm while introducing sleek contemporary comforts. Thick whitewashed walls, wooden beamed ceilings, and hand-crafted details blend seamlessly with state-of-the-art amenities, creating a refined harmony between rustic heritage and modern luxury.

With 6 spacious bedrooms accommodating up to 10 guests, Villa Solvista is perfectly suited for large families, groups of friends, or retreat-style gatherings seeking privacy, serenity, and space. Each bedroom is a tranquil haven, with carefully curated interiors and restful views. The master suite, a standout sanctuary within the home, offers an indoor Jacuzzi and sweeping vistas over Ibiza’s coastline—an indulgent space for pure relaxation.

Outside, the villa is a celebration of Mediterranean outdoor living. Framed by lush, perfectly maintained gardens and ancient olive trees, the expansive swimming pool invites long, sun-drenched afternoons under clear, cobalt skies. The al fresco dining terrace and barbecue area are ideal for lingering meals, laughter-filled evenings, and entertaining under the stars. Every corner of the grounds is designed to offer peace, beauty, and a deep connection with nature.

Whether you're lounging in the sun, meditating beneath the pines, or watching the sky turn shades of amber and rose, Villa Solvista offers a rare and unforgettable Ibiza experience—where timeless natural beauty meets understated elegance and absolute comfort.

name: Villa Sylvia
tagline: Clifftop hacienda with direct cove access and 180° sunset views
summary:
Perched on the cliffs above Cala Moli, this six-bedroom hacienda commands an unbroken 180-degree arc of coastline — turquoise water below, the western horizon burning amber each evening. 
Built across two levels, the…
description:
Perched on the cliffs above Cala Moli, this six-bedroom hacienda commands an unbroken 180-degree arc of coastline — turquoise water below, the western horizon burning amber each evening. 
Built across two levels, the architecture moves between authentic Ibizan character and clean contemporary lines, with open-plan living spaces that draw the eye outward at every turn. A private path leads directly down to a secluded cove, where the sea is yours alone. 
As the day softens, the terrace becomes the finest seat on the island — cocktail in hand, the famous Ibizan sunset performing its nightly ritual just for you. For larger parties, a separate staff villa is available on request, ensuring the household runs entirely on its own terms. 
This is Ibiza at its most privileged: wild coastline, complete privacy, and a home that wears its elegance without effort.

name: Villa Terra Blanca
tagline: Luxury Private Finca with Pool & Countryside Views
summary: Set in a peaceful corner of the Ibizan countryside, Villa Terra Blanca is a beautiful traditional finca, lovingly restored to balance authentic island character with contemporary comfort. Whitewashed walls, warm…
description: Set in a peaceful corner of the Ibizan countryside, Villa Terra Blanca is a beautiful traditional finca, lovingly restored to balance authentic island character with contemporary comfort. Whitewashed walls, warm terracotta and stone floors, exposed wooden beams and sun-filled terraces frame sweeping views over the island's wooded hills.

Sleeping up to 12 guests across six individually styled bedrooms — four with private en-suite bathrooms — the villa is an ideal retreat for families, groups of friends, or anyone marking a special occasion on the White Isle. At its heart is a light-filled open-plan living and dining area with handsome antique and contemporary furnishings, opening onto the gardens, alongside a fully equipped kitchen made for cooking with the island's finest local produce.

Outdoors is where Villa Terra Blanca comes alive. A large private pool takes centre stage, framed by a spacious sun terrace with loungers and parasols for relaxed afternoons in the sun. A shaded terrace and BBQ area invite easy alfresco dining, while the beautifully landscaped gardens offer a real sense of seclusion. The villa enjoys an accessible setting close to local roads, so guests may notice some gentle passing traffic at times — a small trade-off for its convenient location and the wider grounds that surround it.

With air conditioning and ceiling fans in the living spaces, comfortable heating throughout, high-speed Wi-Fi, private parking for several vehicles, and the option of bespoke concierge services, Villa Terra Blanca offers a relaxed and memorable escape that captures the essence of Ibiza.

name: Villa Tuscany
tagline: Luxury and Privacy in a gated community
summary: We find this perfect example of luxury and privacy in Roca Llisa urbanization, just a pleasant 15 minutes drive from Ibiza town. The property expands around a large plot with several buildings composing the living and…
description: We find this perfect example of luxury and privacy in Roca Llisa urbanization, just a pleasant 15 minutes drive from Ibiza town. The property expands around a large plot with several buildings composing the living and leisure areas. Its position, on top of the forest hill dominating the urbanization’s central/south side of the urbanization, ensures privacy, stunning sea views, tranquility and security.

In the central building we find the main living areas, all facing the impressive views through its large infinity pool, its excellently maintained Mediterranean gardens and its several terraces offering many different options to relax, dine or celebrate due to its top equipment and facilities. In this central house, we will enjoy the large dining room, the living room with its bar and lounge areas (indoors and ooutdoors), the TV/cinema room with its fireplace and enormous sofas and chaisse-longues, the main kitchen with professional and state of the art equipment and the master bedroom with its complete bathroom and dressing room en-suite. In the back entrance we find a double bedroom, a bathroom and a staff office/kitchenette that can also be used by guests to have a quiet breakfast.

The backyard patios lead to the different annexes such as two guest apartments and two double suites. They all also enjoying their bathrooms en-suite. Everything here is designed to maximize guests privacy.

At the western side of the main house, also facing the unspoilt sea views, we find the Spa building. In here the most demanding will not miss a single detail. Its massage room, its top of the range gym with pilates and fitness equipment, its separate wet area with its steam bath, hammam, sauna and hot tub, are all illuminated to ensure relax and concentration. The whole facility is a haven for those seeking to pamper themselves duringt their Ibiza vacations. With no doubt we can say it is one of the best you can find on a private Ibiza residence.
In one of the corners of the complex we find the staff house where the house manager and her team reside all year round to ensure the house is in perfect condition 24/7.

Outdoors, designers of the complex clearly focused on profiting the privileged situation of the property. In the top area, in front of the main house, its lawn areas and terraces surrounded by green and blue create a perfect privacy atmosfear. You never have the sensation to be located inside a large urbanization. In one of its sides we find a pergola with a big round dining table capable to host every guest on a fresh summer night. In the lower terraces we discover a relaxing jacuzzi area in one corner, with its hammocks and equipment. In the lower terraces we find a summer kitchen and barbecue, with complete equipment, grills and ovens to prepare the perfect evening event for a large number of guests. In tis lower side we find a cozy firepit corner to chill-out outdoors all yera round. In this same area we also find some large terraces which would be the ideal location to host events such as weddings or celebrations.
The two parking areas by the two different accesses to the complex offer the possibility to keep safely a large number of vehicles.

- Living room with personalized bar corner, opening to the covered terrace with its lounge and living area
- Main indoors dining room with table for 12 guests
- Fully equipped professional kitchen
- TV/cinema room with fireplace
- Master bedroom with full bathroom en-suite, dressing room, fireplace and terrace
- Double bedroom with twin beds, terrace and bathroom en-suite
- Staff office/kitchenette with breakfast table and terrace

- Two double suites with en-suite bathroom and covered terrace
- “White” apartment with its living area, terrace and bathroom en-suite
- Impressive Spa and gym building with separated fitness, wet and massage rooms enjoying the unique sea views
- Staff quarters, with independent access and service area

Outdoors
- Large rounded infinity pool with lounge and sunbathing area facing the Mediterranean sea
- Beautiful and excellently maintained Mediterranean gardens and lawn areas
- Al-fresco dining area with round table for all guests by the main house living area
- Front side covered living room extension
- Jacuzzi corner with sun loungers
- Outdoors kitchen with large dining table, pizza/bbq oven and grills
- Open air fireyard with chill-out
- Large open terraces facing the views perfect to host events and celebrations
- Open parking space for several cars by the west entrance to the complex

Special features
- All bedrooms en-suite, with independent access and terrace
- Discretion and tranquility due to its privileged location
- Dedicated and professional staff on-site
- Impressive spa and fitness facilities
- Excellently prepared and open for bookings, events and celebrations all year round
- Top equipment, service and decoration
- Facilities designed to maximize privacy while enjoying its great outdoors possibilities
- No neighbours closeby besides being located inside a large urbanization
