name: Villa Vanessa
tagline: Outstanding property minutes from Ibiza Town
summary: Set within a breathtaking 16,500-square-meter estate, Villa Vanessa is a private escape that invites you to unwind, connect, and celebrate life’s finest moments. Surrounded by lush gardens, colorful blooms, and…
description: Set within a breathtaking 16,500-square-meter estate, Villa Vanessa is a private escape that invites you to unwind, connect, and celebrate life’s finest moments. Surrounded by lush gardens, colorful blooms, and panoramic views, this 6-bedroom haven offers the perfect retreat for families or groups of friends seeking tranquility, luxury, and privacy in equal measure.

Inside, the villa’s over 500 square meters of beautifully refurbished living space exude effortless elegance. Contemporary designer furnishings are paired with authentic Ibizan touches—vibrant art, wood-beamed ceilings, and natural textures—to create a warm and stylish ambiance. Spacious common areas, sunlit lounges, and cozy corners provide room for both celebration and quiet reflection.

The villa features a gourmet Valcucine kitchen, ideal for culinary adventures, while the multiple-level living areas and panoramic dining space make entertaining a joy. The six serene bedrooms, some with garden or terrace access, are filled with natural light and boast luxurious en-suite or shared bathrooms, ensuring every guest experiences comfort and rest.
INDOOR

Villa Vanessa welcomes you into a world of sophistication and relaxation. The interior is thoughtfully designed with colorful, chic furnishings and inviting wood-beamed ceilings. Multi-level living areas create versatile spaces to unwind—from a sunny reading nook to a cozy lounge with a fireplace. The spacious dining area overlooks the scenic countryside, perfect for shared meals and lively conversations.

A fully equipped Valcucine kitchen stands ready for gourmet creations. Across three levels, the villa's six bedrooms are bright and elegant, with plush double beds and luxurious en-suite or shared bathrooms. Some rooms offer direct access to the garden or terraces, ideal for catching a peaceful sunset or morning breeze.
Four of the en-suite bedrooms feature double beds, while two rooms that share a bathroom can be arranged as twins or doubles, providing flexibility for families or groups.
OUTDOOR

Villa Vanessa’s expansive outdoor areas are designed for both relaxation and entertainment. A stone stairway leads to the stunning pool terrace, where a nearly 80 sqm swimming pool with a child-safe automatic cover invites sun-soaked lounging. The adjacent outdoor pool kitchen includes a fridge, bar-side seating, a gas BBQ, daybeds, and a poolside shower—perfect for casual meals and cocktail hours.

Beyond the pool area, you'll find an olive garden, fruit trees, a children's play zone, trampoline, and a football field for active fun. Challenge friends or family to a friendly match at the table tennis area, then wind down in the outdoor cinema, where evenings come alive under the stars.
To top it off, the villa’s rooftop chill-out zone offers a gazebo, plush lounge furniture, and panoramic views of Ibiza’s rolling hills—a perfect place to enjoy sunset drinks from the outdoor bar.
LOCATION

Nestled in a scenic valley in south-east Ibiza and surrounded by Mediterranean fan palms and pine trees, Villa Vanessa enjoys both natural seclusion and convenient access to the island's best attractions. A variety of beautiful beaches and coves—such as Cala Llenya, Cala Llonga, Cala Olivera, Cala Martina, Cala Nova, and Cala San Vicente—are just minutes away.

Santa Eulalia del Rio: approx. 6.5 KM
Ibiza Town: approx. 11 KM
Ibiza Airport: approx. 17.5 KM
Heated pool available on request (additional fee applies).

name: Villa Wendy
tagline: Rustic stone, green hills, and the sea at Es Cubells
summary:
Set among the terraced hillsides of Es Cubells, Villa Wendy commands some of southern Ibiza's most coveted sea views — the kind that stretch past Formentera and hold your gaze long after sunset. 
The architecture is…
description:
Set among the terraced hillsides of Es Cubells, Villa Wendy commands some of southern Ibiza's most coveted sea views — the kind that stretch past Formentera and hold your gaze long after sunset. 
The architecture is rooted in the island's vernacular: hand-cut stone walls, traditional wooden beams, and thick-set arches that keep the interiors cool and quiet even in high summer. Inside, six king-bedded rooms are finished to a high standard, each balancing rustic character with contemporary comfort. Open-plan living spaces spill naturally toward the outdoors, where lush gardens and a private pool sit against a backdrop of rolling countryside. 
Cala Jondal, Porroig, and the clifftop charm of Es Cubells village are all within easy reach, making this a rare base that feels genuinely remote without sacrificing convenience. Pour something cold, take a seat on the terrace, and let the view do the rest.

name: Villa Xantara
tagline: Beautiful villa near Sant Carles with large pool, BBQ, garden and panoramic views of the Morna Valley
summary: Villa Xantara is a beautifully restored traditional Ibizan finca set within an expansive rural plot of approximately 30,000 m² in the Morna Valley. The property enjoys a peaceful countryside setting, positioned near…
description: Villa Xantara is a beautifully restored traditional Ibizan finca set within an expansive rural plot of approximately 30,000 m² in the Morna Valley. The property enjoys a peaceful countryside setting, positioned near Atzaró Agroturismo and conveniently located between Sant Llorenç de Balàfia and Sant Carles de Peralta, home to the well-known Las Dalias artisan market.

The villa preserves its authentic architectural character while offering the comfort expected of a high-standard holiday residence. Natural materials, warm tones, wooden ceilings, and a combination of traditional features with carefully selected furnishings define the atmosphere throughout the home.

The property offers six air-conditioned bedrooms, all individually styled, each with an en-suite bathroom and TV with satellite channels. Two bedrooms are located on the first floor, while four bedrooms are situated on the ground floor. One of the ground floor bedrooms benefits from an independent external entrance while remaining adjoined to the main house, providing additional privacy for guests.
Four bedrooms are arranged with double beds, while two bedrooms feature twin beds that may be configured as doubles upon request, offering flexibility for different group compositions.

The traditional kitchen is fully equipped and showcases classic finca elements including a wooden ceiling, seating area, and fireplace. The kitchen connects directly to a covered outdoor dining area where a brick-built charcoal barbecue creates a natural gathering space for meals and entertaining. The living and dining areas follow a semi open-plan layout, combining contemporary comfort with original features such as exposed textures and rustic detailing.
OUTDOOR AREAS

Outdoor living is central to the experience of Villa Xantara. The swimming pool (10 m x 5 m) is positioned to overlook the surrounding valley, providing open views across the lush landscape. The pool area is equipped with loungers and parasols, creating a comfortable setting for daytime relaxation.

A shaded chill-out area with Balinese-style day beds offers a tranquil retreat beside the pool, while a dedicated dining space at one end of the terrace allows for outdoor meals in a natural setting. Within the landscaped gardens, an additional relaxation area with a large day bed provides further space for quiet moments and privacy.

Surrounded by nature and designed for comfort, Villa Xantara offers a serene countryside environment ideal for guests seeking an authentic Ibiza finca experience combined with space, views, and seclusion.

name: Can Harley
tagline: A 200-year-old hilltop finca, where the bay meets the horizon
summary: Can Harley is a 6 double bedroom finca farmhouse which has been listed for its architectural merit and is one of the oldest houses on the island. This wonderful villa has recently been lovingly renovated, maintaining…
description: Can Harley is a 6 double bedroom finca farmhouse which has been listed for its architectural merit and is one of the oldest houses on the island. This wonderful villa has recently been lovingly renovated, maintaining its original features and authentic style as a traditional Ibicencan home, which offers a true Ibizan experience for up to 11 guests. Located close to the village of San Rafael and the vibrant resort of San Antonio, it also gives easy access to the world famous sunset beaches of the south.

The exceptional interiors offer hard wood beamed ceilings, original stone built and exposed walls and traditional cement flooring. Each and every room has benefited from centuries of attentive care, having belonged to the same family for over 200 years. The living spaces offer an array of welcoming and spacious areas to explore and enjoy the home's history.

Each of the equally well appointed bedrooms are complete with en-suite bathrooms, and the resplendent master suite located on the top floor of the tower offers guests the luxury of an outside terrace delightful views over the local coastline.

Can Harley’s exteriors are truly splendid, and offers extensive landscaped terraces, an infinity pool, beautifully sculpted exterior dining, entertainment and chill out areas., ideal for long lazy days soaking up the sun by the pool of starlit dinners with friends and family. One of the main attractions of this timeless property is the opportunity to enjoy the unforgettable sight of the Ibizan sunset, making it a truly desirable location.

name: Can Kali
tagline: Whitewashed walls, wild herbs, and six bedrooms of rural calm
summary:
San Lorenzo moves at its own pace — unhurried, sun-bleached, fragrant with pine and wild rosemary. 
This six-bedroom Ibizan finca sits deep in one of the island's most quietly beautiful corners, where traditional…
description:
San Lorenzo moves at its own pace — unhurried, sun-bleached, fragrant with pine and wild rosemary. 
This six-bedroom Ibizan finca sits deep in one of the island's most quietly beautiful corners, where traditional whitewashed architecture has been thoughtfully refreshed with a relaxed boho aesthetic that feels entirely at home among the almond groves. Original architectural details remain intact — thick stone walls, terracotta floors, low-slung archways — while interiors bring warmth through natural textures, earthy tones, and carefully chosen pieces that reward a second look. 
Santa Gertrudis, with its sun-drenched café terraces and slow weekend mornings, is minutes away; Ibiza Town a little further still. But the pull here is always back — back to the pool, back to the shade of the garden, back to the particular stillness that only the island's rural heart can offer. Close your eyes and you're already there.

name: Can Melanie
tagline: A fabulous family home close to beautiful sunset beaches
summary: Can Melanie is an enchantingly rustic traditional home located idyllically close to Ibiza’s beautiful west coast and its most sought after sunset beaches. This property is an authentic Ibicenco style farmhouse with many…
description: Can Melanie is an enchantingly rustic traditional home located idyllically close to Ibiza’s beautiful west coast and its most sought after sunset beaches. This property is an authentic Ibicenco style farmhouse with many contemporary touches throughout, and is perfectly situated on a hillside, by the charmiing village of San Agustin. This home is an ideal location for exploring the beautiful beaches of Cala Bassa and Cala Conta.

Can Melanie’s interiors are a timeless blend of terracotta tiled floors, white walls and traditional wood beamed ceilings, seamlessly mixed with touches of modern minimalism and high spec, luxurious furnishings. A sociable kitchen offers a sunny breakfast table leading directly to one of the interior dining spaces and the spacious, welcoming lounge offers direct access onto the exterior pool terrace. Three of the equally well appointed bedrooms are to be found in the main house, while additional guest accommodation is located in three casitas on the grounds, each with twin beds, en-suite bathroom and terrace access.

Enjoy the comfort of the private L-shaped pool from the terraces or lounge on the luxury wooden decking. There is a wide terrace with an al-fresco dining table which is shaded by a traditional wooden-beamed roof. The gardens also offer further exterior seated areas and a wooden pergola with a second outside dining space. Enjoy the spectacular sight of the world famous Ibizan sunset sky each and every night, making it a truly desirable holiday home.

name: Can Mole
tagline: Walking Distance to San Antonio
summary: Experience the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury at Can Mole, a stunning 6-bedroom villa located within walking distance of the attractions of San Antonio Bay and San Antonio town. With its prime…
description: Experience the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury at Can Mole, a stunning 6-bedroom villa located within walking distance of the attractions of San Antonio Bay and San Antonio town. With its prime location, a car is not necessary, allowing you to easily explore the area on foot. This modern villa is thoughtfully designed and well-equipped, featuring 6 bathrooms (4 of which are en-suite), air conditioning, and Wi-Fi.

Step into the spacious outdoor area and be greeted by a private pool, inviting you to take a refreshing dip. The ample space also includes a dining area where you can savor delicious meals, as well as a BBQ for outdoor grilling. Can Mole is the perfect choice for both groups and families, offering a high-quality villa with convenient amenities nearby.

Inside the villa, the main house welcomes you with a generous lounge area, complete with a large L-shaped sofa, TV (with UK freeview), and an indoor dining table. A small hallway leads to two bedrooms and a spacious family bathroom with a bath/shower combination. The master suite, accessed from the hallway, features a king-size bed, walk-in wardrobe, and an en-suite bathroom with a corner bath, separate shower, and his and hers sinks. Another single room is conveniently located off the lounge, leading towards the pool. The villa also includes a well-equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, hob, oven, microwave, kettle, toaster, and fridge/freezer.
Moving to the poolside area, you will discover three additional modern bedrooms, each boasting their own en-suite bathrooms.

The outdoor space at Can Mole is truly fantastic, catering to large groups and families. A spacious porch area with seating awaits you at the front of the villa, while at the back, your private pool beckons with its gradual steps. Surrounded by palm trees, the large terrace provides an oasis of relaxation, offering plenty of sunbeds for you to bask in the sun. For added entertainment, the villa also includes a table tennis table. An outdoor kitchen area, complete with a charcoal BBQ, sink, and fridge, awaits your culinary endeavors. Two shaded seating areas with a large dining table and seats provide the perfect setting for al fresco dining, allowing you to savor meals in the refreshing Ibiza breeze.
Indulge in the luxury and comfort of Can Mole, where unforgettable moments await you and your loved ones.

name: Can Sage
tagline: A truly enchanting rustic villa perfectly located close to Ibiza Town
summary: Located on the southern end of the municipality of Santa Eulalia and just a few minutes from Ibiza Town, Puig d’en Valls, Can Sage is a 6 bedroom traditional villa which has been lovingly restored, is an incredibly…
description: Located on the southern end of the municipality of Santa Eulalia and just a few minutes from Ibiza Town, Puig d’en Valls, Can Sage is a 6 bedroom traditional villa which has been lovingly restored, is an incredibly quiet and tranquil escape from busy island life. With spectacular views of Ibiza’s harbour, you have easy access to the centre of Ibiza with its dazzling array of nightlife venues, plus of course the islands abundance of beautiful beaches.

Hosting up to 11 guests, Can Sage is an enchanting villa spread over a main house and guesthouse, teaming beautifully original architecture with practical, modern fittings and finishes. Encapsulating a rustic island feel, the vast inside spaces at this villa have been well designed to provide an easy flow from the outdoor to indoor areas.

In keeping with the surrounding landscape, the four bedrooms in the main house team a organic colour palette with original detailing. With a charming farmhouse character, the reception, living room and kitchen showcase Sabina beams and traditional tiled floors creating cool calming space to relax in. Then you have the guest house with 2 twin bedrooms.

Can Sage offers huge amounts of outdoor entertaining space including a gazebo with barbeque, shaded pergolas, multiple dining zones and of course a superb swimming pool. Benefitting from a charming gazebo, barbeque area and outdoor dining zones, Can Sage is perfect for welcoming a large family or a group of friends. Surrounded by vast amounts of agricultural land, the villa provides uninterrupted views of the majestic medieval fortress Dalt Villa.

name: Villa Auren
tagline: Contemporary Luxury Hideaway
summary: Hidden in the tranquil countryside of Cala Llonga, Villa Auren is an extraordinary 400-year-old Ibizan finca where timeless heritage meets contemporary luxury. Meticulously restored to preserve its authentic character…
description: Hidden in the tranquil countryside of Cala Llonga, Villa Auren is an extraordinary 400-year-old Ibizan finca where timeless heritage meets contemporary luxury. Meticulously restored to preserve its authentic character while embracing refined modern design, this exceptional estate sits within 5,000 m² of private landscaped grounds, offering complete privacy and an unparalleled setting for unforgettable holidays, celebrations, retreats, and special events.

Natural stone walls, minimalist white interiors, organic textures, and carefully curated contemporary art create a sophisticated atmosphere that remains true to the essence of Ibiza. Designed as a private wellness sanctuary, Villa Auren offers an outstanding collection of facilities rarely found in a single estate. Guests can enjoy a professional padel court, beach volleyball court, pétanque court, fully equipped gym, two saunas, hammam, two ice baths, dedicated massage and mindfulness spaces, yoga area, elegant fireplace, and a DJ booth—creating the perfect balance of relaxation, wellbeing, and entertainment.

The estate also features a private home cinema, games room with poker table, pool table and ping pong, as well as multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces designed for gathering with family and friends. Beautiful Mediterranean gardens surround the swimming pool, while shaded terraces and alfresco dining areas invite guests to embrace Ibiza's renowned outdoor lifestyle from sunrise to sunset.
Daily housekeeping is included throughout your stay, ensuring every moment is effortless and allowing you to fully unwind in your own private oasis.

Just 15 minutes from Ibiza Town, Villa Auren enjoys a privileged location close to the island's finest beaches, restaurants, marinas, and nightlife, while remaining a peaceful retreat surrounded by nature. Whether you're planning a luxury family holiday, wellness retreat, corporate gathering, or unforgettable celebration, Villa Auren offers one of Ibiza's most exclusive and unique experiences.

name: Villa Marita
tagline: Charming villa with sea views and a beach within walking distance
summary: Elegant and sophisticated villa with breathtaking sea views over Cala Tarida bay. The property is located on the West coast within a short walk from the sandy, family-friendly Cala Tarida beach and only a short ride…
description: Elegant and sophisticated villa with breathtaking sea views over Cala Tarida bay. The property is located on the West coast within a short walk from the sandy, family-friendly Cala Tarida beach and only a short ride away from the equally stunning Cala Comte, Cala Bassa, Cala Moli and Cala Vadella.

The main house consists of 3 bedrooms- two spacious double bedrooms and a single room. There are also 2 apartments, each with a private entrance. The first apartment consists of 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and a kitchenette. The second apartment is a large studio with a kitchen and a bathroom.

The fully landscaped garden has its own fenced forest area, which provides plenty of fresh logs for summer BBQs and the indoor fireplace in the colder months. The house is perched 160 meters above sea level, making for unforgettable sea and sunset views, as well as the surrounding forests, stretched along the coast.
The large stoned pool area overlooks the green hills and it is surrounded by rocky landscape of cactuses and palms.

name: Ca'na Calma
tagline: Luxury 5-Bedroom Sea View Finca in Ibiza | San Carlos – Santa Eulalia

Set on a quaint little hill between San Carlos and Santa Eulalia, this stylish and authentic Ibiza rental holiday home has been refurbished for summer 2021 with no expense spared. Ideally located only a few minutes drive from San Carlos, Santa Eulalia and Santa Gertrudis de Fruitera, although incredibly private and set back, its location is not too far away from everything.

This area is a beloved destination for families and Yoga groups alike with its incredible sea and countryside views, there are plenty of sandy beaches nearby. With a long-established reputation as the island’s most natural area, it is perfect for long walks and cycling with picturesque views all round.
This Ibiza rental villa features extensive outdoor terraces with ample sunbathing and shaded areas for the whole family, along with a huge swimming pool, Jacuzzi, and Sauna.
Its stunning terraces showcase a wide variety of plants and greenery rich in colour, which are beautifully lit in the evenings and feature a barbecue and a large covered outdoor dining area.
The property has 5 beautifully and thoughtfully presented bedrooms, including an incredibly luxurious, spacious bedroom that takes in breathtakingly stunning sea and landscape views.
This exclusive property has so many rooms and areas to explore, which makes it perfect for larger families or Yoga groups holidaying together.
This luxury Ibiza villa boasts a spacious open plan lounge with an expansive dining area looking out to the pool area.
A large fully equipped kitchen with all the appliances you will ever need.
The property includes 4 dining areas, 2 indoors and 2 outdoors.

The interior and exterior have been exquisitely designed and refurbished by the famous Blakstad Architects on the Island. The property maintains the typical, authentic Ibizan Fincas, but with a spacious feel.
You will always be able to find a nice, quiet place to relax and unwind.
Tastefully presented throughout, this property is the perfect retreat for family or friends to unwind together. A beautifully secluded Ibizan holiday Rental home for families with magnificent views.

name: Can Aspen

Located in a quiet hillside neighbourhood, the house sits majestically overlooking the valley at its feet, with stunning views to the extensive pine tree forests, the farmlands that surround the villa and the sea in the distance. Can Aspen was completely renovated in 2018 giving it a fresh modern summer vibe that visitors from around the world. The interiors are a minimal chic dream, with a white theme which flows from the living and dining spaces to the sleeping areas.

The house offers 4 double bedrooms, all with bathroom en-suite and king/queen size beds. All living areas face the captivating country views, including its several terraces, large dining tables and chill-out corners which all serve to maximise its peaceful atmosphere.

Step outside into the grounds of Can Aspen and immerse yourself in the true beauty of the nature which surrounds you, with a charming pool area surrounded by sun soaked terraces and various trees and plants filling the air with their fragrance. Relax on one of the luxurious loungers and take in the view, or entertain friends and family in the delightful alfresco dining area.

name: Can Bassora
tagline: Contemporary design villa on the east coast
summary: Can Bassora is an exclusive villa with a contemporary design located on the east coast of the island of Ibiza, just a few minutes away from the beach of Es Canar, an enchanting area especially popular with surfers and…
description: Can Bassora is an exclusive villa with a contemporary design located on the east coast of the island of Ibiza, just a few minutes away from the beach of Es Canar, an enchanting area especially popular with surfers and those seeking the authentic hippie soul of the island.

The villa is an incredible property of no less than 846 m2 on a total plot of 17,300 m2, distributed on two levels and with a basement connected to the property by lift and where all guests can enjoy extra space and a private gymnasium. Can Bassora consists of 5 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, equipped with modern furniture of elegant design and every comfort.

The structure of the house is a continuous interweaving of light elements, such as glass and wrought iron, that defy heights, thus creating a continuum with the outdoor spaces and flooding the indoor area with fantastic natural light. The perfect architectural geometry outside the villa blends perfectly with the surrounding garden. The front contains the chill-out area with swimming pool, barbecue area, relaxation area with sofas and outdoor dining area: relaxing holidays in good company will be made perfect by this unrivalled combination of privacy and comfort.

The terrace gives direct access to both the modern, fully equipped kitchen and the living area. This room is characterised by high windows that increase the sense of space and create plays of light that blend in with the choice of furnishings. The large sofa occupies the centre of the room, an invitation to enjoy moments of conviviality in the company of friends or family even out of season thanks to the presence of the fireplace. The living area continues the indoor
dining area, access to the laundry area, a service toilet, and the access points to the other levels of the house: the lift, for access to the lower level where the gym, a bathroom with shower and garage are located, and the stairs giving access to the sleeping area on the upper level.

On the upper level is the master suite and the second double bedroom. Both have an en-suite bathroom, walk-in wardrobe and private terrace. The other three bedrooms are located on the main level: a double bedroom with en-suite bathroom with shower, a job corner and private terrace, and two other double bedrooms with direct access to the terrace, a shared bathroom and a small relax area with sofa.

Whatever your needs are, they will be met at Can Bassora by exceeding your every expectation. Whatever your expectations are, everything you need will be right there at your fingertips in what can be briefly summarised as the perfect home.

name: Can Brooke
tagline: Bohemian soul, lush gardens, and the wild north at your door

San Carlos moves at its own pace — farmers' markets at dawn, the scent of jasmine drifting through pine, Las Dalias just down the road come Saturday evening. Can Brooke belongs to this rhythm entirely. A thoughtful bohemian renovation gives the villa warmth without pretension: sun-bleached textiles, earthy tones, and rooms that feel lived-in in the best possible way. 
The master suite opens onto its own private living room, while the sky lounge catches the last of the northern light long after the rest of the island has moved on to dinner. Outside, a generous pool sits within gardens lush enough to lose an afternoon in. 
Cala Llenya and Cala Nova are a short walk away for when the sea calls. Come evening, with the children settled and a glass of something cold in hand, the only decision is whether to watch the stars or pour another.

name: Can Catalina
tagline: A stylish property in the heart of the island with panoramic country views
summary: This newly modernised five-bedroom Blakstad finca offers sensational south-facing views overlooking miles of the island’s luscious landscape. Can Catalina is located in Santa Gertrudis which is home to many fashionable…
description: This newly modernised five-bedroom Blakstad finca offers sensational south-facing views overlooking miles of the island’s luscious landscape. Can Catalina is located in Santa Gertrudis which is home to many fashionable restaurants and boutiques as well as a rich agricultural landscape. Santa Gertrudis has a truly picturesque village square with a vibrant cafe culture. The bright lights of Ibiza Town with its famous nightlife scene are just a short drive away.

Traditionally styled to incorporate the natural, rustic elements of its surroundings, Can Catalina blends timeless designer furniture with fresh, modern soft furnishings to create a warm, welcoming environment. Stunning sabina wooden beams and terracotta tiles adorn every luxurious floor of the finca, creating a seamless flow from the ground floor all the way to the sumptuous day bed found on the roof, from where you can immerse yourself in the beauty of the nature which surrounds you.

All five bedrooms at Can Catalina offer breathtaking views overlooking the lush, green countryside. Leading out to its own private terrace, the master bedroom is the perfect spot for a morning coffee!

In the grounds of Can Catalina you can delight in a shaded pergola,inviting swimming pool and multiple terraces which all look over the lush, green surroundings making this the ultimate home to escape to. Offering peace and privacy, the outside spaces at this villa offer an array of shaded dining areas, cool relaxation beds and sunny lounge zones. The highest vantage point of all, on the roof terrace is a wonderful spot for extra peaceful sunbathing or stargazing at night.

name: Can Chloe
tagline: Stunning property with beautiful sea views
summary: Perched above the glittering western coastline, Can Chloe sits within easy reach of two of Ibizas most quietly coveted coves, the sheltered bay of Cala Vadella and the pebbled shore of Cala Moli. Inside, white walls and…
description: Perched above the glittering western coastline, Can Chloe sits within easy reach of two of Ibizas most quietly coveted coves, the sheltered bay of Cala Vadella and the pebbled shore of Cala Moli. Inside, white walls and natural wood set a calm, unhurried tone, while colourful furnishings add warmth and character to the generous living spaces. The kitchen is well equipped and anchored by a breakfast bar, opens onto a sunwashed terrace where a table for eight catches the morning light. As the day turns, the villas elevated position earns its reputation: the western horizon ignites at sunset, painting the sea amber and gold. With five bedrooms and an atmosphere that sits somewhere between refined and relaxed, this is a villa for those who want Ibizas wild beauty on their own terms unhurried, uninterrupted and entirely their own.

name: Can Daneri
tagline: A private Mediterranean retreat near Ibiza Town
summary: Can Daneri is a spacious Mediterranean retreat located just five minutes from Ibiza Town, Ses Salines beach, and the airport. Surrounded by pine forests and offering beautiful sea views, the villa blends rustic charm…
description: Can Daneri is a spacious Mediterranean retreat located just five minutes from Ibiza Town, Ses Salines beach, and the airport. Surrounded by pine forests and offering beautiful sea views, the villa blends rustic charm with modern comfort, creating an ideal setting for families and groups seeking privacy and convenience.

The main house offers four bright double bedrooms for up to eight guests, while a fully equipped independent apartment adds another double bedroom, comfortably accommodating up to 2 more guests. This layout provides generous space and comfort for groups of up to ten.

Inside, the villa features two inviting living rooms filled with natural light, Smart TV, and a warm Mediterranean aesthetic. The interiors mix rustic details with modern finishes, creating a relaxed yet refined ambiance. With two full indoor kitchens, an outdoor barbecue, and multiple dining areas both inside and outdoors, the villa is designed for long meals and memorable social gatherings.

Outside, guests can enjoy a large private pool surrounded by sun loungers, shaded chill-out corners, and terraces overlooking the landscape and coastline. The villa’s elevated outdoor areas and lush surroundings create a calm and private environment perfect for a Mediterranean escape.

The master suite includes an en-suite bathroom and a private terrace with outstanding views. Additional bedrooms share stylish bathrooms with natural materials and warm tones. The independent apartment offers its own living room, dining space, and kitchen, giving extra privacy within the property.

Amenities include Wi-Fi, two fully equipped kitchens, barbecue, private pool, air conditioning, outdoor dining areas, smart TV, parking, alarm system, sea views, and a baby cot on request ensuring a comfortable stay.
Located just minutes from beaches, restaurants, Ibiza Town, shopping, the Marina, and nightlife, Can Daneri offers the ideal combination of comfort, privacy, and prime Ibiza positioning.

name: Can Daphne
tagline: Renovated finca in a tranquil Santa Gertrudis
summary: Finca Can Daphne belongs to the absolute top segment fincas of Ibiza. This more than 250-year-old 5 bedroom family finca plus separate guest house and old tower was completely renovated during 2018 and 2019. With a nod…
description: Finca Can Daphne belongs to the absolute top segment fincas of Ibiza. This more than 250-year-old 5 bedroom family finca plus separate guest house and old tower was completely renovated during 2018 and 2019. With a nod to the famous Blackstad fincas, in combination with its own character, it has become a real gem.

Can Daphne is offering an amazing dazzling stay with all new bedrooms, new bathrooms, new kitchens, new floors, new terraces, new salt-electrolysis pool (5x10 meters) (10% salt content), a new chill-out ´corner´ with a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, a yoga deck, kids playground with trampoline and table tennis, child-safety terraces around the pool, a games room with pool table and so on.

Also, you will find the latest technical gadgets in the field of sound and the internet. There is also a laundry room for you as a guest and you will find air conditioning in the majority of rooms. There are idyllic views, looking out over the beautiful valleys with a large variety of fruit trees, various large terraces with different dining areas, and various chill-out zones.

The main house accommodates 8 people, the nearby guesthouse with the tower provides room for two more.
From the garden, you walk into the main house. There is a beautiful fully equipped open kitchen. The living room is very cozy. Next to the living room, there is another lounge where you'll find a pool table. On the ground floor, there are 2 bedrooms. One of the bedrooms has en-suite bathroom with a shower. The other bathroom, also with shower, which belongs to the second bedroom is adjacent to the living room and also functions as a guest toilet.

The first floor can be reached via the amazing spiral staircase. Here is the master bedroom. On the private terrace of the master bedroom you will find a bath and shower. Adjacent to the hall is another bathroom with a bath and shower, this belongs also to the master bedroom. The other bedroom that is located here has an en-suite bathroom with a shower.
The guest house is situated in the tower. It has a sitting area and a small open kitchen, the washing mashing machine can also be found here.

Can Daphne is located 20 minutes drive from the airport in the heart of the island just 4 minutes from the beautiful and increasingly in-demand art village of Santa Gertrudis. The Finca can be found at the end of a winding camino, meaning there is no passing traffic and 100% privacy and peace are guaranteed. Within only 10 minutes you can be in Ibiza town or at one of the popular beaches and beach clubs.

name: Can Elsa
tagline: A whitewashed finca where countryside silence with sea views
summary: Can Elsa is a charming and traditional Ibicencan 5-bedroom villa, ideally located just moments from the stunning bays of Cala Bassa and Cala Conta, both renowned for their crystal-clear waters and breathtaking sunset…
description: Can Elsa is a charming and traditional Ibicencan 5-bedroom villa, ideally located just moments from the stunning bays of Cala Bassa and Cala Conta, both renowned for their crystal-clear waters and breathtaking sunset views. Only a short drive away from the quaint and picturesque village of San Agustin, this exquisite property is set on a generous plot of land, surrounded by sweeping green countryside, offering guests the ultimate blend of privacy and natural beauty.

The interiors of Can Elsa elegantly maintain the iconic 'Ibicenco' style, featuring traditional elements such as floor-to-ceiling stone masoned walls and wooden beamed ceilings that infuse the villa with authentic charm. These classic details are artfully complemented by striking bright white finishes and modern decor, creating a perfect balance between rustic tradition and contemporary luxury. The open-plan design offers an inviting and spacious lounge area with a large, comfortable sofa, providing a cozy spot for relaxation. A choice of dining areas makes it easy to enjoy both formal meals and more casual dining experiences. The stylish, fully equipped modern kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring a breakfast bar and all the latest appliances, ensuring a seamless experience for both seasoned chefs and those who prefer to enjoy leisurely meals. Contemporary lighting, artwork, and stylish furniture throughout the villa contribute to the sophisticated atmosphere, blending traditional design with modern touches.

Each of the five bedrooms is spacious and thoughtfully designed, maintaining the villa’s seamless theme of contemporary elegance. The bedrooms are all beautifully decorated, with a clean and modern aesthetic that flows naturally from the rest of the villa. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom, ensuring privacy and convenience for all guests. The Master bedroom is located on the upper grounds of the property and features its own private entrance, as well as a large terrace where you can enjoy stunning views of the surrounding countryside and coastline. Bedroom 2 also has its own private entrance, a comfortable double bed, and an en-suite bathroom, offering an additional level of privacy. Bedrooms 3, 4, and 5 are located within the main finca and are equally spacious and beautifully designed, each with an en-suite bathroom, and one bedroom having a WC just over the hall for added convenience.

The exterior of Can Elsa is centered around a delightful pool area, which is surrounded by high-quality decking, sun loungers, and parasols, making it the perfect spot for soaking up the Ibizan sun. The pool area is complemented by several dining spaces, ranging from formal seating to more relaxed, bohemian-style outdoor dining. Whether you prefer a laid-back meal in the shade or a more elegant evening under the stars, there is an ideal setting for every occasion. Two luxurious chill-out areas are also available for guests to unwind in comfort. One of these areas offers a shaded space with a view of the pool, while the other is a sun-drenched roof terrace, providing panoramic views of the stunning surroundings.
With its blend of traditional charm and modern sophistication, Can Elsa is a perfect retreat for those seeking a luxurious escape in one of Ibiza’s most desirable locations.

name: Can Luna
tagline: An exceptional property in a family friendly location
summary: Can Luna is a luxurious and charming 5 bedroom villa with exceptional seaviews located just a few metres from the nearest beach. Close by is the elegant Nikki Beach club and the area of S’Argamassa with its seafront…
description: Can Luna is a luxurious and charming 5 bedroom villa with exceptional seaviews located just a few metres from the nearest beach. Close by is the elegant Nikki Beach club and the area of S’Argamassa with its seafront bars and restaurants. The vibrant town of Santa Eulalia is just a short drive away, with its abundance of dining destinations, shops and amenities, making this a desirable location for families.

The interior decor has a fluid theme of a contemporary minimalist approach artfully combined with authentic Mediterranean decor throughout the open-plan lounge area and modern kitchen, which is of course fully equipped with all modern appliances. There are 5 beautifully furnished double bedrooms all with en-suite bathrooms, ample wardrobe space and air conditioning. Each bedroom has its own individual charm, with bright colourful artwork complementing the neutral tones of the decor. Head upstairs and enjoy the delights of the sun-drenched roof terrace with expansive and tranquil sea views.

The property is a modern architectural build with a traditional Ibizan style, predominantly white exterior walls with beautiful planes of stone masonry works. The grounds are spacious and inviting, the perfect place to spend a lazy luxurious Ibizan afternoon, with a unique L-shape swimming pool with an expansive terrace and sunbathing area complete with several sun loungers. You can entertain friends and family at your leisure in the outdoor dining and entertaining space with a purpose built BBQ. Can Luna is an exceptional frontline property in a family friendly location.

name: Can Mayans
tagline: Hidden Gem in the countryside of Santa Gertrudis
summary: This top renovated finca property is located on an approximately 10,000m2 large plot with about 100 orange trees, everything was designed with great attention to detail. The whole environment and the interior of the…
description: This top renovated finca property is located on an approximately 10,000m2 large plot with about 100 orange trees, everything was designed with great attention to detail. The whole environment and the interior of the finca is very similar to the authentic Ibizan country hotel style. The original Sabina woodwork and all the ironwork was handmade and finished by the owner's family in Ibiza. In this 450m2 large finca, you will experience the pure naturalness and generosity of Ibiza. A composition of natural stone, olive and Sabina wood and authentic Ibicencan style. Driveway, garden and pool can be beautifully lit at night!

name: Can Mira
tagline: Charming and stylish Villa near San Lorenzo and Santa Gertrudis
summary: Can Mira is a five bedroom villa, newly built stone by stone within the magical embrace of ancient pine trees and a forest that holds secrets only those with an open-heart and unfettered imagination can uncover.…
description: Can Mira is a five bedroom villa, newly built stone by stone within the magical embrace of ancient pine trees and a forest that holds secrets only those with an open-heart and unfettered imagination can uncover. Perfectly hidden deep in the campo, its proximity to restaurants, beaches, shops and Ibiza town are to be rejoiced in; nothing is far from your Island hideaway. Follow the twisting country roads and within minutes you find yourself in the village of Santa Gertrudis, a cool cute social hub, where stocking up on organic essentials, popping in to browse artisan home wares in Es Cucones or an indulgent no shame people watching, café con leche in hand from the village square are all easy peasey.

A love project from beginning to end, the villa is everything you would want from a family villa. Soft muted natural stone interiors provide the backdrop for mystical artifacts and artwork from far flung destinations all personally curated by the owners. High spec throughout, Can Mira makes the living easy and frankly effortless when you have a multi generational group that lovingly demand different things. Yet it is more than just the city standard flick of a button technology here that eases your time on the island. Sun shiny days that make way to hazy nights, giggles and stolen glances between your tribe, knowing that all is right, all is good. Dancing like a loon just to see your children laugh uncontrollably, their beautiful faces etched into your mind's memory bank forever. With a myriad of outside al fresco spaces and a huge garden perfect for tearing around in, Can Mirna will return you and your loved ones to the connection that is sometimes lost in our busy lives. Restoring fun, frivolity and freedom, all by just holding the most precious of spaces for you all to simply be.

Open plan living creates space and intimacy all in one and Can Miras’ large living, dining and kitchen area provide this new slow rhythm for you to languidly dance to. Carefully considered cupboards and generous amounts of work surfaces including a central food island implore you to prepare nutritious and fun family feasts. Large windows look out onto the wisteria-framed porch, and beyond the forest unfurls its majesty. Keep a watchful eye on your little ones as they begin adventures in the forest, returning at lunchtime a little more feral than they started. The look of exploration ablaze in their shiny, excited eyes.

A large L-shaped sofa with super snugly seats invites you and your lot to cuddle on or stretch out. Planning the day's island adventures or perhaps radically not planning at all, delighting in the newly found sense of no schedule.

Can Mirna offers a myriad of activities for your young ones to engage in, from skateboarding, football or badminton whilst you lounge in any of the chill out or al fresco dining spaces. Cocooned by nature, Can Mirna offers freedom and space to roam wildly. Proud Pines leave traces of a resinous woody smell in the air and Palms of all sizes from stocky to slender cast a tropical spell that weaves around you. Breaking the fifty shades of verdant green are neon burst of saturated fuchsia bougainvillea. Precisely cut green coiffured lawns offer their soft-carpeted grass for bare foot walks or take off like an explored and follow the windy paths deep into the grounds.
For cozy fireside chats, curl around the open plan fire when the nip is in the air or simply luxuriate alone in the space with a book or guilty pleasure magazine.

Mainhouse: 4 Bedrooms and 3 Bathrooms
Guesthouse: 1 Bedroom with 1 bathroom

San Lorenzo 4km
Santa Gertrudis 5,5km
Santa Eulalia 6,5km
Supermaket 4km
Ibiza Stadt 12km
Airport 18km

Large open plan living area with fireplace, L-shaped sofa & opens onto the terrace
Open plan dining area opening onto the terrace
Fully equipped open plan kitchen with work island
Master bedroom (double) with sitting room opening onto terrace
Bedroom 2 (double) opening onto balcony
Bedroom 3 (french double) with en-suite (shower)
Bedroom 4 (french double) with en-suite (shower)
Bathroom for master bedroom & bedroom 2 (bath & shower)
The owners prefer families rather than groups of friends. Up to 6 adults and 4 kids are the ideal group - max 8 adults.

name: Can Mistique
tagline: Spacious Ibizan Villa on the West Coast
summary: Nestled in the picturesque Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Villa CAN MISTIQUE boasts an expansive 10,000 m² estate. This remarkable hillside property ensures a high level of privacy and comfort, making it an ideal retreat.…
description: Nestled in the picturesque Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Villa CAN MISTIQUE boasts an expansive 10,000 m² estate. This remarkable hillside property ensures a high level of privacy and comfort, making it an ideal retreat. With a generous living space of 400 m² distributed across two floors, the villa comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests.

CAN MISTIQUE features a bright living-dining area and a well-appointed country kitchen. The property includes five bedrooms, each equipped with its own bathroom and dressing room, totaling six bathrooms along with an additional toilet. Among the many amenities offered are Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a security system, a fireplace, cable TV, a crib, and a high chair.

The standout feature of this property is its stunning outdoor space, highlighted by a spacious 50 m² pool, outdoor showers, a jacuzzi, and a table tennis area. Guests can revel in breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and the distant sea. The outdoor loungers and comfortable beach beds provide the perfect setting for relaxation, while the covered dining areas are ideal for enjoying freshly grilled meals amidst the serene Mediterranean greenery.

Conveniently located just 880 meters (an 11-minute walk) from shops, restaurants, bars, and cafes, the nearest sandy beach, Playa Port des Torrent, is only 6.5 kilometers away, accessible in about 13 minutes by car, allowing you to easily escape the stresses of daily life.
The property offers parking space for up to 10 vehicles, and pets are welcome. Bed linens and towels are included in the rental fee, ensuring a comfortable stay.

name: Can Nala
tagline: A beautifully renovated finca with spectacular views close to Ibiza Town
summary: Can Nala is a stylish 5 bedroom property offering stunning panoramic sea and island views across Ibiza Town, Dalt Vila and sweeping across to the neighbouring island of Formentera. This elegantly styled villa is set up…
description: Can Nala is a stylish 5 bedroom property offering stunning panoramic sea and island views across Ibiza Town, Dalt Vila and sweeping across to the neighbouring island of Formentera. This elegantly styled villa is set up high on the hillside of the extremely sought after area of Cap Martinet. The perfect location allows for spectacular landscape views and is just a short drive from Ibiza Town with its abundance of attractions.

The living areas have polished cement floors and are brightly furnished with modern fixtures and fittings, all of the very highest standard throughout. Can Nala has a fabulous fully equipped kitchen, a large open plan lounge, and divine dining areas which open out onto the terrace enhancing the superb location of this home. The five sophisticated and contemporary bedrooms are set across three separate floors, affording space and privacy, with two of the rooms offering Queen sized beds, all with ensuites and four rooms open out directly onto an outdoor terrace space.

Step outside and delight in the superb salt-water swimming pool which comes complete with luxury sun loungers, daybeds and parasols. The grounds of Can Nala are exceptionally designed, and beautifully sculpted with outstanding garden features, and look onto a wonderful woodland nature reserve. For al-fresco entertaining, the terrace is complete with a spacious dining area, comfortable covered chill-out areas and an outdoor plancha for long lazy lunches or dinners under the starry sky.

name: Can Puig Lorenzo
tagline: Peaceful Hacienda Retreat with Pool & Chill-Out Areas near Santa Gertrudis
summary: Nestled in the heart of Ibiza, just minutes from the picturesque village of Santa Gertrudis, this exceptional hacienda offers the perfect balance between convenience, privacy, and authentic island living. Santa…
description: Nestled in the heart of Ibiza, just minutes from the picturesque village of Santa Gertrudis, this exceptional hacienda offers the perfect balance between convenience, privacy, and authentic island living. Santa Gertrudis is renowned for its charming atmosphere, excellent restaurants, boutique shops, cafés, and vibrant village square, making it one of Ibiza's most desirable locations.

Set along the road connecting Santa Gertrudis and San Lorenzo, the property enjoys a secluded position surrounded by nature while offering distant sea views towards the bay of Santa Eulària. Far from the island's busy tourist hotspots, it is a place where peace, space, and tranquillity take centre stage.

This impressive 400 m² hacienda reflects the timeless beauty of traditional Ibiza architecture, inspired by classical Moorish design. Natural stone walls, handcrafted details, ancient olive wood, and original sabina beams create a warm and authentic atmosphere throughout the estate.

The elevated pool area is undoubtedly one of the property's highlights. From here, guests can enjoy breathtaking panoramic views across the valley towards the Mediterranean Sea. A charming gazebo, multiple sun terraces, and several stylish chill-out areas furnished with teak furniture provide endless opportunities to relax and unwind. Surrounded by fruit trees, Mediterranean gardens, and the scents of the countryside, the estate offers a true connection to nature.
Accommodation: The estate consists of a main finca, an annex, a casita, and an independent studio guest house, providing privacy and comfort for families or groups of friends.

Main House: 2 double bedrooms (1 bedroom with king-size bed 1.80 m x 2.00 m + 1 bedroom with double bed 1.40 m x 2.00 m), 1 bathrooms with shower and/or bathtub, 1 en-suite bathroom en with shower, Spacious living room with fireplace and air conditioning, Large fully equipped kitchen with dining area, Satellite TV and stereo system
Annex: Located next to the main entrance. 1 double bedroom (1.80 m x 2.00 m), En-suite bathroom, Private entrance, Air conditioning
Casita: Located beside the pool area. 1 double bedroom (1.80 m x 2.00 m), En-suite bathroom, Seperate Kitchenette, Private terrace, Private entrance, Air conditioning

Studio Guest House: Situated approximately 80 metres from the main finca, surrounded by vineyards and a flourishing vegetable garden. 1 double bedroom (1.80 m x 2.00 m), En-suite bathroom, Kitchenette, Private terrace, Private entrance, Air conditioning

The Perfect Setting for Family and Friends: Whether you spend your days by the pool, exploring the nearby villages, enjoying long outdoor dinners under the stars, or simply relaxing in one of the many peaceful corners of the estate, this unique hacienda offers an unforgettable Ibiza experience.
A wonderful retreat for families and friends seeking authenticity, privacy, comfort, and the natural beauty of Ibiza.

name: Can Savasana
tagline: A 16th-Century Finca, Private Cala Salada Access, Zero Compromise
summary: From its lofty perch in the quiet pine-clad hills near San Antonio, Savasana holiday villa enjoys spectacular sea views and grand Ibiza sunsets. The 50 000 m2 grounds surrounding the villa provide countless vantage…
description: From its lofty perch in the quiet pine-clad hills near San Antonio, Savasana holiday villa enjoys spectacular sea views and grand Ibiza sunsets. The 50 000 m2 grounds surrounding the villa provide countless vantage points for reflection, and include a pool, multiple relaxing and outdoor dining areas and both a Mediterranean and vegetable garden - all enjoyed in the perfect privacy of the neighbourless plot.

The villa itself is unique - a 500 year old finca restored in high quality, with modern comforts but a decidedly rustic, homely and creative style which includes Balinese fittings, tiles, unusual artworks and artefacts and beautiful wooden beams.

With 5 double bedrooms - 3 of which en suite making a total of 4 bathrooms - there is space enough for up to 10 people in either groups or families. For the safety of children the very large pool can be fenced on request. This villa is also ideal for weddings, with the top floor master bedroom including a 100 m² private terrace with the best sea views on the whole plot.

Savasana is not far from the action, but its secluded location make a car essential. The nearest beach is the beautiful Cala Salada, only a 5 minute drive, whilst San Antonio and its shops, clubs and famous sunset strip cafes are only 10 minutes.

name: Can Sol
tagline: Walking distance to beach in San Antonio
summary: Welcome to Can Sol, a magnificent contemporary villa nestled in the heart of San Antonio Bay. This spacious house spans two levels and features two fully independent, self-contained apartments on the ground floor. Villa…
description: Welcome to Can Sol, a magnificent contemporary villa nestled in the heart of San Antonio Bay. This spacious house spans two levels and features two fully independent, self-contained apartments on the ground floor. Villa Sunset, as it is also known, boasts a large private pool and ample space for sunbathing, barbecuing, and unwinding with friends. With numerous amenities right on your doorstep, it truly epitomizes the perfect holiday home for both families and groups seeking a premium villa experience.

Upon entering Can Sol, you are greeted by a generous hallway that leads to a spacious open-plan lounge, complete with comfortable sofas and a widescreen TV. Adjacent to the lounge is the indoor dining area, and from here, you can access the "L"-shaped balcony furnished with outdoor seating, offering splendid views of the pool. The first level also houses a well-equipped kitchen, featuring all the necessary appliances including a dishwasher, coffee machine, and large fridge/freezer. This kitchen includes a convenient breakfast bar and another separate balcony, creating an idyllic spot for enjoying breakfast in the sun.

On the first level, you will find the Master room, which boasts a spacious double bed, ample storage space, a TV, and a private balcony with enchanting views of the pool. The second room offers two single beds that can be converted into a double, along with plenty of storage. Bedroom three also features two single beds that can be converted into a double and provides ample storage space as well. The master bathroom on this level is equipped with a large corner bath, shower, toilet, bidet, and double sinks. Additionally, there is a separate toilet available for your convenience.

The first apartment offers an open-plan lounge area with a sofa and TV, connected to a well-appointed kitchen equipped with a hob, oven, and washing machine. This apartment also includes a spacious double room and another bathroom with a shower and toilet.

The second apartment features an open-plan lounge area with a sofa and TV, leading to a comfortable double bedroom. This area then leads to another kitchen with a separate entrance. The second apartment also includes a separate bathroom with a shower and toilet. Furthermore, at the entrance of the second apartment, you'll find a utility area housing an additional washing machine/dryer.

Can Sol is designed to accommodate large groups or families who desire privacy while still enjoying a memorable holiday together. Its contemporary design, luxurious amenities, and prime location make it the ideal choice for those seeking a spacious and upscale villa experience in close proximity to a wide range of conveniences.

name: Can Timo
tagline: A stunning restored Finca nestled in the hillside in a central location
summary: Sunshine orange clementine’s and bright yellow lemons hang heavily amongst the scented pine trees and neon pink flowers that envelop the dazzling white Can Tomas. Nestled in the hillside between San Rafael and San…
description:
Sunshine orange clementine’s and bright yellow lemons hang heavily amongst the scented pine trees and neon pink flowers that envelop the dazzling white Can Tomas. Nestled in the hillside between San Rafael and San Antonio, this restored finca was once an olive press and speaks gently of an ancient time. Inside, heavy walls implore you to surrender as if in a trance whilst the interiors are a soothing celebration of tradition and modernity, with eclectic treasures from Bali, London and Morocco placed against organic materials and soft muted shades.
With a playground, a swimming pool that can be heated at an extra cost and lots of outside chill out and dining areas, Can Tomas offers your family a haven in the heart of the islands countryside whilst still being close enough to the quiet villages of San Rafael and Santa Gertrudis or the buzzier Ibiza town.

Hand baked terracotta tiles look up to twisted wooden beams, gently reminding you of Can Tomas roots. Renovated to an exceptional spec, this country home features under floor heating throughout for the colder winter days. Designed with a reverence to the past and a love of all things exotic by design maestros Ksars, the open plan living area is elegant yet functional. Following an L shape, there are two cleverly zoned off seating areas. Sink your toes into the softness of the Moroccan Berber rug or lie back on the comfiest of sofas, cocktail in hand, whilst you anticipate the evening ahead. A rustic style wooden table flanked by a stylish collection of chairs adds to the global chic aesthetic. Just around the corner is another seated area, allowing your younger family members the privacy they crave to huddle up away from the curious eyes and ears of the grown ups. Yet still within necessary reach.
Cleverly mismatched tiles give off subtle pops of colour in the beautifully hand crafted kitchen, which has a perfect size family breakfast bar to keep the food flowing for your little ones at meal times.

Two of the bedrooms are located within the main house whilst three bedrooms are found in the old olive press. Elegant herringbone wooden floors feature in all the bedrooms, juxtaposed harmoniously to the traditional thick cavernous walls of the ancient finca.
Bedroom 1 is found just off the kitchen and is a great room for your children as it has two single beds and is interconnected to bedroom 2. This room can be also be turned into a double on request. This room shares a large bathroom with bedroom 2.
Bedroom 2 Whilst this room is inter connected to bedroom 1, the privacy settings come in the guise of the door to bedroom 1 and the curtains between the corridors.
Bedroom 3 Situated in the old olive press downstairs, this room has its own en suite. African art and vintage Moroccan furniture create a subtle and chic global style statement.
Bedroom 4 Situated in the old olive press, upstairs, this room shares a large bathroom with bedroom 5. Two singles make up this room but can on request be transformed to a double.
Bedroom 5 Situated in the old olive press, upstairs, this room shares a large bathroom with bedroom 4. Raw organic materials create a soothing vibe in this room.

The grounds of Can Tomas are rich, fertile and alive with flora and fauna such as Oleander flowers, giant Aloe Vera, pine and olive trees. Pick your own oranges, lemons and even grapefruits from the orchard.
With such enchanted grounds, you really wont want to leave so we say find a spot to hang out in. Large Balinese day beds provide horizontal comfort around the pool, which can be heated upon request (additional fee) . For meal times, an outside pizza oven and BBQ are just two ways to prepare your food Mediterranean style. Choose from either of the two shaded areas to take a seat with your tribe for easy breezy alfresco living.

name: Can Verde
tagline: Stunning Renovated Rustic Finca with Sea Views
summary:
Can Verde is a beautifully renovated rustic 300 year-old Ibizan finca oozing with charm and character. 
Enjoy maximum comfort, luxury and views over San Augustin to the Mediterranean sea.
description:
Can Verde is a beautifully renovated rustic 300 year-old Ibizan finca oozing with charm and character. 
Enjoy maximum comfort, luxury and views over San Augustin to the Mediterranean sea.

This property offers all your home from home comforts, a fully equipped kitchen, dining and large living communal areas. 
The main house has an Interior living space of over 300m2 where you find four comfortable bedrooms all with ceiling fans and air conditioning for your comfort at this holiday home. 
The large Master bedroom with ensuite bathroom opens onto a small private terrace with views over an array of fruit trees. 
A further three bedrooms are located in the main villa, one double bedroom with ensuite bathroom with shower and two twin bedroom that share a bathroom in the hall.
For those that enjoy more privacy there is a guest bedroom with ensuite bathroom with shower, independent entrances and no access to the main villa.

Within the 15.000m2 of enclosed tropical gardens you have three terraces to enjoy entertaining with family and friends. 
From the two poolside terraces with infinity pool enjoy the beautiful ibicencan sunsets as the sun vanishes over the mountains and on the back terrace enjoy dining and BBQ evenings.

Can Verde is surrounded by nature, animals, tranquillity and offers seasonal fruits as they ripen such as grapes, oranges, apricots, figs and pomegranates to name but a few. 
The property is situated in a peaceful location close to San Agustin and the picturesque village of San Josep. Popular west side beaches such as Cala Bassa, Cala Comte, Cala Tarida and Cala Vadella are within a 15 minute drive and Ibiza town with its array of restaurants and busy night life is around a 20 minute drive.

name: Can Vista Cala Jondal
tagline: Exquisite contemporary villa in the exclusive area of Cala Jondal.
summary: This beautifully refurbished property offers a prime location, just moments from the iconic Blue Marlin, and combines modern luxury with serene privacy.
description: This beautifully refurbished property offers a prime location, just moments from the iconic Blue Marlin, and combines modern luxury with serene privacy.

The villa spans 400m² and is set on a fully enclosed 5,200m² plot with stunning sea views. The landscaped garden is a tranquil haven, featuring a lush green lawn, palm trees, olive trees, and other Mediterranean plants. At the center is a luxurious 5 x 12m pool, perfect for soaking up the Ibiza sunshine.

The villa is thoughtfully designed across two levels. On the ground floor, you’ll find a spacious living area, an open-plan fully equipped kitchen, a guest bathroom, a twin bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, and a master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom. Both bedrooms provide direct access to the garden, blending indoor and outdoor living seamlessly. Whether you seek a tranquil retreat or a vibrant nightlife experience, Casa Pine is an ideal choice. Come and create unforgettable memories in San Antonio and Ibiza.

On Ibiza's west coast, where the land tilts toward the sea and the sky turns molten at dusk, Villa Claire occupies one of the island's most coveted viewpoints. Es Vedrà rises from the water directly ahead — a dark, mythic silhouette that commands every terrace, every sundowner, every quiet morning with a coffee. 
The architecture earns its place in the landscape: timber beams cross whitewashed ceilings, natural stone textures the walls, and light moves through the interiors with an unhurried ease. 
Two pools offer different moods for different hours of the day, while the layout — three bedrooms in the main house and two self-contained apartments — gives groups both togetherness and breathing room. 
Cala d'Hort and Cala Carbó are minutes away by car, but the pull to stay put, glass in hand, watching the sun dissolve behind that ancient rock, is strong. Some evenings, you won't make it further than the terrace.
