The villa is tastefully decorated by Maison Elephant and Bisc. Ibiza town is a 25 minutes away and Blue Marlin one of the famous beach clubs is reached in 15 minutes.

Right after entering the villa you step into the spacious living room and open plan kitchen. Numerous windows allow enjoying the fantastic seaviews. The living room has a large dining table that seats 10 persons and is equipped with a B&O sound system to enjoy music to its fullest. On this very same level, there is an outdoor area with a Boretti BBQ and dining table that seats 14 persons. The kitchen is of a high-quality standard, modern and equipped with Miele appliances. There are 3 refrigerators available, of which one is specifically for the wine.

On the lower level, there are 4 bedrooms, all with en-suite bathrooms with shower. The master bedroom has an en-suite bathroom with bath and shower. All bathrooms are furnished with top designer Philippe Starck materials. A unique aspect of this villa is that sea view is to be enjoyed from each bedroom. Through a separate entrance, the 5th spacious bedroom is to be reached, that also has an en-suite bathroom. All bedrooms are equipped with air-conditioning and a safe. Around the pool, there is a sufficient number of loungers and a cozy chill- out lounge corner with a fridge.

name: Villa Diso
tagline: Beautiful property close to the beach
summary: Cozy 4-bedroom house with one seperate bedroom is within walking distance to the beach. This beautiful villa offers stunning sea views and incredible sunsets. From the moment you step through the door, you’ll feel at…
description: Cozy 4-bedroom house with one seperate bedroom is within walking distance to the beach. This beautiful villa offers stunning sea views and incredible sunsets. From the moment you step through the door, you’ll feel at home with its cozy design and thoughtful attention to detail – this is not just another house, but a real home in a fantastic location.

The villa accommodates up to 8 guests with 4 bedrooms in the main house and an additional independent bedroom that can be used for staff. The interior features a spacious living area with large sliding doors that open to the pool area, offering breathtaking sea views and sunsets. The fully equipped open kitchen provides everything you need for a comfortable stay.

The bedrooms are thoughtfully arranged: Bedroom 1 has a double bed and en-suite bathroom with a shower. Bedroom 2 offers twin beds that can be joined, access to a covered terrace, and an attached bathroom with a shower. Bedroom 3 features a double bed, an en-suite bathroom with a shower, and access to the pool terrace. Bedroom 4 has twin beds that can be joined, an en-suite bathroom with a shower, and a private entrance from the pool terrace. Bedroom 5, located in the basement with independent access, includes a double bed and an external bathroom. This room is ideal as a spare bedroom or nanny room, as it does not match the same standard as the others.

The exterior boasts a welcoming Mediterranean garden with vibrant colors and several chill-out areas, perfect for socializing with family and friends or enjoying some quiet time alone. The garden features a large pool with sunbeds, an outdoor covered dining area with a barbecue, and a spacious table for everyone to gather and enjoy local specialties.

The villa is conveniently located within walking distance of Cala Vadella beach (150 meters), which is ideal for families and offers several restaurants, shops, and a supermarket. Parking is available on the public street, approximately 50 meters from the house.
Please note: The 5th bedroom has an external bathroom.

name: Villa Fico
tagline: Modern Oasis in Can Furnet
summary: Nestled within the prestigious gated community of Can Furnet, this villa offers a serene retreat just moments away from Ibiza’s renowned nightlife and pristine beaches. Elevated above the landscape, it provides…
description: Nestled within the prestigious gated community of Can Furnet, this villa offers a serene retreat just moments away from Ibiza’s renowned nightlife and pristine beaches. Elevated above the landscape, it provides breathtaking, uninterrupted views of Dalt Vila, the island’s historic old town, and the glistening Mediterranean Sea. This is not just a residence—it’s a harmonious blend of Ibiza’s timeless allure and modern sophistication.

The 2,302 m² private estate is a floral oasis, surrounded by lush greenery and designed for ultimate privacy. Located in a secure neighborhood with 24/7 gated access, CCTV surveillance, and regular security patrols, the villa combines tranquility and refined living in a seamless manner.

Inside, the villa features a fully equipped, high-end kitchen adorned with furnishings by Roche Bobois, opening to outdoor dining terraces and BBQ facilities perfect for al fresco gatherings. Spacious indoor and outdoor lounge areas invite relaxation, while underfloor heating, air conditioning, and a state-of-the-art Sonos music system enhance comfort and convenience.

Outside, a large swimming pool and meticulously landscaped gardens create a stunning setting for unwinding or entertaining. High-speed WiFi is available throughout, ensuring seamless connectivity for guests.

The villa offers five luxurious bedrooms, each accommodating two guests. Every bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom and is thoughtfully furnished with high-quality amenities and toiletries, ensuring a premium stay.
Whether basking by the pool, taking in the panoramic views, or exploring Ibiza’s vibrant surroundings, this villa promises an experience of unparalleled luxury and unforgettable moments.
-Currently, there are construction works taking place close to the property. However, according to Can Furnet regulations, no heavy construction works are permitted between 15 June and 15 September.

name: Villa Frankie
tagline: Formentera on the horizon, countryside silence at your door
summary: Perched in the sun-bleached hills between Es Cubells and Porroig, Villa Frankie occupies one of the south coast's most coveted positions — where terraced countryside rolls quietly toward the sea and Formentera…
description:
Perched in the sun-bleached hills between Es Cubells and Porroig, Villa Frankie occupies one of the south coast's most coveted positions — where terraced countryside rolls quietly toward the sea and Formentera materialises on the horizon like a brushstroke. 
Five bedrooms are arranged across the property with considered privacy in mind, each space thoughtfully separated so that large or mixed groups move through the villa with ease and independence. Inside, the interiors weave together raw Mediterranean materials and loose, bohemian warmth — linen textures, earthy tones, and open volumes that invite the outside air in. Multiple living areas across the main building mean there is always a corner to retreat to, whether for a slow morning coffee or an afternoon read in the shade. As the light shifts golden over the valley and Formentera blurs into the dusk, it becomes difficult to imagine being anywhere else.

name: Villa Heidi
tagline: White-on-white modernism, minutes from Ibiza Town's pulse
summary: Villa Heidi is a picturesque 5 bedroom modern property which is ideally located close to all of the attractions which the capital of the island, Ibiza Town, offers with its abundance of shops, restaurants and nightlife.
description: Villa Heidi is a picturesque 5 bedroom modern property which is ideally located close to all of the attractions which the capital of the island, Ibiza Town, offers with its abundance of shops, restaurants and nightlife.

As you enter Villa Heidi, you will instantly feel at home with the wide, spacious and inviting bright open plan lounge, dining room and fully equipped modern kitchen which benefits from floor to ceiling glass doors, flooding the house with the warming natural light of the Ibizan sun. The all white theme abounds throughout the house, adding to the clean and stylish charm of this exquisite property. The refined soft furnishings have been carefully selected to complement the elegance of the house and are perfectly complemented by pops of colour from contemporary art pieces throughout. The bedrooms all boast inviting queen size beds with en suite bathrooms. The only exception is the sixth bedroom which instead is adjoined as a connecting room, perfect for families travelling with small children.

Villa Heidi really comes into its own as you exit the house and take in the fragrant gardens and sizeable grounds. They stretch over acres of land with exceptional sea and country views. The crowning glory is decidedly the sloping infinity swimming pool, artfully surrounded by a traditional roman stone walled terrace and ample sunbeds. All together offer the perfect space to soak up the sun, along with several large, shaded chill out and lounging areas complete with luxury daybeds and a delightful outdoor dining area with bespoke BBQ.

name: Villa Ibiza Bay
tagline: Perfectly located elegant holiday home
summary: Experience the epitome of relaxation and luxury at the exquisite Villa Ibiza Bay, nestled in the captivating surroundings of Ibiza. This exceptional property offers an idyllic getaway for those seeking a truly exclusive…
description: Experience the epitome of relaxation and luxury at the exquisite Villa Ibiza Bay, nestled in the captivating surroundings of Ibiza. This exceptional property offers an idyllic getaway for those seeking a truly exclusive experience.

Spanning across 300 m², this meticulously designed villa boasts an elegant living room, a fully equipped kitchen, five spacious bedrooms, and five opulent bathrooms, accommodating up to ten discerning guests. Indulge in the seamless blend of comfort and style, with amenities including high-speed Wi-Fi (perfect for video calls), state-of-the-art televisions, air conditioning, heating, and a convenient washer and dryer, ensuring a truly lavish stay. Families with children will appreciate the availability of a crib and high chair, both provided at an additional cost.

Step into the private outdoor haven, where you will discover a captivating landscape featuring a pristine swimming pool, meticulously manicured gardens, a tranquil covered terrace, two inviting balconies, a deluxe barbecue area, and a refreshing outdoor shower. Additionally, guests have exclusive access to a shared uncovered terrace, providing an enchanting space to unwind and soak up the breathtaking surroundings.

For those seeking the finest culinary experiences, indulge in the nearby acclaimed restaurants, such as Hostal Talamanca, Nobu Ibiza, Lío, Trattoria del Mar, and It Eivissa. Embrace the vibrant nightlife scene with the renowned Pacha nightclub, while the stunning Talamanca beach and the esteemed Club Chinois are just a stone's throw away, offering endless entertainment options.

Rest assured with the convenience of three private parking spaces within the property, while complimentary street parking is readily available.
The villa warmly welcomes families with children, ensuring an unforgettable stay for guests of all ages.
Unleash the true essence of luxury by bringing along your beloved pet, as one well-behaved furry companion is permitted with an additional fee.
Indulge in an extraordinary escape at the prestigious Villa Ibiza Bay, where every detail has been carefully curated to create an unparalleled experience of exclusivity and refinement.

name: Villa Jaja
tagline: Ancient Olives, Lavender Air, and Poolside Afternoons in San Josep
summary:
Located near the charming village of Sant Josep, Villa Jaja is an authentic finca that has been recently renovated to perfection. 
This exquisite property seamlessly blends traditional features with classic design…
description:
Located near the charming village of Sant Josep, Villa Jaja is an authentic finca that has been recently renovated to perfection. 
This exquisite property seamlessly blends traditional features with classic design furniture, offering a style and comfort
The villa is set on an expansive 22,000 m² of beautifully landscaped gardens, featuring colorful lemon, fig, and olive trees, pines, yuccas, bougainvillea, lavender, and a variety of flowers and grass.

The living room is tastefully furnished with two comfortable sofas and features an elegant open plan kitchen with dining area and views out to the pool and back gardens.
The Tv Snug has a tv that only operates with the smart settings and no satellite stations.

The sleeping arrangements are as follows:
Located in the main villa you will find bedrooms 1 and 2.
Bedroom 1, King sized double bed with en suite bathroom with bath with shower. Doors open onto the back terrace
Bedroom 2, King sized double bed with en suite bathroom with shower. Walk in wardrobe. The bedroom has a bath in the bedroom and opens onto the back terrace.

Guest bedrooms 3 and 4 have no access to the main villa.
Bedroom 3, Double bedroom with en suite bathroom with shower
Bedroom 4, Double bedroom with en suite bathroom with shower

Outside various chill-out areas and day beds are strategically placed throughout the property, offering serene spots to unwind and enjoy the tranquility and there is Spacious outdoor dining areas are set amidst lush gardens, providing a picturesque setting for lunch and dinner

Villa Jaja is conveniently located near some of Ibiza's most beautiful beaches, including Cala Bassa and Cala Comte, renowned for their stunning sunsets and the village of Sant Jose with all its amenities is around a 5 minute drive.
Whether you are looking for a serene family getaway or a picturesque venue to entertain guests, Villa Jaja provides an unparalleled experience in the beautiful surroundings of Ibiza.

name: Villa Jeanette
tagline: Delightful house combining Ibizan architecture with comfort and quality finishings
summary: Between the charming village of Sant Jose and buzzing Ibiza town, in the middle of nature and far from the hustle and bustle, is the three-storey Villa Jeanette. This villa the perfect choice for all those who want to…
description: Between the charming village of Sant Jose and buzzing Ibiza town, in the middle of nature and far from the hustle and bustle, is the three-storey Villa Jeanette. This villa the perfect choice for all those who want to spend a relaxing holiday in wonderful surroundings and at the same time have the advantage of being near all the popular spots of the South.

This dream house combines Ibizan architecture with luxurious comfort and quality finishings. It has 2 ultra-modern fully equipped kitchens, 5 bedrooms, 5 modern bathrooms and a toilet. 5 of the bedrooms are located in the main house. The amenities include Wi-Fi, air conditioning, cable TV, toys, children's books, a crib and a highchair.

The most striking space is the outdoor area of lush green grounds, with the private swimming pool , illuminated at night and surrounded by several terraces with deckchairs and lounge furniture. From here you can enjoy the view of the mountain landscape and the lush vegetation, which guarantees a peaceful holiday with the highest level of privacy. The balcony also invites you to sunbathe or enjoy a good conversation with a glass of wine while the barbecue area promises the right culinary cuisine - no wish goes unfulfilled!

Many popular restaurants and beach clubs such as Blue Marlin or Playa den Bossa clubs and restaurants are in the vicinity and you can reach beautiful beaches with turquoise waters, such as Platja des Codols, Ses Salines, Es Cavallet, Cala Jondal or Platja d'en Bossa, easily by car. Parking is available on the property and on the road.

name: Villa Lyla
tagline: Spectacular designer home perfectly located close to Ibiza Town
summary: Be entranced by the grand entrance hall as you enter Villa Lyla, leading you through to a luxurious open plan lounge area and dining room, all flooded with natural light from the floor to ceiling windows. A fully…
description: Be entranced by the grand entrance hall as you enter Villa Lyla, leading you through to a luxurious open plan lounge area and dining room, all flooded with natural light from the floor to ceiling windows. A fully equipped modern kitchen is at your disposal should you wish to entertain and is of course equipped with all the modern day appliances you would expect. The house also benefits from a dedicated games room, and as you descend to the lower level, you can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, table tennis, basketball and cinema room.

Villa Lyla boasts of 5 equally luxurious suites, all of which are complete with king-size beds and en suite bathrooms. The master suite and 3 of the guest suites are situated on the first level and the further guest suite on the second level with one additional family suite.

Villa Lyla is an ideal property for family holidays, business retreats or elegant entertaining. Surrounded by perfectly maintained gardens, this superb home offers several expansive outdoor terraces, featuring a spectacular infinity pool and jacuzzi with unbroken views of the Mediterranean Sea and the surrounding countryside. The rooftop terrace offers a sophisticated seating and dining area, simply ideal for those endless summer evenings entertaining friends and family and enjoying sundowners under the stars in complete privacy.

name: Villa Marielle
tagline: A breathtaking property featuring expansive and impeccably designed outdoor living spaces
summary: Villa Marielle is an exclusive 5-bedroom private residence defined by its refined design and quiet elegance. Set in a secluded location between the village of San José and the iconic bay of Cala Jondal—home to some of…
description: Villa Marielle is an exclusive 5-bedroom private residence defined by its refined design and quiet elegance. Set in a secluded location between the village of San José and the iconic bay of Cala Jondal—home to some of Ibiza’s most sought-after beach destinations—the villa offers both privacy and proximity.

Inside, contemporary design is balanced with natural warmth. Polished wood floors and carefully selected furnishings create a calm and inviting atmosphere, enhanced by natural light throughout. Each of the five bedrooms features its own en-suite bathroom, finished with high-quality materials and a clean, modern aesthetic.
The master suite is designed as a private retreat, complete with shower, bathtub, hammam, and direct access to a secluded Jacuzzi and chill-out area.

Surrounded by landscaped gardens of mature palms and pine trees, the outdoor areas are designed for both relaxation and entertaining. At the center of the property sits a striking infinity pool, complemented by a private padel court, pétanque pitch, outdoor cinema, and curated garden spaces.

Expansive terraces offer multiple lounge areas, an al fresco dining space, and a second shaded lounge set within a beach-style setting. A fully equipped outdoor bar with seating for up to 30 guests creates a natural focal point for hosting and social gatherings.
Villa Marielle is ideal for smaller groups seeking a private, design-led property with strong outdoor living and easy access to Cala Jondal.

name: Villa Monica
tagline: Five bedrooms, three legendary beaches, one very quiet corner of Ibiza
summary: Tucked away in a private, peaceful setting on Ibiza’s west coast, Villa Monica is a beautifully renovated five-bedroom retreat where sleek contemporary design meets understated elegance. A local beach is within walking…
description: Tucked away in a private, peaceful setting on Ibiza’s west coast, Villa Monica is a beautifully renovated five-bedroom retreat where sleek contemporary design meets understated elegance. A local beach is within walking distance, and the island’s most celebrated sunset coves, Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and Cala Tarida, are just a short drive away.

Inside, vintage charm and modern sophistication blend effortlessly with traditional Ibicenco character. High-end finishes and carefully curated décor create a warm yet refined atmosphere throughout the living spaces. At the heart of the home lies an exceptional kitchen, a dream for keen cooks and private chefs alike, with triple ovens, two Miele dishwashers, two fridge-freezers and a Nespresso machine.
The five spacious bedrooms are true havens of comfort, each with sumptuous bedding, air conditioning and a sleek en-suite bathroom.

Outdoors, a sprawling fenced garden surrounds the shimmering saltwater pool, making the villa ideal for families with children. Generous terraces and shaded lounging areas set the scene for lazy afternoons and sunset cocktails, while the bespoke outdoor kitchen, with its premium barbecue and dining area, makes entertaining under the stars effortless.

The charming villages of Sant Agustí and Sant Josep are only a short drive away, and the glamour of Ibiza Town, with its acclaimed restaurants, boutiques and legendary nightlife, is within easy reach. After a day of exploring, Villa Monica welcomes you back to a world of calm, privacy and effortless style, the perfect Ibiza escape for families and friends.

name: Villa Nia
tagline: A stunning property located close to Cala Jondal
summary: Villa Nia is a uniquely designed 5 bedroom property perfectly situated in one of the most desirable areas of Ibiza, and offers spectacular views over Cala Jondal, the sparkling Mediterranean sea and the surrounding…
description: Villa Nia is a uniquely designed 5 bedroom property perfectly situated in one of the most desirable areas of Ibiza, and offers spectacular views over Cala Jondal, the sparkling Mediterranean sea and the surrounding countryside and coastline landscape.

Upon entering this modern, minimalist style home, the spacious hall leads into the large and tastefully decorated living room which is flooded with the glorious Ibizan sunlight through floor to ceiling sliding glass doors which emphasis the full effect of the unrivaled sea views. Careful attention has been paid to every detail for your comfort and luxury and tasteful decoration abounds throughout every part of this sophisticated villa.

A modern fully equipped kitchen offers you the option to extend out onto the outdoor covered terrace and al fresco dining area for entertaining, or alternatively set a more formal evening scene for your guests in the large interior dining room located in an adjacent and open plan style to the stylish kitchen. Villa Nia offers clean and bright contemporary interiors throughout which is enhanced with neutral and well chosen decor. All bedrooms are luxuriously furnished with en-suite or connecting bathrooms and some have access to their owner private terrace.

Step outside and spend a long lazy day soaking up the healing rays of the Ibizan sunshine around the fabulous pool area, which is surrounded by ample luxurious sun loungers, with a large outdoor dining area complete with BBQ and an incredibly inviting and comfortable shaded chill-out area providing an ideal space to truly appreciate the sea views, relax and reflect after another idyllic day.
Villa Nia also offers a full size tennis court just meters from the main house ideal for sport oriented holiday makers or for anyone who wishes to fine tune any long lost skills.

name: Villa Obsidian
tagline: Architectural Masterpiece with Panoramic Sea Views
summary: There are villas. And then there is Villa Obsidian.
description: There are villas. And then there is Villa Obsidian.

Carved into the pine-clad hills above Santa Eulalia, this fully renovated contemporary residence is a statement of absolute luxury — the kind of property that stops conversations before they begin. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls dissolve the boundary between inside and out, framing an unbroken 180° panorama of the Mediterranean that stretches from the old town's rooftops to the open sea. Wake to Ibiza's sunrise flooding the bay with gold. Go to sleep with the lights of the marina shimmering below.

The architecture is as dramatic as the setting: soaring volumes, polished marble floors, warm oak panelling and brushed metal accents compose an interior that belongs in the pages of the world's finest design publications. Original contemporary artworks punctuate every room — this is not a rental property dressed up in luxury. It is a private art residence that simply happens to take your breath away.

Fully renovated within the last two years, Villa Obsidian accommodates up to 10 guests across five spectacular suites. For those who will not compromise on privacy, quality or design, the search ends here.

The Grand Salon
The living room is the soul of Villa Obsidian — a vast, double-aspect grand salon that flows seamlessly between lounge, library and sea-view terrace. Oversized floor-to-ceiling sliding doors fold entirely away, flooding the space with Mediterranean light and merging interior living with the outdoors. Statement sculptures, international designer furniture and a bold, curated art collection make this a room you want to linger in long after the sun has set.

Adjacent, the dining table — emerald velvet chairs set around a custom marble table beneath a sculpted gold light installation — seats ten and transforms every meal into an occasion. A private bar and climate-controlled wine cellar complete the picture, stocked with a curated selection of Mediterranean wines and champagnes for evenings that need no itinerary.

The Kitchen
Designed for the serious host, the designer kitchen is fully equipped with professional-grade appliances and every tool a private chef could require. Marble surfaces, integrated cabinetry and seamless lines keep the aesthetic at the highest level, while the layout makes cooking for a full group effortless.

Outdoor Living
The terraces of Villa Obsidian are where Ibiza truly happens.

Multiple outdoor spaces cascade down the hillside, each with its own character: a covered pergola terrace with a long teak dining table for alfresco lunches with the sea as backdrop; a lounge terrace framed by bougainvillea in full bloom; and a rooftop terrace with a round dining set positioned to catch every degree of the panoramic view. A professional BBQ and fully equipped outdoor summer kitchen make long outdoor dinners both effortless and exceptional.
The landscaped Mediterranean gardens — palm trees, flowering shrubs, stone pathways — offer seclusion at every turn. This is an outdoor environment designed not just for beauty, but for living.

Wellness — The Indoor Pool & Gallery
Villa Obsidian's most extraordinary feature: a heated indoor pool housed in a double-height glass pavilion that opens directly onto the sea-view terraces. The space functions simultaneously as a private wellness studio and a curated art gallery — bold contemporary canvases set against warm linen-textured walls, reflected in the still water below. Whether you swim at sunrise or simply sit beside the water as evening falls, it is an experience that no other rental property on the island can offer.

Alongside it, a fully equipped open-air gym beneath a slatted timber pergola overlooks the sea. Cardio machines, a complete weight-training station and a free-weight area mean guests never need to leave the property to maintain their routine.

The Suites
Five bedrooms — all with private en-suite bathrooms — are conceived as true suites: spacious, serene, and finished to a level that rivals the world's finest boutique hotels. Upholstered king beds, botanical-print wallpapers, designer pendant lighting and deep-soaking freestanding bathtubs define a sleep environment of genuine indulgence. The two sea-view suites open onto private terraces with the bay laid out below; the remaining three look over the Mediterranean gardens.

The bathrooms are architectural statements in their own right — gold-tiled rain shower enclosures, sculptural freestanding tubs, LED-lit mirrors and premium marble surfaces create a spa experience that is entirely private.

Location
Villa Obsidian sits in one of Santa Eulalia's most coveted residential pockets — elevated above the bay, east-facing so that every morning begins with Ibiza's sunrise painting the water. Mediterranean pines surround the property, yet the marina, Nikki Beach, Las Dalias and the island's finest beach clubs are all within ten minutes. Ibiza Town is a fifteen-minute drive. The airport, twenty-five.
Seclusion without sacrifice. The island at your feet. A minimum of 48 hours' advance notice is required for all arrivals,

name: Villa Ocean Vista
tagline: Stunning frontline property with sea views available for rent in Es Cubells, Ibiza
summary: Located within one of Ibiza’s most prestigious gated communities along the coastline of the Es Cubells Natural Park, Ocean Vista enjoys a privileged setting in a truly remarkable Mediterranean landscape. This area has…
description: Located within one of Ibiza’s most prestigious gated communities along the coastline of the Es Cubells Natural Park, Ocean Vista enjoys a privileged setting in a truly remarkable Mediterranean landscape. This area has long been considered one of the island’s most desirable locations for luxury villas, offering privacy, dramatic scenery and uninterrupted sea views across the southern coast of Ibiza.

Recently renovated in a refined and contemporary style, the villa blends modern comfort with elegant Mediterranean living. Expansive terraces and landscaped gardens surround the property, creating several outdoor spaces designed for relaxation and entertaining. At the centre of the exterior area lies a distinctive oasis-shaped swimming pool, complemented by sun loungers and generous outdoor dining areas where guests can enjoy long lunches or sunset dinners overlooking the sea.

Inside, Ocean Vista features five spacious bedrooms, all benefiting from beautiful sea views, air conditioning and direct access to outdoor terraces. Four bedrooms, including an impressive master suite, are located on the upper floor of the main house, offering elevated perspectives across the coastline. The fifth double bedroom is positioned on the lower level and opens directly onto the pool terrace, providing privacy and easy access to the outdoor areas.

A wide stone staircase leads to the main living level, where a bright living and dining area is filled with natural light through large windows framing the gardens and the Mediterranean beyond. The living room opens onto a shaded porch and the main garden terrace, creating a natural flow between indoor and outdoor living. Adjacent to this space is a spacious, fully equipped kitchen that also connects to an outdoor breakfast area, ideal for relaxed mornings or meals prepared by a private chef.
The villa also features a newly installed gym, allowing guests to maintain their fitness routine while enjoying the tranquility and privacy of the property.

With its panoramic sea views, elegant renovation, expansive terraces, landscaped gardens, oasis-style swimming pool and new gym, Ocean Vista offers a refined and private retreat in one of Ibiza’s most exclusive coastal settings—ideal for families or groups seeking both relaxation and proximity to the island’s finest beaches and restaurants.

name: Villa Paola
tagline: An elegant and stylish villa close to Cala Jondal
summary: Villa Paola is a modern 5 bedroom private property which enjoys an elevated countryside view within walking distance to Cala Jondal beach, home to the renowned and exclusive Blue Marlin Beach Club. The home is…
description: Villa Paola is a modern 5 bedroom private property which enjoys an elevated countryside view within walking distance to Cala Jondal beach, home to the renowned and exclusive Blue Marlin Beach Club. The home is surrounded by extensive land and lavish gardens. The villa's living areas and bedrooms are split over several levels.

Upon entering Villa Paola, you will delight in the open plan fully equipped kitchen, leading you naturally through to a spacious lounge offering large comfortable sofa seating and an accommodating dining area; all of which have floods of natural light through the floor to ceiling windows and simply unforgettable seaviews. Exquisite attention to detail means that his home is at once welcoming yet sophisticated and opulent, giving a feeling of luxury throughout,

All of the double bedrooms are superbly decorated with the elegant theme flowing through this most stylish of homes. Your every comfort is catered for with state of the art furnishings and decoration, each room has an en-suite bathroom, with the master suite benefiting from its own bath tub and huge terrace and panoramic views from the top of the villa. There is also a private gym available for use.

Of course, the exteriors and grounds of Villa Paola are equally grand, with several terraces on different levels complete with luxurious sun drenched and shaded chill out areas.There is a fabulous infinity pool with several sun loungers as well as four poster day beds for you and your guests to recline and reflect. The beautifully landscape and well maintained grounds and lush, fragrant Mediterranean gardens are home to a stunning Balinese gazebo, purposely designed with al fresco dining in mind. The expansive outdoor space is the perfect place to truly immerse yourself in the spectacular views.

name: Villa Paraiso
tagline: Beautiful Spanish villa in Sa Caleta
summary: Escape to Villa Paraiso, a luxurious Spanish villa located in a stunning natural oasis above the picturesque village of Sa Caleta, Ibiza. Surrounded by lush greenery and offering breathtaking sea views, this spacious…
description: Escape to Villa Paraiso, a luxurious Spanish villa located in a stunning natural oasis above the picturesque village of Sa Caleta, Ibiza. Surrounded by lush greenery and offering breathtaking sea views, this spacious retreat provides the perfect setting for a relaxing vacation, corporate retreat, or workation.

The villa has five beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom and air conditioning. Three of the bedrooms have private terraces, one of which features a roof terrace with panoramic views. The large open-plan living space includes a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, and there are two outdoor kitchens—one for BBQs and one for preparing traditional paella.

Step outside to enjoy the 15x5 meter swimming pool, complete with a pool bar, or unwind in the 4-person jacuzzi. The villa also offers plenty of seating areas both inside and outside, allowing your group to spread out and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. For added convenience, there is fast Wi-Fi throughout the villa and ample parking space.

Villa Paraiso is ideally located just a short walk from the beach and a 10-minute drive from Ibiza’s most popular attractions. A bio supermarket is within walking distance for your daily needs, and the airport is only a 7-minute drive away.

Enhance your stay with a range of activities, hiking, mountain biking, horse riding, personal training, yoga, meditation, boxing, and more. You can also book a delightful BBQ or paella evening for a true taste of the island.

Whether you're here for a peaceful getaway, a corporate event, or a memorable celebration with friends and family, Villa Paraiso offers the ultimate Ibiza experience with luxury, comfort, and adventure at your fingertips.
*Booking requests are subject to final owner confirmation after June 1st

name: Villa Pins
tagline: A beautiful villa in the heart of the island
summary: Welcome to this exquisite and luminous chalet nestled in the serene and picturesque rural area of Can Tomás, situated between San Rafael and San Antonio. This stunning retreat boasts a private saltwater pool, adding a…
description: Welcome to this exquisite and luminous chalet nestled in the serene and picturesque rural area of Can Tomás, situated between San Rafael and San Antonio. The design philosophy of Can Mambo extends to the sleeping quarters, where each of the four exquisite bedroom suites is adorned with superb design features and all the comforts you could desire. This attention to detail ensures a restful and rejuvenating experience for all guests.

One of the standout features of Can Mambo is the breathtaking panoramic views from the top floor, which encompass the iconic fort of Dalt Vila—an emblem of Ibiza's rich history—and the sparkling Mediterranean Sea. This stunning backdrop adds to the villa's allure, providing a picturesque setting for relaxation and leisure.

Outside, the tranquil swimming pool is surrounded by lush garden lawns, creating a serene oasis for guests to unwind. The bespoke outdoor dining space is perfect for hosting long, leisurely lunches with friends or enjoying starlit cocktail gatherings, making it an ideal venue for entertaining.

Can Mambo offers a comprehensive experience that goes beyond its luxurious accommodations, melding comfort, style, and the allure of Ibiza's vibrant lifestyle. Here’s a closer look at the various features and benefits of this exquisite property:

- Architectural Design: The villa's architectural design is a testament to modern elegance, characterized by clean lines and an open layout that enhances natural light throughout the space. Large windows and sliding glass doors blur the lines between indoor and outdoor living, allowing guests to fully embrace the stunning surroundings.

- Interior Decor: The interior of Can Mambo is a visual delight, with a decor that speaks to a sophisticated taste. The careful selection of furnishings blends contemporary chic with traditional touches, creating a warm yet stylish ambiance. The use of high-quality materials and finishes ensures that every detail is taken care of, contributing to an overall sense of luxury.

- Spacious Living Areas: The living areas are designed for both relaxation and socializing. The open-plan layout encourages a natural flow from the living room to the dining area and kitchen, making it an ideal space for entertaining guests. Comfortable seating arrangements invite you to unwind after a day of exploring the island, while the dining area is perfect for enjoying meals together.

- Gourmet Kitchen: The well-equipped kitchen features modern appliances and ample counter space, catering to those who enjoy cooking. Whether preparing a casual breakfast or a gourmet dinner, the kitchen is designed to meet all culinary needs. Guests can also opt for private chefs to enhance their dining experience, allowing them to savor local and international cuisine without any hassle.

- Luxurious Bedroom Suites: Each of the four bedroom suites is a sanctuary of comfort and style. Thoughtfully designed with plush bedding, en-suite bathrooms, and ample storage, these rooms provide a peaceful retreat for guests. The decor in each suite is unique, ensuring that everyone enjoys their own personal space while still feeling connected to the overall aesthetic of the villa.

- Outdoor Oasis: The outdoor spaces at Can Mambo are truly enchanting. The swimming pool, surrounded by lush gardens, serves as a serene backdrop for relaxation. Guests can lounge on sunbeds, take refreshing dips, or simply bask in the sun. The bespoke outdoor dining area is perfect for al fresco meals, allowing you to enjoy the balmy Ibiza evenings under the stars.

- Ideal for Families and Groups: Can Mambo is well-suited for families or groups of friends looking to create lasting memories. The spacious layout allows for both shared experiences and private moments, making it an ideal setting for reunions, celebrations, or simply enjoying quality time together. The tranquil environment promotes relaxation, while the proximity to local attractions ensures that there's always something to explore.

The lively Ibiza Town offers a plethora of dining, shopping, and entertainment options, ensuring that guests can immerse themselves in the island's dynamic culture. The nearby beaches, such as Talamanca, are perfect for sunbathing, water sports, and enjoying beach clubs.

- Wellness and Relaxation: In addition to the pool, Can Mambo offers opportunities for wellness and relaxation. Guests can practice yoga on the terrace, enjoy spa treatments at nearby wellness centers, or simply take leisurely strolls through the picturesque surroundings.

In essence, Can Mambo is not just a place to stay; it’s a luxurious sanctuary that embodies the beauty and spirit of Ibiza. Whether you prefer lounging by the pool, enjoying the nearby beaches, or indulging in the local culture, this elegant villa provides an unforgettable escape in one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

description: Charming Ibiza-Style Villa in Sa Coma

Set on a sprawling 15,000 m² estate with centuries-old olive trees and vineyards, this traditional Ibiza-style villa offers the perfect countryside escape. Nestled in the serene Sa Coma region, the property is surrounded by nature and just a 10-minute drive from Ibiza Town.
Outdoor Living and Arrival

Upon arrival, a picturesque pathway leads you to the villa’s entrance, the swimming pool, and the barbecue area. A spacious terrace stretches along the front of the house, furnished with outdoor seating and a large dining table, ideal for enjoying meals and gatherings al fresco. Meeting spaces are surrounded by lush gardens filled with native plants and colorful flowers, creating an atmosphere of peace and natural beauty.
Kitchen and Dining Area

Stepping through the rustic wooden door, you enter the well-equipped kitchen and dining space. Complete with modern appliances and all necessary utensils, this area serves as the heart of the home, connecting the outdoor spaces with the living room and bedrooms.
Cozy Living Room

The living room, adjacent to the terraces, serves as a central gathering place. With inviting furnishings, a fireplace, and traditional juniper-beamed ceilings, it offers a warm and cozy ambiance where you can relax with friends and family.
Bedrooms and Sleeping Arrangements
The villa features 5 charming bedrooms with wooden ceilings, exterior windows, and tasteful Mediterranean décor. The sleeping arrangements include:

1 King-Size Bed: Spacious and luxurious, perfect for a restful night.
 2 Queen-Size Beds: Designed for single occupancy, offering comfort and space.
 4 Single Beds: Ideal for those who prefer individual sleeping arrangements.
Bathrooms

The villa offers 2 full bathrooms, each with a shower, sink, toilet, and bidet. Shower and hand towels are provided for all guests.
Additional Spaces

Next to the living room, there’s a quiet nook for reading or working, complete with a desk and views of the beautiful countryside.
Outdoor Leisure and Pool Area

The pool area is a true haven, surrounded by fruit trees, palm trees, and wildflowers. Sun loungers invite you to relax under the sun, while a nearby covered space offers a barbecue, a wood oven, and a large table — perfect for outdoor feasts with loved ones.
Modern Comforts in a Natural Setting
The villa is equipped with free Wi-Fi and a generous recreation area where you can connect with nature and experience the authentic essence of Ibiza.

With its thoughtful layout, this property is ideal for groups of friends, families, or anyone looking to share special moments together. We are committed to ensuring your stay is both enjoyable and memorable.

name: Can Sabina
tagline: Luxurious finca-bungalow style house with pool on private plot.
summary: Spacious and luxurious single-level villa in finca bungalow style, set on a private plot within a protected nature reserve on Ibiza’s south coast. The property is just a 12-minute walk from Cala Jondal, home to iconic…
description: Spacious and luxurious single-level villa in finca bungalow style, set on a private plot within a protected nature reserve on Ibiza’s south coast. The property is just a 12-minute walk from Cala Jondal, home to iconic beach venues such as Jondal, Blue Marlin and Es Xarcu, and a 10-minute walk from the exclusive bay and restaurant Es Torrent.

The villa offers a stylish yet cosy living area, a modern open-plan kitchen with dining space, an outdoor kitchen and bar, four bedrooms (including a master suite and a second bedroom with en-suite bathrooms), plus an additional guest bathroom. Double-glazed windows throughout provide comfort year-round, protecting from summer heat and cooler winter nights.
The living area opens onto a generous covered porch leading to a 10 x 4.5-metre swimming pool, surrounded by a natural stone sun terrace and bar—ideal for outdoor living and entertaining.

Set on approximately 2.5 acres (1 hectare), the grounds combine open sunny areas with mature pine trees, a small orchard and a vegetable garden, creating a refined yet natural atmosphere. The property is accessed via a tarmac road and benefits from central heating, air conditioning, electricity, water from a communal cistern and private well, high-speed internet, satellite TV, laundry facilities and ample parking. Despite its countryside setting, the villa offers excellent privacy and security through solid walls and fencing.

name: Can Sef
tagline: An Extraordinary Coastal Treasure with Private Mediterranean Access
summary: A very special, one-of-a-kind house with direct access to turquoise color Mediterranean waters. Almost entirely sea facing and covering over 800 square meters between indoor and outdoor spaces and terraces. Central…
description: A very special, one-of-a-kind house with direct access to turquoise color Mediterranean waters. Almost entirely sea facing and covering over 800 square meters between indoor and outdoor spaces and terraces. Central air-conditioning with independent controls in each room guarantees perfect temperatures. Notwithstanding this feature, the house tends to benefit from a cool and mild sea breeze during summers given its front-line position. An over two thousand year old olive tree next to the car parking area makes for an impressive entrance.

The main house includes four double bedrooms, each with sea views and an en-suite bathroom. There is also a living room with over four meter high ceilings, a dining area for ten or more people, separate quarters for a maid, and a chef’s kitchen where amazing meals can be served for an additional fee. Outside, there are numerous terraces with seating areas and stunning sea views, an infinity pool and over two acres of forest land for quiet strolls. The house is fully equipped, with internet access and cable TV.

The Master Suite is at a lower level relative to the rest of the house and benefits from its own private terrace. When the four meter wide glass window-door is open, indoor and outdoor areas merge into one. From the king size bed, only the blue sea and a green forest of pine trees are visible. The same panoramic view can be enjoyed while relaxing in a bubble bath. For those eager to start their day with a swim, the sea is a mere one hundred and fifty steps below.

A secluded cove, close to the beautiful beach of Es Figueral, can be reached from the house. A snorkelers and swimmers paradise. Definitely a top offer for those looking for a dream holiday in the most genuine side of the island.

name: Can Simo
tagline: Stylish villa with sea views 10 min from Botafoch
summary: Villa Simo is a stylish 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom villa located in the exclusive area of Can Pep Simó, offering a unique blend of retro charm and modern comfort. Set across two levels, the property boasts breathtaking sea…
description: Villa Simo is a stylish 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom villa located in the exclusive area of Can Pep Simó, offering a unique blend of retro charm and modern comfort. Set across two levels, the property boasts breathtaking sea views and a serene setting that makes it perfect for relaxation.

The villa features a spacious master bedroom on the first floor, complete with an ensuite bathroom, walk-in wardrobe, and a private terrace overlooking the sea. The second main bedroom, also on the first floor, includes its own ensuite bathroom, a walk-in wardrobe, and a charming balcony with panoramic mountain views. On the ground floor, a bright and comfortable third bedroom comes with a full annex bathroom, ideal for guests or family members. The fourth bedroom, known as the Garden Pool Room, is accessed externally and offers direct access to the garden and pool area, providing an added layer of privacy.

The villa's outdoor space is equally inviting, with a private garden, swimming pool, and a barbecue area that’s perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Inside, Villa Simo is styled with a mix of modern mid-century and 70s-inspired interiors, showcasing a curated selection of new and authentic vintage furniture that’s been expertly refurbished to create a warm, sophisticated atmosphere. The fully equipped kitchen includes everything needed for comfortable, effortless living.

Ideally located, Villa Simo is just a 10-minute drive from Ibiza Town, 5 minutes from the Marina and Talamanca Beach, and only 15 minutes from the airport. With 230 square meters of built space, beautiful design, and incredible views, this home offers an elegant and timeless escape in one of Ibiza’s most desirable neighborhoods.

name: Cana Celeste
tagline: A Countryside Finca Where Orchard Air Meets Barefoot Sophistication
summary: Santa Eulalia's rolling interior unfolds quietly around this centuries-old finca — terraced orchards, warm stone walls, and the kind of deep countryside silence that Ibiza's coastline rarely offers.
description: Santa Eulalia's rolling interior unfolds quietly around this centuries-old finca — terraced orchards, warm stone walls, and the kind of deep countryside silence that Ibiza's coastline rarely offers.

Cana Celeste earns its name in the quality of its light: golden through the day, celestial by evening. The ground floor moves easily between cool, whitewashed living spaces and the sun-warmed terrace, where a private pool mirrors the hills beyond. Three bedrooms on this level are serene and considered — linen textures, private bathrooms, natural tones that ask nothing of you. Climb to the master suite and the landscape opens fully: a king bed framed by terrace doors, orchard views stretching to the horizon, and a bathroom where a deep soaking tub and Balinese shower make the ritual of evening genuinely unhurried.
Close your eyes and you can already hear the cicadas settling in.

name: Cana Safari
tagline: Whitewashed walls, harbour views, and golden-hour skies over Cap Martinet
summary: Cap Martinet sits on Ibiza's quieter eastern flank, where the island exhales. Here, just minutes from the shore and within easy reach of the harbour, Cana Safari channels the unhurried elegance of traditional Ibizan…
description: Cap Martinet sits on Ibiza's quieter eastern flank, where the island exhales. Here, just minutes from the shore and within easy reach of the harbour, Cana Safari channels the unhurried elegance of traditional Ibizan architecture — thick whitewashed walls, warm contemporary interiors, and a deep connection to the landscape around it.

The outdoor space is the heart of the house: a generous pool catches the afternoon light while multiple lounge areas invite long, languid afternoons. Come evening, the western sky ignites, and the terrace becomes the best seat on the island. Twin BBQs — gas and charcoal — mean dinner is never rushed, and a Sonos system carries music from room to terrace without effort. Inside, four well-considered bedrooms offer genuine comfort after days spent between sea and sun.
Picture yourself here on a warm July evening, glass in hand, watching the harbour lights flicker to life below.

name: Cana Sole
tagline: Sun-Drenched Sa Carroca Retreat With a Private Guest House
summary: Sa Carroca sits in the quietly coveted heartland of southern Ibiza — close enough to the salt flats and shoreline, far enough from the noise. Cana Sole captures that balance perfectly.
description: Sa Carroca sits in the quietly coveted heartland of southern Ibiza — close enough to the salt flats and shoreline, far enough from the noise. Cana Sole captures that balance perfectly.

The main house unfolds across four bedrooms and three bathrooms, where clean contemporary lines soften into warm, lived-in comfort. Air conditioning keeps things cool through the long Ibizan afternoons, while the layout opens naturally toward the outdoors, drawing you outside at every turn. A fully independent guest house adds two more sleeping spaces and a private bathroom — ideal for a family who wants proximity without sacrifice of privacy. Beyond the threshold, generous terraces stretch toward a pool framed by sun-bleached stone and open sky. The beaches of the south — Es Cavallet, Ses Salines — are minutes away.
Picture a late morning here: coffee in hand, the day entirely unscheduled, the light already gold.

name: Casa Alhena
tagline: Modern Comfort Steps from Santa Eulalia Town
summary: Contemporary villa located in Santa Eulalia, just a short and pleasant walk from the town center, supermarkets, shops, restaurants, and the marina. Offering both privacy and convenience, this spacious home sits on a…
description: Contemporary villa located in Santa Eulalia, just a short and pleasant walk from the town center, supermarkets, shops, restaurants, and the marina. Offering both privacy and convenience, this spacious home sits on a plot of approximately 850 m² and boasts a built area of 360 m² distributed over two levels.

On the ground floor, the villa features a bright entrance hall that connects to covered verandas ideal for relaxing or enjoying your morning coffee. The main living room is spacious and filled with natural light, with large sliding doors that open directly to the garden and pool area, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The open-plan kitchen and dining space is both functional and elegant, perfect for everyday use and entertaining guests.

This level also includes two double bedrooms that share a modern bathroom, and a third double bedroom with its own private en-suite bathroom, offering additional privacy. There is also a guest toilet on this floor for added convenience.

Upstairs, the master suite occupies the entire second floor, providing a true sense of retreat. This space includes a private lounge area, a large en-suite bathroom, and direct access to a spacious terrace with views over the garden and surrounding area.

The outdoor area is designed for relaxed Mediterranean living. The garden is landscaped with mature trees and lush greenery, creating a peaceful oasis. There is a generous swimming pool with a surrounding sun deck, a built-in barbecue area ideal for al-fresco dining, and an outdoor rain shower for cooling off on hot summer days.
With its ideal location and thoughtful layout, this villa is perfect for families and friends seeking aholiday home in one of Ibiza’s most desirable towns.

name: Casa Can Tina
tagline: Casa Can Tina presented a large pool in a central location nest to Ibiza town
summary: Experience the beauty and simplicity of this peaceful yet centrally located accommodation. This enchanting villa is situated in a rural and tranquil area of San Jordi, an idyllic village in the south of the island, in…
description: Experience the beauty and simplicity of this peaceful yet centrally located accommodation. This enchanting villa is situated in a rural and tranquil area of San Jordi, an idyllic village in the south of the island, in close proximity to the breathtaking Las Salinas beach.
Here, you will find a wonderful residential area with friendly neighbors, yet absolute privacy. From the upstairs of the house, you can enjoy a view all the way to Las Salinas.

The interior of the villa is characterized by its modern design yet cozy charm. You will find all the amenities you need for a unique vacation. The spacious living room with high ceilings invites you to relax and features a charming wood-burning fireplace. Adjacent to it is a fully equipped kitchen with two large refrigerators, a central island, and all the necessary amenities, including a breakfast table for up to 8 people. From the kitchen, you have direct access to the pool area, which is perfect for unwinding.

The villa offers a total of 4 spacious double bedrooms (1 x 180 x 200 + 3 x 160 x 200), two with its own en-suite bathroom and built-in wardrobe. Here, you will find peace and comfort for a restful sleep.

Outside, a wonderful veranda awaits you, complete with a large dining table for up to 10 people. Here, you can enjoy shared meals in the open air. Next to it, you will find the spacious swimming pool, surrounded by sun loungers, a cozy chill-out area, and a barbecue area. All of this is framed by majestic palm trees, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
Amenities include a coffee machine with a grinder, a kettle, a citrus press, a blender, a toaster, and a sandwich maker. You will find everything you need for your culinary adventures.
The distances to key destinations are extremely convenient: the airport is only 5 minutes away, the vibrant city of Ibiza can be reached in 10 minutes.
A cleaning service can be arranged ($$$) so that you don't have to worry about anything during your stay.
This villa is ideal for an unforgettable family vacation, but also perfect for couples or a group of friends looking to explore Ibiza together.

name: Casa Canela
tagline: Private Family Villa with Pool and Pine Forest Views near Ibiza Town
summary: Casa Canela is a warm and inviting Mediterranean villa set in a peaceful pine-forest environment, just a short drive from Ibiza Town, Jesús, the Marina, and the island’s most renowned beaches and restaurants. Designed…
description: Casa Canela is a warm and inviting Mediterranean villa set in a peaceful pine-forest environment, just a short drive from Ibiza Town, Jesús, the Marina, and the island’s most renowned beaches and restaurants. Designed for relaxed family stays and easy island living, the property offers privacy, comfort, and a natural connection to its surroundings.

The villa features bright, single-level interiors with a calm, understated aesthetic. Two welcoming living areas provide comfortable spaces to relax and dine, filled with natural light and opening directly onto the garden. The fully equipped kitchen is practical and well integrated for everyday use, making the house ideal for longer stays and shared moments.

Casa Canela accommodates up to eight guests across four cozy double bedrooms, all styled in soft Mediterranean tones and equipped with air conditioning. The villa includes two full bathrooms and an additional guest toilet, finished with clean, modern materials.

Outdoors, a wooden-decked swimming pool is surrounded by mature pine trees, sun loungers, and shaded seating areas, creating a private and tranquil atmosphere. Several outdoor dining and lounge spaces invite long summer lunches, poolside afternoons, and relaxed evenings under the trees.

Additional features include private parking, security system, and the option of a baby cot. A discreet caretaker lives in an independent annex on the property, ensuring the villa remains well maintained throughout your stay while fully respecting guest privacy.

Combining a calm natural setting with fast access to Ibiza’s lifestyle highlights, Casa Canela is an ideal choice for families or groups of friends seeking comfort, privacy, and an authentic Mediterranean villa experience.

tagline: Ibizan style house with stunning views to Es Vedra
summary: This beautiful white villa is located in an easy accesible part of Cala D’hort natural park, overlooking, the famous rock of Es Vedra, on the sunset side of Ibiza. The beach of Cala d’Hort with its unbelievably…
description: This beautiful white villa is located in an easy accesible part of Cala D’hort natural park, overlooking, the famous rock of Es Vedra, on the sunset side of Ibiza. The beach of Cala d’Hort with its unbelievably turquoise waters and its excellent seafood restaurants is just a short drive downhill. Cala Carbo, Cala Vadella and Es Cubells are also a short drive away, all of them offering super nice restaurants, services, and water activities for all ages.

Casa d'Hort enjoys very quiet surroundings due to its privileged location, with very few neighbours around. The hill where it was built offers direct sunset views over miles of Mediterranean intense blue waters.

Decoration is modern and fresh, always with comfort in mind, trying to preserve the spirit of the original Ibizan house. It breathes a relaxed and cozy atmosphere that invites guests to enjoy its large outdoor spaces, always with the image of Es Vedra domintaing the views in the distance.

In the main level of the house, we find the 4 double bedrooms surrounding its large living and dining area. The rounded pool is surrounded by several terraces where we can find a large outdoors dining, chill out and sunbeds areas.

name: Cielo del Norte
tagline: Cosy haven minutes from Benirras beach
summary: This beautiful villa is a peaceful escape located in the quiet north of Ibiza. Surrounded by nature, it feels private and calm, making it perfect for guests who want to relax and slow down. The outdoor space is special,…
description: This beautiful villa is a peaceful escape located in the quiet north of Ibiza. Surrounded by nature, it feels private and calm, making it perfect for guests who want to relax and slow down. The outdoor space is special, with a sandy area that feels like a small private beach, green gardens, and sunny spots to sit and enjoy the warm island weather from morning until evening.

Inside, the villa is bright, cozy, and full of character. The rooms are decorated with simple, artistic touches that give the home a warm and welcoming feel. The living areas are spacious and comfortable, with easy access to the outdoors, so you can move freely between inside and outside. The bedrooms are designed for rest and privacy, offering a quiet place to recharge after a day in the sun.

The outdoor area is ideal for spending long, relaxed days. The private pool is surrounded by greenery, creating a natural and peaceful setting for swimming or lounging. Whether you are enjoying breakfast outside, resting by the pool, or watching the sunset in the evening, this villa offers a calm and authentic Ibiza experience that feels both comfortable and special.

name: Los pinos
tagline: Modern stylish villa with spectacular coastline views
summary: This hillside Luxury villa in Ibiza is surrounded with pine forests and is a short distance from the buzzy, beautiful beaches of Cala Conta. . Being south West orientated the villa has superb sea views across this…
description: This hillside Luxury villa in Ibiza is surrounded with pine forests and is a short distance from the buzzy, beautiful beaches of Cala Conta. . Being south West orientated the villa has superb sea views across this specular part of the Ibiza coastline.
Bedrooms & bathrooms
There are four double bedrooms, each with glass headboards, a TV and an en suite bathroom with twin sinks.
Two rooms can have twin beds on request.
The 29sq m master bedroom has a king-size bed, floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing the sea and a shower in the en suite bathroom.
There’s a second 29sq m bedroom with a king-size bed.
Both 30sq m double/twin rooms have showers and baths in their en suite bathrooms.

Bedroom 1: master bedroom has a king-size bed, floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing the sea and a shower in the ensuite bathroom.
Bedrooms 2: Double en suite bedroom Sea views

The main living space on the ground floor is set over three areas, which can be separated by glass doors or curtains. A bright and breezy house with all-white interiors and exteriors, double-height ceiling in the hallway. The living space opens out to both the sunset-facing front terrace and the shady dining terrace to the back, via sliding doors. The indoor and outdoor dining areas seat eight. There is a modern kitchen with a laundry room next door.

The 84sq m pool has a shallow sitting area around the edge, with a deep, tear-shaped section in the middle surrounded by sleek sun loungers. There is an extra WC under the house by the pool. Outdoor lounge area with daybeds and an outside dining area with BBQ for 8 comfortably.

name: Villa Abigail
tagline: Hilltop contemporary elegance, where Ibiza Town meets the sea
summary: Perched on Talamanca's hillside, Villa Abigail commands one of Ibiza's most coveted vantage points — a sweeping panorama that stretches from the amber rooftops of Ibiza Town across open Mediterranean water to the faint…
description:
Perched on Talamanca's hillside, Villa Abigail commands one of Ibiza's most coveted vantage points — a sweeping panorama that stretches from the amber rooftops of Ibiza Town across open Mediterranean water to the faint silhouette of Formentera. 
Cool grey-white interiors and polished marble floors set a tone of quiet sophistication, while floor-to-ceiling windows flood every room with the island's famously generous light. A dramatic stone feature wall rises through the stairwell, anchoring each level with organic texture against the villa's clean contemporary lines. The first floor unfolds in an easy, considered flow — a relaxed lounge gives way to a mezzanine sitting area, with both formal and informal dining spaces served by a sleek, well-appointed kitchen. 
Talamanca's laid-back beach cafés are just minutes away, yet up here, the only thing demanding your attention is that view — vast, luminous, and entirely yours.

name: Villa Amazonia
tagline: Sophisticated modern villa in Vista Alegre
summary: We find this sophisticated modern villa with stunning views in the prestigious Vista Alegre urbanization, on Es Cubells bay. Located on a secured plot inside the urbanization, sharing and additional gated access and…
description: We find this sophisticated modern villa with stunning views in the prestigious Vista Alegre urbanization, on Es Cubells bay. Located on a secured plot inside the urbanization, sharing and additional gated access and driveway with its neighbour, it offers 4 spacious double bedrooms and 5 bathrooms on a modern open plan distribution around its spectacular living room. The whole house is been recently refurbished and updated to adapt it to current design and decoration trends. It mixes its minimalistic architectural features with Mediterranean materials, furniture and textures with the main purpose of maximizing confort and still take profit of the amazing panorama that shines up front.

In the exteriors owners added recently new sofas, sunbeds, a new dining table by the barbecue area and a large brand new pergola by the pool in order to help guests enjoy the amazing panorama and life outdoors.

name: Villa Amorigen
tagline: Cosy home walking distance to town and beach
summary: Villa Amorigen in Santa Eulalia is an ideal accommodation for a stress-free holiday with loved ones. This modern property spans 300 m² and includes a living room, a kitchen with a dishwasher, 4 bedrooms, and 4…
description:
Villa Amorigen in Santa Eulalia is an ideal accommodation for a stress-free holiday with loved ones. This modern property spans 300 m² and includes a living room, a kitchen with a dishwasher, 4 bedrooms, and 4 bathrooms, making it suitable for up to 8 people. The villa is equipped with Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a washing machine, and a large screen TV.
The villa's private outdoor area is its standout feature, with an infinity pool, barbecue, large terrace, and three balconies that make it perfect for families and groups of friends. The nearest supermarket, Eroski Siesta, is located a couple of minutes' drive away.

The property has three parking spaces available on-site, and parking is also available on the street. All in all, Villa Amorigen is an excellent option for those seeking a convenient and comfortable holiday in Santa Eulalia del Riu.

name: Villa Andana
tagline: Charming holiday home in Sant Josep area
summary: Do you fancy a rural Ibizan paradise? Villa Andana is ready to offer you the experience thanks to its privacy and ideal location. Ready to host 8 guests, this villa is located in the municipality of San Jose, equipped…
description: Do you fancy a rural Ibizan paradise? Villa Andana is ready to offer you the experience thanks to its privacy and ideal location. Ready to host 8 guests, this villa is located in the municipality of San Jose, equipped with four bedrooms and two bathrooms, with a total space of 225 square meters.

Thrill seekers as you might be, you will surely be fascinated upon the surrounding beauty of the villa. Its charm will make you feel like you are in a lost paradise in the middle of the island, from where you can move comfortably to impressive places such as Sa Caleta’s cove, the beach of Cala Jondal, or to the party and shopping area of Playa d’en Bossa and even the airport. Isn’t it perfect and wonderful for you to make your own discoveries at your own pace where you enjoy touring a Mediterranean village?

The pool is relaxing and giving some romantic and chilling vibes especially during a sunset. Equipped with sunbeds and palm trees, it is a perfect area to focus on resting. Do not forget your cocktail and let the sun do its work.

The inside is as beautiful and modern as the outdoor. The living room is comfortable and of course, stylish. The dining table placed right next to the corner by the sofa is a perfect place to spend your family afternoons. White and blue, just like a typical coast house, this estate will give you the relax you have been longing. This cosy escape is hidden near the town of San Jose, ready to be discovered and enjoyed. The luxurious touch soothes with wooden furniture, blue cushions and so on, placing dreamy furnishings front and center highlighting the beds in each bedroom.
The bathrooms are also minimalistic, fully furnished and ready at your disposal.

The barbecue grill by the pool makes for a perfect meal and company of friends or family under the sun. The relaxing and chilling view that this area offers is so peaceful. If you are more of an adventure-seeker, a car would be needed to drive through the town and discover local premium restaurants or other bars and clubs. As you know, this is the island that never sleeps, no matter if you choose to be active at night or during the day. Make sure to have plenty of energy to cope with the experience that this island has to offer to you.

name: Villa Apia
tagline: Fantastic 5 bedroom villa in gated community close to Ibiza Town
summary: Villa Apia, located in the secure urbanization of Can Furnet, is a stunning and recently renovated property that draws attention both inside and out. Completed in 2020, this beautiful family home offers a unique…
description: Villa Apia, located in the secure urbanization of Can Furnet, is a stunning and recently renovated property that draws attention both inside and out. Completed in 2020, this beautiful family home offers a unique combination of authentic Ibiza charm with a modern touch. Every detail has been carefully considered, blending the spirit of Ibiza, contemporary design, and top-of-the-line appliances seamlessly.

Outside, the highlight is the inviting 4x11 meter saltwater pool, surrounded by comfortable sunbeds and a spacious double sun lounger. Multiple relaxation areas have been thoughtfully designed, including a covered dining area for up to 10 guests, complete with a barbecue for al fresco dining. For younger guests, there is a trampoline and a grassy area for play and fun.

Inside the villa, the brand-new kitchen features a sleek design and is fully equipped with state-of-the-art appliances, ensuring a perfect environment for cooking. Next to the kitchen, the open dining area includes a stylish table that seats eight guests comfortably. The living room is elegantly furnished, creating a cozy and welcoming atmosphere, enhanced by intricate details.

Villa Apia offers four spacious bedrooms, each with a double bed and tasteful decor. Each bedroom has its own en suite bathroom, with rain showers, and two of the bathrooms also feature luxurious bathtubs. The property is outfitted with a Sonos sound system, so you can enjoy your favorite music both indoors and outdoors.

In addition to the main villa, there is a separate studio with its own entrance. This studio includes a double bed, a kitchenette, and an en suite bathroom, providing privacy and convenience. There is ample parking available for up to three cars, though due to the nature of the driveway, it is recommended to rent a 4x4 vehicle, as it can get slippery.

Villa Apia is a remarkable retreat that effortlessly combines the essence of Ibiza with modern luxury. With its thoughtfully designed spaces, beautiful pool area, and attention to detail, it offers a truly unforgettable experience for those seeking a relaxing and stylish escape on the island of Ibiza.

name: Villa Aurora
tagline: A sophisticated property with spectacular sunset views
summary: Villa Aurora is a stylish and modern 4 bedroom villa located directly on a hillside in the stunning Ibicencan countryside, close to the breathtaking bay of Cala Vadella. This holiday home is set up high thus affording…
description: Villa Aurora is a stylish and modern 4 bedroom villa located directly on a hillside in the stunning Ibicencan countryside, close to the breathtaking bay of Cala Vadella. This holiday home is set up high thus affording guests outstanding Mediterranean Sea, sunset and forest views.

The interior of Villa Aurora is sleek and sophisticated, designed to perfection, with careful attention to detail making sure your every need is catered for as soon as you enter the property. A welcoming open plan lounge and dining area look out over the pool and across to the valley,, an idyllic spot to relax and revive your senses. The well appointed, modern and spacious kitchen has all the high tech appliances you would expect of a house of this calibre. Each of the 4 independent non connected bedrooms have their own unique style, and are all furnished to the highest standard, continuing the modern, minimalist theme throughout. All have double beds and en-suite bathrooms, with two out of the five benefiting from their own bathtub.

The terraces of Villa Aurora are equally stylish and offer unrivalled views over the coastline, stretching to Es Vedra, Formentera and beyond. From here you can enjoy the world famous Ibizan sunset as you relax, cocktail in hand, after another perfect day. The swimming pool is surrounded by designer sun loungers and several chillout areas provide shade and comfort. An outside dining area welcomes you through breakfast to supper under the stars. Villa Aurora is simply an idyllic Ibizan holiday home. 
The secluded location of this house does mean that guests are highly recommended to hire a 4x4 or raised car to access the dirt road.

description: Villa Azura is situated in the exclusive area of Cap Martinet near Talamanca, this contemporary luxury villa enjoys breathtaking panoramic views over the Mediterranean Sea and the island of Formentera. Set within a peaceful private resort and just 50 meters from a secluded bay, the property offers exceptional privacy while remaining only a short drive from Ibiza Town, Marina Botafoch, and Talamanca Beach.

Designed for seamless indoor–outdoor living, the villa features spacious terraces, a swimming pool with sun loungers, and a stylish outdoor lounge ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The interiors are modern and elegantly furnished, with a bright living and dining area opening onto the terrace through large sliding glass doors, alongside a fully equipped contemporary kitchen.

With air conditioning throughout, a Sonos sound system, alarm security, electric carport, laundry room, and ample storage, this exceptional villa combines comfort, design, and one of Ibiza’s most sought-after locations, offering the perfect balance between tranquility and vibrant island living.

Villa Equis is located on the hill Can Pep Simo / Cap Martinet just five minutes from Ibiza’s Marina Botafoch and the famous nightclubs Lio, Pacha and Heart. This premium property melts classic, minimalistic design with high-class amenities and an incomparable view: the magical sunlight of Ibiza, the sea, the beautiful bay of Talamanca and unique sunsets are all part of the daily routine at Villa Equis. The elevator takes you and your guests up to your private 360 ° rooftop terrace. Enjoy how the bright daylight slowly fades into dusk - one of the moments that makes your stay in Ibiza so special. And the accompanying sundowners come conveniently from your own Sky Bar. Villa Equis, blessed with a top location, already gave a unique home and hospitality to some well known international celebrities who have been fully satisfied in every regard. Already upon entering, the white, three-storey villa with its open and light-flooded rooms looks particularly elegant. Nothing superfluous diverts attention from the skillfully staged view of the bay and lets the eye wander all the way to Ibiza’s old town Dalt Vila. 
The sea panorama is fully integrated into the open living and dining area. If you open the large windows, the infinity pool looks like a natural extension of the living area. Exterior becomes interior and vice versa.

The outdoor area invites you to take a refreshing dip in the pool and to relax with numerous sun loungers, terraces and chill out areas. Villa Equis offers four high-quality bedrooms on the first two floors for up to eight people, all with en-suite bathrooms, smart TVs, LED color lighting and dressing areas. The two master suites also have freestanding bathtubs, open bathrooms and access to a private sunset terrace.

The third floor, in addition to the quiet office working area, has its own Skybar and 360 ° rooftop terrace, which rewards its visitors with stunning day and night views of the glittering ocean, the old town of Ibiza and the mountains of Cap Martinet. You can find within walking distance the beach of Talamanca, the Pacha Beach Resort Destino and some of the top restaurants of the island like Sa Punta, Patchwork, Ginger or Nobu. By car, it’s less than five minutes to Ibiza Town anyway. Private parking, a fully equipped kitchen, 400 m2 of living space and a security service bound alarm system are among the other amenities. A brilliant location, paired with such a view is also for gorgeous Ibiza a rarity and makes Villa Equis the perfect holiday home for your Ibiza trip.
