name: Villa Hebe
tagline: The first carbon neutral villa in Ibiza
summary: Villa Hebe is the first house in Ibiza that is carbon neutral. This recently (2022) renovated villa is the ultimate place to fully unwind and recharge the batteries soaking up the Mediterranean sun. Eco-friendly Hebe is…
description: Villa Hebe is the first house in Ibiza that is carbon neutral. This recently (2022) renovated villa is the ultimate place to fully unwind and recharge the batteries soaking up the Mediterranean sun. Eco-friendly Hebe is equipped with the latest tech solutions making it almost self-sustained. The property generates 80% of its energy through solar panels. All additional CO2 that comes from the grid will be compensated by the owner's participation in a non-profit tree planting programme.

This family home is located on a hill ensuring privacy throughout your stay. The central location in the countryside between San Rafael and San Antonio makes it the perfect starting point for exploring the whole Island. Stunning sunset beaches of the West are 10-15 minutes drive away, as are the real Ibizan towns of Santa Gertrudis and Santa Agnes, great for tapas and evening meals.

LIVING AREA
This spacious living area features a 7m couch. Like all other rooms, the entire living area is equipped with dimmable lights to ensure the best light at every moment of the day.
It features one of the best views of San Antoni and the sunset. The room has been designed to let the sun through all the way into the kitchen. The large reclaimed monastery dining table has space for 12 people and is separately accessible from the kitchen. The living room is equipped with pellet Stove for heating, aircon for cooling, wine fridge, 55-inch Samsung TV with Apple TV & ChromeCast

KITCHEN
The kitchen- the heart of the house- is designed to be a meeting point. The custom-made kitchen features high-quality equipment. With a large refrigerator, there is enough storage to keep all your drinks and food cool. The double freezer drawers give you easy access to your ice cubes. Equipement: Toaster, Blender, Induction Stove, Dishwasher, Oven, Juicer, Kettle Nespresso Professional.

OFFICE
We know it is tempting to work during your holiday. We recommend not doing so, however, if you're in the need of private working space, this house has it.
A full office with 4k HDMI screens and a printer. Our chairs are comfortable to sit in all day and you are close to the kitchen. With northern light, it is the ideal place to work.

OUTDOOR DINING
The outdoor dining area features a 5m long reclaimed, dragline table, ensuring that there is enough space for 14 people to have dinner. Perfectly located in the shade and with a slight breeze to escape the heat in the summer and keep you warm in the winter. The outdoor area has a built-in barbecue and sink, making it possible for you to grill your local fish, meat or veggies.

POOL AREA
A large 60m2 pool gives you your needed refreshment during the hot days. Around the pool, there are 12 sun beds.

SUNSET MASTER
The Master bedroom is located on the top floor. From its private balcony, you can enjoy an amazing sunset. The private bathroom with a toilet includes a large shower and double sink. Directly connected to the office. Bed configuration: 1 x 180 x 200 or 2 x 90 x 200

OLIVE
The olive room is located on the main floor. The calm morning sun gives you the impression of waking up in between the olive trees. An ensuite-connected bathroom and large wardrobe give you a fully private space. Bed configurations: 1 x 180 x 200 or 2 x 90 x 200

GOLDEN HOUR
Located at the entry-level, you will find the Golden Hour. The room and its colours have been chosen because of the amazing golden hours Ibiza has to offer. Visit the room at the Golden hour, and you will experience a warm colour palette. This room has a separate toilet in the room. Bed configuration: 1 x 180 x 200 or 2 x 90 x 200

SEA
On the ground floor, opposite the main entrance, is the Sea room. The room is inspired by the bright blue sea Ibiza has to offer. These natural colours extend your beach days to the evenings. Bed configuration: 1 x 160 x 200

SECURITY
The house is equipped with an alarm system. Guests who will stay in the house will have access to this system. Moreover, all entrances to the house and the property are equipped with security cameras. Upon request, these can be disabled and/or footage can be removed.

INTERNET / WIFI
We know how important it is to have good Wifi. The house is fitted with 9 access points ensuring that everywhere in the house, you remain connected. The internet is also off-grid. The house is connected to the internet through Starlink System. Offering speeds up to 350mbit down and 60mbit up. Enough to have everyone watch Netflix simultaneously and do remote zoom calls.

HEATING / COOLING
All bedrooms, kitchen and the office have their own dedicated air-conditioners. These can heat, cool and dry. Low noise modes ensure a smooth sleep. The main living area has a pellet stove that has enough capacity to heat all the upper floors.

(HOT) WATER
Our water comes from a private well. The house has 2 water storages of 25.000 litres each. These are automatically refilled. During the summer and sunny days our water is heated by the sun, in the winter we heat up the water with our boilers.

SMART HOME
The house has 77 built-in smart switches. They are connected through a central system that ensures lights are switched off and on automatically. Designed to optimise our energy usage and storage. All that to reduce the carbon footprint. For example, we will switch on the garden lights when the sun sets. Bathroom lights will be switched off automatically if no longer in use.
Electric car charger

This stunning villa is set on 3 floors, including a roof terrace and Jacuzzi, is located jutting proudly out of the mountainside with unrestricted 270 views of endless deep blue seas as well as the port of Santa Eulalia, the second largest marina of Ibiza.
MAIN HOUSE

Completed in 2012 by German developer, all appliances, fixtures, and home-automation systems have been installed by German craftsmen 
with complete high end quality and renovated and renewed again in 2019. The architecture ensures flight-flooded rooms, with real oak parquet flooring in all living areas, with the rest of the house laid with high-quality tiles.

The 4 bedrooms all have a double basin, bidet, bathtub and/or shower. There are 4 main bedrooms: a Master, a VIP, with en suite bathrooms, 2 guest bedrooms with shared bathroom. The guest toilet on the ground floor is fully fitted with a bathtub and shower and there are staff quarters on the lower ground floor with a bedroom, kitchen and bathroom. Master bathroom fittings (all stainless steel) are by Dornbracht. All window are by Schuco with electric aluminium shutters and all switched and sockets are glass framed by Busch-Juger.

The incredible open plan kitchen has white high gloss lacquer surfaces and black granite working surface, and all appliances are by Miele and Geggenau. There is a central Osmosis Machine ensuring drinking water quality throughout the house. Aircon has been installed throughout the house and there is a floor heating system by Viessmann, including hot water floor heating in all living areas.

A Smart Home System is provided by Gira, with all functions controlled by iPhone and iPad with a full music library on hand at the touch of the button via the Sonos Music Distribution System available throughout the house. High speed WiFi internet access is of course available throughout the house and in all exterior areas.
Truly this is a villa where no quality stone has been left unturned or untouched.
OUTDOOR AREAS

Approached via electric gate, this villa ensures complete privacy, with 4 individual terraces.
A 120m2 terrace on the ground level with a pool, a 30m2 terrace on the first floor and a huge 200m2 rooftop terrace with Jacuzzi up on the top. 
All terraces have spectacular views of the ocean, Santa Eulalia and its port.
Sun sails on the roof-top terrace as well as on the ground floor dinning terrace are held securely by stainless steel poles.
The infinity pool 66m2 and gives the impression of hanging ones feet over the edge of cliff.
There is a two-car garage as well as state of the art outdoor furniture with Bauhaus style elements. The villa itself is fully furnished with ultra-modern Benz-Furniture.
LOCATION

Siesta, a quiet community in Santa Eulalia only 5 minutes by car to the port of St.Eulalia.
15 minutes Ibiza- Marina and 25 minutes to Ibiza Airport.
Recommended beaches : Cala Lenya, Cala Olivera, Cala Martina, Cala Nova, Cala St.Vicente.

The Norht East is possibly the most family-friendly region of the island. Santa Eulalia, the third largest town in Ibiza, remains the same safe family heaven all year round, a theatre, amazing sport facilities, cinema, a blue flag beach and endless shops, restaurants and gyms. Very popular with British, Dutch and Germans, its main square contains pretty fountains running down from the Town Hall all the way down to the seafront.

Moving out of town and north towards the picturesque little village San Carlos, one will find the famous Las Dalias Hippy Market, with hundreds of stalls to wander around, and along the coastline, untold beaches perfectly suited for families.
Linen changes once a week and towels change twice a week included.

tagline: Ibiza Town Skylines, Formentera Horizons, Black Marble Sophistication
summary: Villa Casanova is set within a prestigious gated community, offering panoramic views over Ibiza Town and, on clear days, across to Formentera. This ultra-modern villa combines striking architecture with refined…
description: Villa Casanova is set within a prestigious gated community, offering panoramic views over Ibiza Town and, on clear days, across to Formentera. This ultra-modern villa combines striking architecture with refined interiors, creating a stylish and luxurious retreat.

The property features four south-facing ensuite bedrooms, each beautifully furnished and enhanced with elegant artwork and impressive views. The split-level open-plan living space is bright and spacious, seamlessly blending lounge, dining, and kitchen areas. The sleek black marble kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances and a breakfast bar, ideal for entertaining. The lounge includes large, comfortable sofas, a smart TV, Apple TV, and floor-to-ceiling sliding doors opening onto a terrace. Air conditioning (except in one bedroom), WiFi, Bluetooth sound system, cool floor tiling, and underfloor heating ensure year-round comfort.

Outside, multiple terraces surround the villa. The main pool terrace features a private swimming pool, luxury sun loungers, parasols, and stunning views. An upper terrace offers a chill-out area and outdoor dining space, both with integrated sound. The fully enclosed property includes private gates and parking for three cars.

name: Villa Porroig Relax
tagline: A stylish villa with sensational sea views
summary: Villa Porroig Relax is beautiful 4 bedroom beautifully designed modern luxury villa with sensational sea views on the peninsular of Porroig – one of the most exclusive areas of Ibiza. Located in the so called Golden…
description: Villa Porroig Relax is beautiful 4 bedroom beautifully designed modern luxury villa with sensational sea views on the peninsular of Porroig – one of the most exclusive areas of Ibiza. Located in the so called Golden Triangle, you are close to the equally charming villages of Es Cubells and San Jose, and just a short distance from the bay of Cala Jondal, home to the world famous Blue Marlin beachclub. And of course, the dazzling lights of Ibiza Town and Marina Botafoch, home to the islands most glamourous nightlife and dining destinations.

The villa is set over two levels, affording a true sense of space and privacy. The top level has a large living area with a state-of-the-art open kitchen, a large pool area and a guest toilet.  From every point on this level you can enjoy the beautiful sea view and the green hills in the background. The villa has just been totally modernised with the highest quality materials – and with exquisite taste.
On the lower level there are four double bedrooms – all with impressive en-suite bathrooms. Two of these bedrooms enjoy the sea view and the other two have access to private gardens.

Villa Porroig Relax features a fabulous roof terrace where you can spend long lazy evenings under the stars admiring the truly sensational views with eh luxury of your own private bar and chillout area. The heated infinity pool is supremely inviting and the perfect place to relax and reflect, surrounded by sundecks and shaded areas. Entertain friends and family in this elegant home and enjoy the perfect Ibizan experience.

name: Villa Sadie
tagline: White walls, wooden beams, and Santa Eulalia at your door
summary:
Santa Eulalia moves at its own unhurried pace — market mornings, harbourside lunches, the kind of town that rewards those who linger. Villa Sadie sits just moments from it all, yet feels like a world apart.
Inside, pure…
description:
Santa Eulalia moves at its own unhurried pace — market mornings, harbourside lunches, the kind of town that rewards those who linger. Villa Sadie sits just moments from it all, yet feels like a world apart.
Inside, pure white walls and authentic wooden beamed ceilings create a tension between the crisp and the characterful, anchored by a living room where high-end furnishings invite long evenings and unhurried conversation. The kitchen is fully equipped for those who prefer to cook on their own terms. Each of the four bedrooms is dressed with a king-sized bed and an en-suite bath and shower room — thoughtfully individual, consistently refined.
Picture yourself on the terrace, the coastal neighborhoods humming softly in the distance, in no particular hurry to be anywhere else.

name: Villa Shiva
tagline: Superbly finished villa with unbeatable views
summary: Villa Shiva is a newly refurbished prestige property situated in the hills of Ibiza inside the Ibiza’s premier gated community of Can Rimbau
description: Villa Shiva is a newly refurbished prestige property situated in the hills of Ibiza inside the Ibiza’s premier gated community of Can Rimbau
This spectacular villas overlooks Ibiza town and has uninterrupted views towards Dalt Vila and the clear waters of Ibiza all the way to Formentera.
Named Can Shiva after the god of dance as you are literally minutes from the best night life in the world while still far enough away to relax under the blue skies of Ibiza.
Can Shiva take in the views of the sea and countryside from each bedroom as well as the immense terrace space above the pool where you can entertain freely and in style.
Surrounded by manicured gardens and flawless design this property is quickly becoming the envy of all the super villas in Ibiza.

Even after the sun fades away it is easy to relax courtesy of the sound system, multi-colour lights, and al-fresco dining for twelve. If you’d prefer to move inside, there’s is a fully fitted kitchen and wine cellar pre -stocked for your enjoyment and indulgence.
Sliding glass doors connect the terraces to the magnificent interiors of this luxury villa, where high-tech amenities create an atmosphere of relaxation and bliss.
The fully equipped kitchen offers the opportunity for fine dining experiences as well as ample space to entertain your friends, family and guests in comfort.
Villa Shiva has 4 spacious bedrooms all with en-suite and breathtaking views.
The 2 masters suites, located on either side of this stunning property also helps create more space and harmony.
while the other 2 bedrooms are located strtaegically on the other floors to allow space and privacy while still offering the same excellent quality.
The property comes with a well equipment gym, cinema room as well as an office space if needed during your well deserved rest in one of the worlds most iconic holidays destinations.
Can Rimbau is only a short drive from the soothing waters of Talamanca Beach, restaurants, clubs and Ibiza Town.

name: Villa Tess
tagline: An Iconic Ibiza Retreat Where Opulent Elegance Meets Bohemian Bliss
summary: Villa Tess, is a one-off unique Ibizan property. With the exquisite location looking over Cala Jondal, with stunning views of the distant mountains and two beaches captured from the upstairs balconies, one feels both…
description: Villa Tess, is a one-off unique Ibizan property. With the exquisite location looking over Cala Jondal, with stunning views of the distant mountains and two beaches captured from the upstairs balconies, one feels both luxurious and at home at the same time. The villa was completely restored to the very highest of standards. A great deal of care has gone into the beautiful styling and you instantly feel at home when you enter.

Villa Tess is bursting with an abundance of bespoke furniture and one of a kind pieces and this sizeable property has an eclectic feel which exudes class and quality. The villa has featured in many house/home/design magazines including the Mail on Sunday, Hello Magazine and the Times Travel Magazine for its exceptional design features.

From the spacious and delightfully designed living and dining areas through to the fully equipped modern kitchen everything you could require is on hand to ensure your stay is nothing less than perfect, with marble and natural stone features, sophisticated lighting, relaxing hues and soft pastels lending a calming feeling to all of the common spaces.

The villa has three upstairs balconies the largest off the main bedroom which are a perfect place for late evening drinks to lap in the last rays of the sun which seats up to 20 people in comfort and luxury. The villa also has three purpose-built eating areas including a bespoke BBQ area, a spacious salon, four double bedrooms all en-suite, and a delightful pool with outside DJ and & Bar area. Villa Tess is extremely private and is completely walled with the latest security and protection features.

name: Villa Trevi
tagline: Cosy villa with beautiful sunrise, saltwater pool, BBQ, billiard table.
summary: Nestled in a lush landscape, Villa Trevi offers an idyllic retreat perfect for a relaxing getaway in Ibiza. The villa is decorated in classic Ibiza style, with rustic accents and a warm, inviting atmosphere that makes…
description: Nestled in a lush landscape, Villa Trevi offers an idyllic retreat perfect for a relaxing getaway in Ibiza. The villa is decorated in classic Ibiza style, with rustic accents and a warm, inviting atmosphere that makes you feel instantly at home.

The expansive outdoor area features a large saltwater pool, perfect for swimming, relaxing, or enjoying the stunning countryside views. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, dining on the terrace, or unwinding in the shade of the trees, this space is ideal for soaking up the Ibiza sun.

Inside, the villa has four spacious bedrooms with cozy beds and scenic views. The master suite includes two queen-size beds, while a separate outdoor area offers added privacy with its own bathroom. The lush garden also features an additional bedroom with a bathroom, allowing the villa to accommodate up to 8 guests.

The cozy living room, with its soft sofa and inviting corners, offers a perfect place to relax. The dining area and bar are ideal for enjoying meals, while the fully equipped kitchen adds to the villa’s comfort. Open doors lead to the garden, flooding the space with natural light.

Villa Trevi combines elegant interiors with beautiful outdoor spaces. With multiple terraces, an outdoor kitchen, and BBQ area, the villa offers plenty of opportunities for outdoor living. Surrounded by orange trees and expansive land, it provides an unparalleled sense of tranquility and freedom.

name: Villa Zeus
tagline: Sixty-Eight Thousand Metres of San Mateo Silence, All Yours
summary: Welcome to this exceptional villa set within the tranquil countryside of San Mateo, where understated elegance meets expansive natural beauty. Occupying an impressive 68,000 m² private estate and offering 490 m² of…
description: Welcome to this exceptional villa set within the tranquil countryside of San Mateo, where understated elegance meets expansive natural beauty. Occupying an impressive 68,000 m² private estate and offering 490 m² of refined living space, this residence delivers a truly exclusive luxury rental experience defined by privacy, comfort, and timeless sophistication.

The villa features four generously proportioned bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed to ensure maximum privacy and relaxation, along with four beautifully appointed bathrooms finished to the highest standards. At the heart of the home, a spacious open-plan kitchen fitted with premium modern appliances seamlessly blends style and functionality, flowing into an inviting living area designed for both intimate moments and elegant entertaining.

Outdoors, the estate unfolds into a serene oasis. A striking 13 x 7 metre swimming pool is surrounded by sun-drenched terraces, offering breathtaking countryside views and multiple spaces for relaxation. The dedicated barbecue area and refined al fresco dining setting create the perfect ambiance for entertaining, allowing guests to enjoy memorable evenings immersed in beautifully landscaped grounds.

The expansive gardens provide a sense of seclusion and harmony with nature, offering countless opportunities for outdoor living in complete privacy. Combining sophisticated design with peaceful surroundings, this remarkable villa is a rare sanctuary—ideal for those seeking an elevated lifestyle in one of San Mateo’s most picturesque settings.

name: Vista Conta
tagline: Retro vacation villa in the west with panoramic sunset sea views
summary: Nestled in the enchanting west part of the island, overlooking the picturesque shores of Cala Compte and Cala Conta, the villa "Vista Conta" offers an awe-inspiring panorama of untouched landscapes extending to the vast…
description: Nestled in the enchanting west part of the island, overlooking the picturesque shores of Cala Compte and Cala Conta, the villa "Vista Conta" offers an awe-inspiring panorama of untouched landscapes extending to the vast sea, all complemented by the legendary sunsets! A mere 15-minute leisurely stroll takes you to the beautiful beaches of Cala Compte and Cala Conta, making it easily accessible on foot. This retro-inspired villa, situated on an expansive 16,500m² seafront plot, beckons relaxation on its spacious pool terrace featuring a BBQ, a quaint outdoor kitchen, an alfresco shower, and a covered patio with a dining area.
With its seamless blend of efficient functionality and great cleanliness, this charming residence invites you to craft your affordable and inviting haven.

All rooms boast balconies with sea views, and the villa spans two floors. The upper level hosts the master bedroom with a spacious en-suite bathroom boasting a bathtub, shower, and toilet. Adjacent to the luminous and generous living room with an open fireplace, there's another dining area with an American-style kitchen and a breakfast terrace. The lower level comprises two bedrooms with double beds, one en-suite bathroom featuring a bathtub, shower, and toilet, a separate bathroom with shower and toilet, and an additional bedroom with two single beds. Enjoy breathtaking sea views from every room on the lower level as well.

Convenient distances to key destinations:
- San Jose: 9 km
- Cala Compte Beach (Walk): 0.9 km
- Cala Compte Beach (Drive): 1.6 km
- Cala Bassa Beach (Drive): 1.4 km
- Airport: 10 km
- Supermarket: 3.5 km
- Ibiza Town: 24 km
- San Antonio: 8 km

name: Can Carva
tagline: Lovely Villa Close to Beach
summary: Featuring a bright and airy living area, Can Carva welcomes you with its traditional style fireplace, inviting sofas, and ample space to unwind after a busy day in Ibiza. The villa is tastefully furnished in a typical…
description: Featuring a bright and airy living area, Can Carva welcomes you with its traditional style fireplace, inviting sofas, and ample space to unwind after a busy day in Ibiza. The villa is tastefully furnished in a typical Spanish traditional style, creating a warm and cozy atmosphere throughout. Entertainment options include satellite TV with UK freeview and a collection of DVDs suitable for all ages. Adjacent to the living area is a conservatory/games room, where additional dining areas and a pool table can be found.
On the ground floor, you'll discover a spacious dining and kitchen area, recently renovated and equipped with modern appliances such as an oven, dishwasher, and microwave.
Also on the ground floor is Bedroom 1, featuring three single beds that can be combined into a double and single if needed. An adjacent modern bathroom offers a shower enclosure.

Upstairs, Bedrooms 2 and 3 also feature twin beds that can be converted into doubles. Both rooms have direct access to their private terrace area, which surrounds the villa. These two rooms share a modern bathroom with a shower and WC.
The master bedroom (Bedroom 4) boasts a large kingsize bed, a dressing room/walk-in wardrobe space, and private access to the terrace.

On the top floor, there is a spacious lounge area that can be converted into an extra bedroom (Bedroom 5). This flexible room can be separated by concertina doors for privacy or left open plan, making it ideal for families with children.
Bedrooms 1, 2, 3, and 4 are equipped with air conditioning for your comfort.
The top floor leads to a vast terrace chill-out area with panoramic views over the bay, providing the perfect spot to relax and bask in the Ibiza sun.

Outside, Can Carva boasts extensive outdoor space, featuring lush green lawns and palm trees that create a tropical ambiance. The large pool is surrounded by a paved sun terrace, complete with a cabana offering shade for your comfort. An outdoor dining area with a spacious circular stone table is perfect for entertaining friends and family. For families with small children, the pool area can be securely closed off.
Additionally, the property offers an outdoor utility room equipped with a washer, dryer, and household equipment. This room also features a shower and WC, providing convenience for post-pool showers.
There is parking available within the property grounds for up to three cars, and ample space on the road outside if needed.

name: Can Kai
tagline: Can Kai, your perfect holiday villa in Ibiza.
summary: Nestled in the serene heart of the picturesque Ibizan countryside, this four-bedroom villa graces the tranquil area of San Mateo, offering a haven of peace and privacy. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature while…
description: Nestled in the serene heart of the picturesque Ibizan countryside, this four-bedroom villa graces the tranquil area of San Mateo, offering a haven of peace and privacy. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature while still enjoying close proximity to some of the island's most coveted beaches, including the enchanting Benirass and Cala San Vicente.

A short drive takes you to the lively village of San Joan, and for those seeking a taste of the cosmopolitan, the chic town of Santa Gertrudis is easily accessible, boasting elegant boutiques and a vibrant cafe culture.

The villa itself boasts four bedrooms, two of which are ensuite, each exuding its own unique charm through a blend of traditional features and modern comforts. Bathed in natural light, the living spaces provide a perfect retreat for relaxation, while the fully equipped kitchen ensures convenience for entertaining friends and family.

The enchanting grounds of Villa Can Kai are adorned with tropical plants and flowers, offering a lush green backdrop that surrounds you as you take a refreshing dip in the inviting pool. Numerous dedicated terraces provide options for basking in the sun or seeking shade, and dining alfresco becomes a delightful experience, whether indulging in long, lazy lunches with friends or enjoying dinner beneath a canopy of stars.
Villa Can Kai is the epitome of the ideal holiday villa in Ibiza, presenting everything you could wish for to make your vacation truly memorable.

name: La Flaca
tagline: Seven bedrooms, sweeping views over Porroig and Es Cubells
summary: La Flaca is a fantastic modern villa located in the exclusive gated community of Vista Alegre. Distributed along two large floors, it offers 6 suites and multiple luxury amenities. This amazing property enjoys coastline…
description: La Flaca is a fantastic modern villa located in the exclusive gated community of Vista Alegre. Distributed along two large floors, it offers 6 suites and multiple luxury amenities. This amazing property enjoys coastline views towards Porroig and Es Cubells bays, without doubt one of the most beautiful panoramas of the Balearic Islands.

This excellently designed villa is perfect to pass time away with friends and families in designer style. Large sliding glass doors join the massive living and swimming pool areas giving the spaces ample floor to ceiling ventilation and light. With high walls, large comfortable sofas, lavish sea views and quality throughout La Flaca is a property well worth the stay.

All six bedrooms are en-suite facing the stunning views, with common access to living areas and balconies but ensuring privacy for all guests. The stylish architecture supports the tag of a super villa in one of the most prestigious areas in the island.The villa shares additional private access with its neighbours, both offering extra security in an already safe and protected urbanization. It has parking space for six cars, including a two-car garage.
In the area we find some of the most famous landmarks in Ibiza such as Blue Marlin beach club and Es Torrent Restaurant, for many the best seafood restaurant on the island.

name: La Perla Escondida
tagline: Brand new Finca tucked away in the nature
summary: Welcome to this enchanting, brand-new Finca — a rare blend of timeless rustic charm and modern comfort. Beautifully refurbished and tastefully redecorated in 2025, this unique home invites you into a world of…
description: Welcome to this enchanting, brand-new Finca — a rare blend of timeless rustic charm and modern comfort. Beautifully refurbished and tastefully redecorated in 2025, this unique home invites you into a world of tranquility, nestled in the heart of nature yet perfectly positioned within a short drive of all key destinations.

Set across two single-story buildings, this property offers complete peace and privacy, all while being just 12 minutes from the airport. Surrounded by mountains, it provides a serene retreat close to Ibiza’s most iconic beach spots, including Cala Jondal, Tropicana Beach Club, and Blue Marlin. The charming village of Sant Josep is only a 6-minute drive away, blending convenience with tranquility.

Surrounded by lush greenery and mature trees, the property offers a true sanctuary for those seeking peace, privacy, and connection to the natural world. Completely hidden from the noise of daily life, it’s the ideal place to unwind, recharge, and live at your own pace. Whether you're a family looking for a quiet retreat, a couple dreaming of a romantic getaway, or a digital nomad craving inspiration and solitude, this finca is thoughtfully designed to meet your needs.

The heart of the home is its stunning garden — an expansive and lovingly maintained space that captures the essence of Mediterranean living. Whether you're dining under the shade, enjoying a morning coffee on one of the terraces, or simply listening to the sounds of birdsong, the setting is effortlessly magical.

At the center of it all is the crystal-clear pool, whose sparkling waters invite you to cool off during long summer days or float beneath the stars at night. With sweeping views of the surrounding green landscape, it offers the perfect balance of indulgence and serenity.
Inside, each of the four bedrooms has been designed with and style in mind, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

True to its off-grid character, the property runs on its own electricity system, offering a sustainable lifestyle without compromise. Ideal for those who value independence, self-sufficiency, and eco-conscious living, the finca proves that going off-grid can still mean living in style.

Despite its secluded feel, the property is remarkably well-connected. The picturesque village of San José — known for its charming cafes, local markets, and friendly community — is just 6 minutes away by car. And within a short drive, you'll find Ibiza's most beloved beaches, hiking trails, restaurants, and cultural landmarks.
This Finca is more than just a home — it’s an invitation to experience the beauty of island life, in a place where nature, comfort, and soul come together effortlessly.

Fibre optic WI-FI 
AC all bedrooms
Outdoor kitchen with gas BBQ 
Mineralised drinking water tap
Infrared sauna
Laundry room
Portable projector Samsung with access to all streaming platforms 
House manager
Pool size 8x3m

name: Can Cenote
tagline: A Freshwater Spring, Living Orchard, and Country Calm in Buscastell
summary: Can Cenote successfully marries the romance of country living with contemporary comfort and rustic style. The house is perfectly situated for privacy and situated amongst fertile fields and permaculture to bring a…
description:
Can Cenote successfully marries the romance of country living with contemporary comfort and rustic style. The house is perfectly situated for privacy and situated amongst fertile fields and permaculture to bring a harmony of green, lush gardens of movement and balance. Can Cenote has a large swimming pool, bio pool and unique freshwater spring. . 
This stunning three bedroom finca has just been sensitively reformed by the current owners. The resultant home creates an ambiance of domestic calm that is perfect for family holidays. This sense of peace is enhanced by the refined rustic outdoor entertaining areas, pool and a flowing garden which is full of character and flair.
The home has a lateral distribution with plentiful natural light and sensitive partitions of living. Bedrooms offer a sense of retreat and have ensuites with refined fittings and polished concrete in earthy tones. The country home kitchen is spacious and well equipped. The breakfast bar is practical as is the round dining table under the canopy of a traditional Sabina wooden beamed ceiling, bar.
Multiple entertaining areas and terraces which blur the boundaries of indoor and outdoor living. The lawn area, trampoline, children's playground and pétanque court gives children may options to create summer memories. 
The home is surrounded by mature trees and Mediterranean gardens. A mix of formal landscaping with drought resistant planting, fruit orchard, vegetable and herb garden is thoughtful, practical and communicates with the rural vernacular. 
Its secluded but central location makes it an ideal place to explore both the West of the island including San Agnes, the best sunset spots in the island around San Antonio and beautiful beaches within 10 minutes including Cala Salada, Cala Gracioneta, Port des Torrent and Cala Bassa. 
The house comes with his maintenance staff living on-premise who dedicates half of his time to house keeping. The house has a full alarm system and parking for 5 cars.

name: Can de Baix
tagline: Beautiful family finca in San Carlos
summary: Nestled in the enchanting village of San Carlos, a place rich in spiritual energy and natural beauty, Can de Baix is a stunning Ibicenco-style finca that offers the perfect retreat. Surrounded by breathtaking…
description: Nestled in the enchanting village of San Carlos, a place rich in spiritual energy and natural beauty, Can de Baix is a stunning Ibicenco-style finca that offers the perfect retreat. Surrounded by breathtaking countryside, this peaceful oasis is ideal for families and those seeking relaxation and wonder.

The home features a cozy living room, a well-equipped kitchen, and 3 inviting bedrooms (two with twin beds), along with 2 bathrooms. Thoughtfully designed for comfort, the villa includes Wi-Fi, air conditioning in the bedrooms, an alarm system, and satellite TV.

Step outside to discover beautifully landscaped gardens, sun-soaked terraces, and a refreshing swimming pool. An outdoor kitchen with a large dining area beneath a wooden pergola creates the perfect setting for al fresco meals. Unwind on a sun lounger, take in the fragrance of the citrus orchard, and immerse yourself in the serene magic of San Carlos.

name: Can Fabulosa
tagline: An exceptional private estate offering the perfect balance
summary: Nestled in the peaceful countryside near Santa Eulalia, Can Fabulosa is an exceptional private estate offering the perfect balance of luxury, privacy and authentic Ibiza charm. Set within approximately 15,000 m² of…
description: Nestled in the peaceful countryside near Santa Eulalia, Can Fabulosa is an exceptional private estate offering the perfect balance of luxury, privacy and authentic Ibiza charm. Set within approximately 15,000 m² of beautifully landscaped Mediterranean gardens, ideal for families, groups of friends or exclusive retreats.

Designed as a collection of beautifully connected living spaces rather than a single villa, the estate blends traditional Ibizan finca architecture with refined contemporary interiors. Natural stone walls, exposed wooden beams and organic materials create a warm Mediterranean atmosphere, while expansive windows flood the interiors with natural light and seamlessly connect the indoor and outdoor living areas.

The estate features two spectacular swimming pools, each offering its own unique atmosphere. One enjoys open valley views and breathtaking sunsets, while the second provides a more secluded setting surrounded by lush gardens and mature Mediterranean vegetation. Multiple sun terraces, shaded lounge areas and peaceful corners invite guests to relax throughout the day.

Outdoor living is at the heart of Can Fabulosa. Two fully equipped outdoor kitchens, a pizza oven, gas BBQ, poolside bar and several al fresco dining areas provide the perfect setting for long lunches, sunset cocktails and unforgettable evenings under the stars. Winding stone pathways lead through olive trees, palms and native gardens, revealing hidden courtyards and tranquil spaces that make every corner of the estate feel unique.

Inside, guests will enjoy generous living spaces designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The villa offers multiple lounges, a dedicated office, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning throughout, a security system and a games area with arcade machines.

The accommodation is thoughtfully distributed across the estate to provide both privacy and flexibility. The main residence includes an impressive master suite with a private terrace, lounge area, office and luxurious bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms are located within charming guest residences, a pool house and beautifully restored traditional stone buildings, allowing every guest to enjoy their own private retreat.

Despite its peaceful countryside setting, Can Fabulosa is just 20 minutes from Ibiza Airport and within easy reach of Ibiza Town, Santa Eulalia, Talamanca, Cala Llonga and Cala Olivera. The nearby Roca Llisa Golf Course, excellent restaurants and beautiful beaches make it an ideal base for discovering the island while enjoying complete privacy.

Whether you're planning a family celebration, wellness retreat or an unforgettable holiday with friends, Can Fabulosa offers an extraordinary Ibiza experience where luxury, nature and timeless Mediterranean living come together effortlessly.

name: Can Krishna
tagline: Ideal family house in Cala Llonga
summary: Can Krishna is conveniently located just a few minutes from the family friendly resort of Cala Llonga, yet the setting offers privacy and space for you and your guests. The exterior of the house captures the essence of…
description: Can Krishna is conveniently located just a few minutes from the family friendly resort of Cala Llonga, yet the setting offers privacy and space for you and your guests. The exterior of the house captures the essence of Ibicencan charm, rustic and welcoming, yet the interior has been refurbished to the very highest of standards. Adorned with tasteful artwork and elegant yet comfortable furnishings, you cannot help but feel at home at Can Krishna.

A fully equipped kitchen is fitted with every modern day appliance you would expect and the stylish, spacious lounge areas afford you the chance for a quiet moment of reflection. Each of the three bedrooms are flooded with natural light and is elegantly dressed, two benefit from en suite bathrooms with an opulent hot tub dominating the master bathroom.

The minimalist, sleek interior contrasts perfectly with the lush gardens which surround the house. Tropical plants and flowers fill the perfectly manicured grounds with their fragrance, and there are several dedicated chillout areas which simply beg you to kick back and reflect on yet another perfect Ibizan day. A BBQ area and shaded dining area is the perfect space to entertain guests, and the inviting pool is surrounded with ample sunloungers to soak up the Ibizan sun, and canopies and day beds provide shade for those who seek it. Immerse yourself in the sauna located conveniently next to the pool for a superb sauna experience (on request). The bustling resort of Cala Llonga is a hub of restaurants, bars and shops, and one of the most expansive beaches on the island, making this an ideal Ibiza villa for families and groups.

name: Can Laurel
tagline: Ancient beams, whitewashed walls, and the silence of the south
summary: The southern countryside of Porroig moves at its own pace — slower, quieter, shaped by centuries of sun and stone. This traditional Ibicencan farmhouse carries that unhurried character in every detail: dark wooden beams…
description:
The southern countryside of Porroig moves at its own pace — slower, quieter, shaped by centuries of sun and stone. This traditional Ibicencan farmhouse carries that unhurried character in every detail: dark wooden beams worn smooth with age, solid oak doors that creak with history, and whitewashed walls that hold the cool of the morning long into the afternoon. 
Three bedrooms offer an intimate scale, ideal for those seeking genuine seclusion without sacrificing connection to the island's best. Es Cubells, Cala Jondal, and the legendary Blue Marlin are within easy reach, as is the unhurried charm of San José village. Yet the pull here is always back — to the terrace, to the stillness, to a landscape that has changed very little in a hundred years. Evenings arrive golden and unhurried, and somehow, neither do you.

name: Can Meil
tagline: A restored southwest finca, three kilometres from Cala Tarida's shores
summary: Can Meil sits on a private crescent-shaped plot in the southwest of Ibiza, just three kilometers from Cala Tarida and its beach clubs. The modern finca was fully renovated in 2021 and offers a fresh, contemporary feel…
description: Can Meil sits on a private crescent-shaped plot in the southwest of Ibiza, just three kilometers from Cala Tarida and its beach clubs. The modern finca was fully renovated in 2021 and offers a fresh, contemporary feel throughout. Its rooms are spread over three levels, with three uniquely styled bedrooms, each featuring its own bathroom.

The outdoor areas are designed for relaxation and entertaining. The garden includes two outdoor showers and a heated 24 m² swimming pool at the center of the property, surrounded by lush palm and fruit trees. Multiple terraces offer a variety of settings, including a sun terrace with sea views and a dining area, an outdoor kitchen with a refrigerator, plus billiards and table football. A lower terrace features a barbecue, fireplace, a second outdoor kitchen with fridge and freezer, and a large dining table. The winter garden provides an additional dining space that can be enclosed with shutters and includes a fan. Several partially covered parking spaces and two private entrance gates complete the property.

name: Can Milna
tagline: Bohemian chic in the heart of Es Cubells
summary: Can Milna is a truly unique and captivating villa that seamlessly blends bohemian chic with modern-day comforts. Located just a short stroll from the exclusive village of Es Cubells, this idyllic Ibizan home offers easy…
description: Can Milna is a truly unique and captivating villa that seamlessly blends bohemian chic with modern-day comforts. Located just a short stroll from the exclusive village of Es Cubells, this idyllic Ibizan home offers easy access to some of the island’s most secluded and picturesque beaches, providing an ideal escape for those seeking tranquility and beauty.

The villa’s interiors are a testament to effortless elegance, with a spacious, open-plan design that creates an inviting and airy atmosphere. The double-height lounge area is a striking feature, adorned with carefully chosen artwork, eclectic decorations, and comfortable furnishings that bring a sense of warmth and character. This living space flows seamlessly into the dining area and well-equipped kitchen, which is designed for both casual and formal dining experiences. The decor features a perfect blend of vibrant, chic furnishings and authentic touches, creating a sophisticated boho-chic ambiance that feels both welcoming and luxurious.

Upstairs, the master suite is an exquisite retreat, offering ultimate comfort and privacy. It boasts a feature bathroom with a fireplace, making it a perfect spot for relaxation. The suite also has access to two private terraces, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and Mediterranean Sea, ideal for morning coffees or evening sunsets.

On the ground floor, you'll find two additional bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed for a restful stay. Bedroom 2 features a comfortable double bed and an en-suite bathroom with a shower. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, enjoying the view from one of the terraces, or exploring the surrounding nature, Can Milna provides a truly unforgettable experience.

tagline: Ideal Family Holiday Home in Sant Josep de Sa Talaia

description: Situated in the southern region of Ibiza, the two-story villa "Can Olivander" spans 400 m² and provides everything necessary for a delightful getaway. This charming residence features a living room complete with a pool table, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, three bedrooms (two of which have two single beds each), and three bathrooms, accommodating up to six guests.
Among the additional amenities are Wi-Fi, television, air conditioning, a fireplace, a crib, and a high chair, ensuring a comfortable stay for families.

The expansive private outdoor area captivates visitors with its lush greenery and a combination of open and covered terraces, perfect for enjoying a delicious breakfast or a barbecue meal while taking in the beautiful surroundings. The inviting pool offers an excellent spot for a refreshing swim, followed by relaxation on the Balinese bed or in a hammock, with sun loungers available for sunbathing. For those seeking entertainment, the outdoor ping-pong table adds a fun afternoon activity.

The village center is conveniently located just 700 meters away (approximately a 3-minute drive), where guests can explore various shops, restaurants, bars, and cafes. The nearest beach, Playa Port des Torrent, is a short 14-minute drive (7 km), while Ibiza town, featuring the airport, is just a 15-minute drive (11 km) from Sant Josep de Sa Talaia.

The property offers ample parking space, welcomes pets, and includes bed linens and towels in the rental price. Please note that smoking is prohibited inside the house, and parties or events are not allowed.

name: Can Scarlett
tagline: Dalt Vila Views, Whitewashed Walls, and Jesús at Your Door
summary:
Perched above the rooftops of Jesús, Can Scarlett frames one of Ibiza's most coveted panoramas — the ancient fortress of Dalt Vila rising above a shimmer of open sea. 
The village sits quietly at its doorstep, where…
description:
Perched above the rooftops of Jesús, Can Scarlett frames one of Ibiza's most coveted panoramas — the ancient fortress of Dalt Vila rising above a shimmer of open sea. 
The village sits quietly at its doorstep, where locals gather at sun-warmed café terraces and the rhythm of island life unfolds at a gentler pace. Talamanca Beach is a short drive away, as is the pulse of Ibiza Town with its late-night dining and storied old quarter. 
Inside, the villa moves through cool white walls and warm natural wood, grounded by terracotta tones that deepen in the afternoon light. Three bedrooms and generous living spaces make it well-suited to families and small groups seeking both comfort and connection to place. 
Picture a long evening on the terrace, a glass in hand, watching the fortress lights come alive against the darkening sky.

Short Stay Policy: Please note that for stays shorter than one week, when permitted, an increase in daily rates will apply. An empty calendar does not automatically guarantee availability for short stays; confirmation with the property is required. Please consult with your agent to confirm the final price and availability.

name: Can Solis
tagline: Your Private Oasis in the Heart of Ibiza
summary: Discover the essence of Ibiza at Villa Can Solis, a beautifully renovated villa that blends modern comfort with the island’s traditional charm. Nestled in a peaceful and private location in San Rafael, this villa is the…
description:
Discover the essence of Ibiza at Villa Can Solis, a beautifully renovated villa that blends modern comfort with the island’s traditional charm. Nestled in a peaceful and private location in San Rafael, this villa is the perfect retreat for a relaxing holiday in the heart of Ibiza.
Layout & Features

The villa offers 3 double bedrooms, all equipped with air conditioning and spacious wardrobes to ensure maximum comfort. There are 2 full bathrooms, one with a bathtub and another with a shower, providing convenience for all guests. The cozy dining area is designed for shared moments, featuring a dining table and a sofa next to a plasma TV. The entire house is fully air-conditioned with hot/cold air conditioning, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere year-round.
Dreamy Outdoor Spaces

The villa’s exterior is a true oasis, boasting a stunning swimming pool surrounded by sun loungers, perfect for soaking up the sun. The meticulously maintained gardens feature Balinese beds, ideal for unwinding and enjoying the peaceful surroundings. This private outdoor space invites you to disconnect and immerse yourself in Ibiza’s serenity. Additionally, we provide complimentary bed linens and towels for your convenience.

name: Cana Gotas
tagline: Five Terraces, Fruit Gardens, and Rooftop Sunsets in Roca Llisa
summary: Experience refined island living in this exceptional private villa located in the prestigious enclave of Roca Llisa, one of Ibiza’s most sought-after and secure communities. Designed for discerning travelers, this…
description: Experience refined island living in this exceptional private villa located in the prestigious enclave of Roca Llisa, one of Ibiza’s most sought-after and secure communities. Designed for discerning travelers, this elegant residence blends Mediterranean charm with contemporary comfort, offering a serene retreat just moments from the island’s most iconic destinations.

Set on an expansive private plot, the villa is surrounded by lush tropical fruit gardens and features five beautifully appointed terraces, each curated for relaxation, entertaining, or quiet reflection. The seamless indoor-outdoor flow invites you to embrace Ibiza’s lifestyle, whether dining al fresco beneath the shaded pergola, lounging beside the sculpted swimming pool, or unwinding in the outdoor jacuzzi as the sun sets. A stunning rooftop lounge crowns the property, revealing panoramic views across rolling hills and the sparkling Mediterranean Sea—an idyllic setting for sunset cocktails or tranquil mornings.

Inside, the villa offers three spacious bedrooms, all fully air-conditioned, and three elegantly designed bathrooms. The interiors are warm and sophisticated, combining natural textures, soft tones, and carefully selected furnishings to create a welcoming yet luxurious atmosphere. A fully equipped kitchen and generous living spaces ensure both comfort and functionality for extended stays.
Modern conveniences are seamlessly integrated, including high-speed WiFi (300 Mbps) and private parking facilities, allowing guests to enjoy both connectivity and ease throughout their stay.

Perfectly positioned, the villa offers effortless access to Ibiza’s highlights. Within just 10 minutes, you can reach the vibrant energy of Ibiza Town, the charming promenade of Santa Eulalia, the idyllic shores of Amante Beach, and the world-renowned nightlife of Pacha Ibiza.

This villa is an exceptional choice for families and groups seeking privacy, elegance, and proximity to Ibiza’s finest experiences—an elevated sanctuary where every detail is designed for an unforgettable stay.

name: Cana Susanna
tagline: Where Cala Vadella's coastline dissolves into open Mediterranean sky
summary: Perched atop the sun-drenched hills of Cala Vadella, Cana Susanna is a masterpiece of contemporary design and understated luxury, offering unrivaled panoramic vistas of the Mediterranean Sea and Ibiza’s legendary…
description: Perched atop the sun-drenched hills of Cala Vadella, Cana Susanna is a masterpiece of contemporary design and understated luxury, offering unrivaled panoramic vistas of the Mediterranean Sea and Ibiza’s legendary sunsets. This secluded three-bedroom villa, nestled within a private and secure enclave, effortlessly blends traditional Ibicenco charm with modern sophistication, creating an idyllic retreat for discerning travelers. Just moments from the island’s most coveted beaches—Cala Vadella, Cala Conte, and Cala Tarida—and a short drive from the quaint villages of San Agustín and San José, the villa strikes the perfect balance between tranquil seclusion and vibrant island life.

Inside, Cana Susanna exudes refined elegance through its meticulously curated interiors. Neutral tones and soft pastel hues harmonize with natural stone accents, marble finishes, and bespoke lighting, while original artwork and plush furnishings add layers of warmth and sophistication. The open-plan living and dining areas flow seamlessly into a state-of-the-art kitchen, creating an inviting space for gatherings. Three exquisitely designed bedroom suites serve as private sanctuaries, each featuring en-suite bathrooms, sumptuous linens, and subtle design flourishes that echo the villa’s serene coastal ethos.

Outside, the property unfolds into a lush, tropical paradise. Fragrant blossoms and swaying palms frame the shimmering pool, while expansive terraces—perfect for alfresco dining or sunset cocktails—offer front-row seats to Ibiza’s golden horizons. Lounge on a sunbed beneath the Balearic sky, host intimate dinners under the stars, or simply lose yourself in the soothing symphony of rustling leaves and distant waves.

Cana Susanna is more than a villa; it is an invitation to experience Ibiza at its most enchanting. Whether savoring morning coffee on a private terrace, exploring nearby cobblestone villages, or dancing the night away in Ibiza Town, this sanctuary promises a seamless blend of luxury, comfort, and authentic island charm. Here, every moment is steeped in beauty, tranquility, and the effortless allure of Mediterranean living.

name: Casa Bayona
tagline: Immerse in nature and conveniently positioned in S'Estanyol
summary: Casa Bayona is a meticulously restored classic finca, nestled in a tranquil yet incredibly convenient setting in S’Estanyol. It is situated on a sprawling private plot spanning 3,500 square meters, exuding an air of…
description: Casa Bayona is a meticulously restored classic finca, nestled in a tranquil yet incredibly convenient setting in S’Estanyol. It is situated on a sprawling private plot spanning 3,500 square meters, exuding an air of timeless elegance.

Every effort has been made to breathe new life into Casa Bayona, seamlessly blending rustic allure with contemporary charm. Reclaimed timber and Crittall doors harmonize with flowing linen, whitewashed walls, and understated hues. The attention to detail is evident throughout the property, with top-notch finishes adorning every corner.

The remarkable styling and thoughtful design create an al fresco lifestyle experience that enhances the architecture and the natural beauty of Ibiza. The transition from indoors to outdoors is seamless, forming a sanctuary for reconnecting with nature.

The interior design and layout are nothing short of masterful. Intelligent lighting, unique materials, and high-end finishes infuse the spaces with vibrancy and openness, making the most of the island's abundant natural light to evoke a sense of space, tranquility, and freedom.

The kitchen is fully equipped with luxury brand cookware, cutlery, glassware, and crockery. It boasts appliances like a toaster, Magimix, Nutribullet, hand-press citrus juicer, Nespresso machine, a large SubZero fridge freezer with an ice machine, and a separate wine fridge. The Lacanche electric cooker with gas hobs takes center stage, while a spacious kitchen island and an indoor dining table that seats at least 6 provide ample room for culinary exploration.
In the living room, you'll find a generously sized L-shaped sofa and a coffee table, complete with a TV offering access to Sky, Netflix, and Amazon Prime.
As for the bedrooms:

Bedroom 1: Features a super queen-size bed with Volga linen bedding and shares a bathroom with the bunk room, which has four single bunk pods for children.
Bedroom 2: Offers a super queen-size bed with Volga linen bedding, an en-suite bath and shower room, and a separate WC.
Bedroom 3 - Bunk Room: Contains four single bunk pods for children and shares a bathroom with bedroom 1.

Casa Bayona's gardens are truly enchanting, featuring lavender, rosemary, avocado, citrus trees, vegetables, and an olive grove. A sprawling pergola adorned with rambling roses sets the stage for a romantic and unique outdoor dining experience.

With a profound respect for the environment, the property boasts impressive eco-friendly features, including a reed bed filtration system, rainwater irrigation for the gardens, and support for local wildlife, including the rare Ibicencan toad and a bug hotel.

The centerpiece of the property is the majestic large pool, complete with an electric cover and surrounded by a vast wooden deck with sun loungers and a spacious tented shade area. A grassy expanse and a small sandy "beach" offer diverse outdoor living experiences. There's also an outdoor shower, a Giant EGG BBQ, and Sonos surround sound speakers. The pool can be heated at an additional cost.

Casa Bayona's location is ideal, with numerous amenities and charming towns nearby. Situated close to Jesus, you'll find an array of restaurants, supermarkets, shops, and a short 10-minute drive to Ibiza town. For a special dining experience, guests can visit the exclusive and highly regarded restaurant Cala Bonita, which is accessible via a quiet road leading to a hidden beach.

name: Casa Clareta
tagline: Charming renovated finca near the golf court

description: This beautifully restored Ibizan farmhouse, renovated in 2019, is full of character and natural light. Nestled in the exclusive and secure Roca Llisa community—just steps from the golf course—this peaceful retreat is ideally located 15 minutes from both Ibiza Town and Santa Eulalia, and only 10 minutes from the beaches of Cala Llonga and Cala Olivera.

The villa offers a perfect blend of authentic charm and modern comfort. Surrounded by a spacious garden, it features a private swimming pool, multiple sun-drenched terraces, and a stylish outdoor lounge area with hammocks and Balinese beds for ultimate relaxation.

Each bedroom has direct access to the garden and pool, enhancing the indoor-outdoor living experience. The generous living room and shaded outdoor dining area with a large wooden table and built-in barbecue make it ideal for entertaining family and friends.
Whether you're enjoying a sunny day by the pool, a quiet evening on the terrace, or a lively dinner under the stars, this finca is a perfect setting for an unforgettable Ibiza holiday.

name: Es Palauet Duplex

description: Very nice refurbished apartment with 2 double bedrooms, 2 complete bathrooms, 1 toilet, 1 complete kitchen and cozy and comfortable seating and relaxing area. Located inside the old town near the Dalt Vila entrance in a very nice and sunny street, with an amazing terrace in an historical building, which respects its façade and all its details, even having recovered and traited part of its historical floors as “flooring carpets”.
Completely refurbished building with a business in the ground floor, a 1-suite apartment in the 1st floor and a 2-suites apartment in a 2nd floor duplex. The whole building belongs to the same owner.
Live in an apartment which transmits all the history of the old Ibiza with all modern and new comforts.

- Design and new materials, completely modern and respectingstructure and history of the building.
- 2nd floor duplex (two bedrooms and 2 bathrooms in 2nd floor and living room and terrace in 3rd floor. 
- Access with stairs (no lift).
- Smart TV and satellite in living room and in both double bedrooms.
- Wi-fi.
- Air conditioning (cold and hot).
- 2 Complete bathroom with WC and shower(normal and rain drop effect) and a guests toilet
- Complete kitchen ( kitchen, fridge, freezer, dishwasher, oven, washing machine).
- All necessary household items, kitchenware, bed linen and bathroom towels.
- Big wardrobes inside the bedrooms.
- Indoors seating dining and relaxing areas and outdoors relaxing terrace area with views
- No cleaning service included.

-The maximum number of guests is 4-6 adults.
- No parties allowed.
- Baby cots are free of charge and available on request.

- Pets are not allowed.

name: Puig Can Fluxa
tagline: Rural villa with pool at a prime location of Santa Eulalia
summary: A hundred year old finca house recently renovated with the "ibiceancan " country sylte.
description: A hundred year old finca house recently renovated with the "ibiceancan " country sylte.

This Mediterranean house for 6 people is located in a suburban location at Santa Eulalia. A short walking distance to the town with its nice beaches, restaurants and shopping areas. Santa Eulària des Riu (spanish Santa Eulalia del Río) is a city in the east of the island of Ibiza.

The Mediterranean hillside property is completely fenced and has a total area of 250m2. It is overgrown with trees and many native plants such as bougainvillea and oleander. Two house terraces plus a pool terrace offer space for clapping, relaxing, sunbathing .... The two-storey 225m² finca surprises with great panoramic views and unique situation at Santa Eulalia.

You enter the finca on the lower floor and get directly into a bright, comfortably furnished living / dinning room (40m2) with satellite TV and a fireplace. The fitted kitchen is fully furnished and equipped with a gas cooker and electrical appliances. Furthermore, there are 2 bedrooms ( 1 x 20m2 + 1 x 10m2) and 1 bathroom and another livining room on the lower floor.
On the upper floor there is the 1 master bedroom (22m2) with 1 bathroom en suite. The master bedroom has air conditioning for cooling in summer and heating in winter

The traditional Ibizenco house has all the characteristics of Ibiza's typical architecture. Wooden ceilings and thick walls that keep the temperature pleasant in summer and winter. All bedrooms are fan cooled, which ensures a good night’s sleep. In the transitional months and in winter, a marmol stone heaters ensures comfortable temperatures. For cozy fireplace evenings, there is a closed fireplace in the living area.
The sea and Santa Eulalia center are about 5 to 8 minutes walk away.
Ibiza Town, World Culture Heritage, with its many facets, is just 10 minutes away by car.
Enjoy a beautiful stay with family and friends.
Well suited for golf players!

Ibiza Town 12 km - Santa Eulalia Center 0,2 km - Golf Course 8 km - Beach Santa Eulalia 0,6 km - Port Santa Eulalia 1 km - Santa Gertrudis 12 km - Airport 21 km - Amante Beach Club 6 km - Supermarket 0,4 km - Hypermarket 2,5 km

name: Serene Sanctuary
tagline: Elegance and tranquility a short drive from Cala Conta
summary: Serene Sanctuary is your ultimate Ibiza retreat, thoughtfully designed for luxury, comfort, and unforgettable experiences.
description: Serene Sanctuary is your ultimate Ibiza retreat, thoughtfully designed for luxury, comfort, and unforgettable experiences.

PEACEFUL
The property offers serene privacy with separate living quarters, including a guest house. An isolated office outside the main house, crafted by Iglucraft, features high-speed fiber internet, allowing for confidential calls while enjoying a stunning panoramic view of the jungle garden and pool.

BOOST
Enhance your well-being and leave Ibiza healthier than ever. Harvest fresh produce from the vegetable garden for a true farm-to-table experience. Recharge in the infrared sauna, also built by Iglucraft, and take an invigorating plunge into the "Brass Monkey" ice bath, crafted from a historic Scottish barrel. For fitness enthusiasts, the gym includes a Technogym spinning cycle and weights.

RELAX
Unwind by the heated pool, challenge friends to a game of ping-pong, or enjoy breathtaking sea views from the sunset rooftop. Recreational amenities, such as bicycles and paddleboards, are also included. For an extra thrill, explore the island with the Yamaha Razr 1000 buggy and climb Sa Talaia, Ibiza’s highest mountain.

FEEL AT HOME
Designed originally as a private residence, every detail of Serene Sanctuary reflects its owner’s exquisite taste. Furniture has been carefully sourced worldwide, featuring mid-century modern touches, from Italian lighting to Palm Springs-inspired Charles Eames stools. All bedrooms are fitted with luxurious Italian CEA bathroom fittings.

DANCE
Feel the rhythm with a Sonos sound system, indoors and outdoors, in every room. Seamlessly connect to your Spotify or Apple Music playlists via WiFi and keep the party alive around the outdoor bar.

EAT
Dine wherever you feel inspired. The property features four outdoor dining areas and one indoor space around the kitchen, equipped with an American-style refrigerator and bottled water from our private well. Less than five minutes away is Es Xuco, one of the island’s best supermarkets, complete with a butcher. Cook up a feast on the Weber barbecue.

SAFETY
Your security is our priority. Every bedroom includes a personal safe, and alarms are installed throughout both houses. The property is further secured with strategically placed cameras, all connected to an external security service.

SWIM
Enjoy the extraordinary location of Serene Sanctuary, with access to Ibiza’s most stunning beaches in under five minutes. Cala Codolar is within walking distance, perfect for a scenic workout, while Cala Escondida, Cala Conta, and Cala Bassa are just moments away. For an at-home experience, lounge in our 15-meter heated pool.

OFF THE GRID
Serene Sanctuary offers unparalleled opportunities for adventure. Take to the road in a vintage 1976 Ford F100 pickup truck imported from Louisiana, or explore Ibiza’s coastline aboard a 44-foot Magnum Marine boat. With its impressive cruising speed, this rare vessel—one of only 14 in the world—allows you to circle the entire island in a day, from the beauty of Tagomago to the magical sunset at Cala Conta.
At Serene Sanctuary, luxury meets adventure, and every detail has been designed to create unforgettable moments.

name: The Beach House Cala LLenya
tagline: Beach House - Seafront villa with pool at Cala Llenya
summary: This comfortable, detached Ibiza Villa for 6 people is situated in a unique location on the Cala Llenya beach, on Ibiza’s east coast. The sea is only about 100m away and the sand beach is directly in front of the pool…
description: This comfortable, detached Ibiza Villa for 6 people is situated in a unique location on the Cala Llenya beach, on Ibiza’s east coast. The sea is only about 100m away and the sand beach is directly in front of the pool terrace. The Mediterranean property is completely fenced in and has a total surface area of 1,000m2. There are palm trees and many indigenous plants like bougainvillea and oleander. There is a comfortable BBQ corner for sociable BBQ nights amongst families or friends. Two terraced houses with generous pool terrace provide space to chat, relax, tan...

It has 140m2 living space over two floors. You enter the house on the top floor and directly enter a light, comfortably furnished living space with satellite television and direct access to the 50m2 breakfast terrace with fantastic sea views. The living room is attached to the dining room, which is connected to the kitchen by a bar. The fitted kitchen is completely equipped. On the top floor there is a double bedroom with en suite toilet and direct access to the terrace, as well as a guest toilet. On the lower floor there is another double bedroom with toilet and a separate studio with a small living room with bedroom and connected bedroom with two single beds and its own toilet. The lower floor also accesses a generous 50m2 terrace with an awning and covered BBQ spot. From here you can access the pool terrace, outdoor pool and pick nick spot. The garden gate leads straight to the beach.
All bedrooms have A/C, which facilitates comfortable sleep in the peak of summer. In the colder months and in winter, the modern inverter a/c system provides comfortable feel-good temperatures.
Washing machine and iron equipment are in the storage room.
Children equipment (cribs, high chair, etc.) is of course available upon request. Small dogs are also welcome (if well trained ?). Please ask.

At beach Cala Llenya there is a kiosk with gastronomy. Beach Cala Nova and its many different restaurants are 10 minutes away by foot. During season, a small, nearby supermarket opens for basic supply. More shopping opportunities, pubs and boutiques are in the San Carlos hippy area.
Beach Cala Llenya 10m - Beach Cala Nova 1,5 km - San Carlos 3 Km

name: Villa Azure
tagline: Beautiful family house with sea views in Jondal
summary: Perched in a privileged location with commanding views over the sparkling waters of Cala Jondal, this stunning villa combines modern elegance with ultimate comfort. Designed to the highest standards, it offers three…
description: Perched in a privileged location with commanding views over the sparkling waters of Cala Jondal, this stunning villa combines modern elegance with ultimate comfort. Designed to the highest standards, it offers three spacious bedroom suites, each with its own luxurious en-suite bathroom, ensuring both privacy and sophistication for every guest. Year-round comfort is guaranteed with underfloor heating for the cooler months and air conditioning for the summer. A fully equipped kitchen with premium appliances provides the perfect space for preparing everything from light meals to gourmet feasts.

Entertainment and relaxation are at the heart of the villa’s design. A Bose sound system is seamlessly integrated throughout the interior and gardens, allowing you to set the mood wherever you are. Enjoy movie nights in the smart TV lounge with a state-of-the-art sound system, cool off in the crystal-clear swimming pool, or unwind on the expansive 50 m² rooftop terrace, complete with lounge seating, a bar, and fridge. Outdoor living is elevated with a shaded dining area featuring ceiling fans in the chill-out lounge, while the manicured lawn is perfect for games or simply soaking up the Mediterranean sun. As evening falls, the beautifully illuminated gardens create a magical atmosphere.

Security and privacy are paramount, with a modern alarm system, double entrance gates—including imposing four-meter metal gates and an additional set of wrought-iron gates—and the entire property enclosed by a high stone wall and secure fencing. High-speed internet keeps you seamlessly connected throughout your stay.

Despite its peaceful and private setting, the villa is just a short walk from Cala Jondal’s most celebrated beach clubs and restaurants, including Jondal, Tropicana, and Blue Marlin—perfect for indulging in exquisite dining and Ibiza’s vibrant nightlife.
Room Distribution
All three bedrooms are located on the first floor.
Each room features a double bed and an en-suite bathroom.
One suite includes a satellite TV for added convenience.
This Cala Jondal retreat offers a rare combination of luxury, privacy, and accessibility—an unforgettable escape into the best of Mediterranean living.
