description: Beautifully set on its own private hillside, this stunning home offers breathtaking views over Cap Falco, Salinas, Formentera, and Playa d’en Bossa. The property features three spacious bedrooms and bathrooms, including two en-suites, making it ideal for families or groups seeking both comfort and privacy.

With expansive outdoor spaces, a large lawn, a beautiful swimming pool, and several chill-out areas, this villa is perfect for relaxing and soaking up the Ibiza sunshine. Whether you’re looking for a peaceful family retreat or a stylish getaway with friends, this home provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable stay on the island.

name: Villa Cayu
tagline: Whitewashed Walls, Olive Groves, and Southwest Ibiza Stillness
summary: An exclusive modern villa that redefines luxury living on the stunning western shores of Ibiza, just moments from the pristine beaches of Cala Comte and Cala Bassa. This exceptional residence offers a seamless blend of…
description: An exclusive modern villa that redefines luxury living on the stunning western shores of Ibiza, just moments from the pristine beaches of Cala Comte and Cala Bassa. This exceptional residence offers a seamless blend of contemporary elegance and sustainable comfort, nestled in a tranquil setting of rolling hills, lush greenery, and sweeping sea views.

Located only 20 minutes from Ibiza Airport and 10 minutes from the charming town of San Josep, the villa enjoys a prime position that balances seclusion with accessibility. Thoughtfully designed with natural materials and high-end finishes, it rests on an expansive plot of over 4,500 square meters, with a built area of 220 square meters excluding the terraces. The interiors are bathed in natural light thanks to sleek steel-framed windows, creating an open and airy atmosphere that complements the surrounding landscape.

With three spacious bedrooms, three bathrooms, and two additional toilets, the villa offers generous accommodation for family and guests. Modern amenities ensure an elevated living experience, including floor heating and cooling, air conditioning, and a cutting-edge home automation system. The Domotica smart home setup allows you to control lighting, climate, security, and entertainment systems effortlessly, whether you're at home or away.

Sustainability is at the heart of this home, featuring a solar water heater by Solahart, a heat pump, and a private well. Entertainment and relaxation are equally prioritized, with a Sonos sound system, automatic curtains, and strong Wi-Fi connectivity throughout. Fully furnished with stylish and durable designer pieces, the villa embodies refined comfort at every turn.

Step outside into a beautifully landscaped garden where a wooden terrace made from African Padoek surrounds a generous swimming pool and elegant lounge area – the perfect backdrop for enjoying Ibiza’s natural beauty with loved ones. This villa offers a rare opportunity to experience serene island living without compromising on luxury or sustainability.

name: Villa Charlotte
tagline: Clifftop glass and sea light above Es Torrent Bay
summary: Villa Charlotte is a striking Ibizan villa perched high on a clifftop near San José within the prestigious gated community of Vista Alegre. This modern home occupies a commanding position above the beautiful bay of…
description: Villa Charlotte is a striking Ibizan villa perched high on a clifftop near San José within the prestigious gated community of Vista Alegre. This modern home occupies a commanding position above the beautiful bay of EsTorrent with outstanding views across the sparkling waters of the Mediterranean sea.

Inside Villa Charlotte, the floor to ceiling glass walls on the south side of the house, and open plan living offer unforgettable views from every angle of this sleek, modern house. The interiors have been carefully designed with a sophisticated modern contemporary feel, the clean white lines perfectly complemented with different aspects of vibrant yet tasteful colour and design throughout. The impressive master suite features an unusually stylish circular king-size bed, with a ceiling mounted television, a large free standing bath and an expansive private terrace with double daybeds and a private a hot-tub. The other two double rooms both benefit from their own ensuite bathrooms, complete with rain showers. All three bedrooms have air conditioning for your comfort.

To enhance the truly spectacular views, this property is surrounded by perfectly manicured garden terraces, dedicated chill-out spaces and shaded dining areas complete with a Weber BBQ. The heated infinity pool slips away to a glass wall overlooking an al-fresco bar, an idyllic place to immerse yourself in the beauty of your surroundings. Double daybeds provide space for the sunworshippers amongst you, and the many terrace areas afford space, privacy and seclusion.

name: Villa Escondida
tagline: Pine-scented seclusion, Formentera on the horizon
summary: Peacefully situated on a hillside, Villa Escondida is a romantic and secluded luxury south-facing villa. Located high up in the pine-covered mountains, with panoramic views over Salinas to the sea and Formentera the…
description: Peacefully situated on a hillside, Villa Escondida is a romantic and secluded luxury south-facing villa. Located high up in the pine-covered mountains, with panoramic views over Salinas to the sea and Formentera the property offers total privacy and all day sun, while being very close to Ibiza Town.

The villa is immaculately presented and luxuriously furnished and equipped with three double bedroom suites all with sea views, en-suite shower rooms as well as air-conditioning and doors to the sun terrace. Outside there is an inviting 11 meter infinity swimming pool with 2 raised sunbeds with floating pool bean bags and separate heated sunken tiled Jacuzzi. There are large south facing terraces, comfy loungers and outside covered chill out seating area and two covered dining areas, one with new large gas BBQ. The roof top terrace with two luxury 4 poster double sunbeds boasts the most sumptuous views of San Jose zone.

The villa is excellently located 6 kms from Ibiza Old Town and just 10 minutes drive or easy taxi ride from the popular beaches of Salinas, Cala Jondal (and Es Torrent as well as easy access to San Jose village and to the airport.

name: Villa Harper
tagline: Private and secure with exceptional panoramic sea and sunset views
summary: Villa Harper is an exceptionally elegant modern 3 bedroom property which offers superb panoramic sea and sunset views. Private and secure, this home is located close to some of the most popular beaches on Ibiza,…
description: Villa Harper is an exceptionally elegant modern 3 bedroom property which offers superb panoramic sea and sunset views. Private and secure, this home is located close to some of the most popular beaches on Ibiza, including the sunset bays of Cala Conte and Cala Tarida. The picturesque villages of San Augustin and San Jose are a short drive away, and you have easy access to the centre of Ibiza Town with its dazzling array of nightlife venues.

The original features, decor and interiors have been lovingly refurbished with a splash of contemporary chic within this home creating a unique modern Ibizan warmth. Villa Harper boasts spacious living areas which are all tastefully and stylish furnished and decorated, and is of course complete with a well-equipped kitchen, a lounge within a double-height atrium, formal dining space, stylish bar and magnificent views through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

A statement staircase curls around the rough natural stone of the central atrium, providing a grand entrance to the master suite and second double bedroom. Downstairs, across two separate wings, a further two bedrooms reside. Also, another basic kitchen area is available for general use.

Broad decking surrounds the villa's large pool and integrated jacuzzi with an al-fresco dining area. A further spectacular outdoor chill-out area can be found on the roof and is complete with an open fireplace for spring or autumn evenings, allowing you to soak up the spectacular sight of the Ibizan sunset in comfort and style. Villa Harper sits splendidly in palm tree-filled gardens which are carefully manicured and maintained. The property is gated with a security camera system for your peace of mind.

The resplendent soft furnishings, such as the oval shaped velvet sofas where you can lounge, all capture the essence of elegance, this house has its own very unique and astounding style. Villa Jayden also benefits from a large entertainment room, complete with a fully equipped gym and pool table.

Each bedroom is as elegant as the next, but all have their own individual style, with breathtaking design and attention to detail. Opulence really is the theme throughout this sensational property. All bedrooms boast king size beds with the exception of one twin room, and all are complete with en-suite bathrooms with showers and bathtub, and access to private terrace or the pool terrace.

Villa Jayden's chic and sophisticated theme continues to the exterior of this sensational house, step out onto one of the many terraces and soak up the sight of the Medittereanean sea, with sweeping views across the coastline. The rectangular pool is the perfect place to really appreciate the beauty of the surroundings. There are several secluded areas for those who seek privacy, and alfresco dining areas, ideal for sharing a sundowner with friends after a luxurious day at Villa Jayden.

name: Villa London
tagline: Cascading levels and open sea views above Roca Llisa
summary:
Roca Llisa sits quietly above the fray — one of Ibiza's most discreet addresses, bordering the island's only golf course and opening toward the Mediterranean on the horizon.

description:
Roca Llisa sits quietly above the fray — one of Ibiza's most discreet addresses, bordering the island's only golf course and opening toward the Mediterranean on the horizon. 
Villa London is designed around the descent: arriving at the upper level, the architecture draws you downward through clean, light-filled spaces where whitewashed walls and considered minimalism create a mood of effortless calm. The main floor unfolds across generous open-plan living areas, each framing wide sea views through floor-to-ceiling glass, spilling out onto covered terraces built for long, unhurried afternoons. Three en-suite double bedrooms are distributed across two floors — one commanding the upper level, 2 opening directly onto the pool terrace below, where a generous summer living space invites late dinners and slow evenings under the stars. 
This is a villa that rewards those who take their time — cool interiors in the heat of the day, a glass in hand as the sun drops toward the water.

name: Villa Marti
tagline: Stylish villa in the most desired location
summary: Discover Villa Marti, nestled in the prestigious enclave of Cap Martinet, just moments away from Talamanca Beach and Ibiza Marina. Upon arrival, be mesmerized by the sweeping panoramic views of the azure sea and verdant…
description: Discover Villa Marti, nestled in the prestigious enclave of Cap Martinet, just moments away from Talamanca Beach and Ibiza Marina. Upon arrival, be mesmerized by the sweeping panoramic views of the azure sea and verdant forests that greet you. The villa's outdoor pool and lounge area are strategically placed to offer the utmost relaxation against this stunning backdrop.

Three bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, reside in the main villa, providing privacy and convenience. The main villa features a spacious open-plan living and dining area, a well-appointed kitchen, a guest WC, a laundry room, and expansive terraces for alfresco dining. With private terraces, a garden, and ample parking including a large garage, this villa is designed for both comfort and luxury.
Additional Information

Child-friendly amenities including a ping pong table and basketball net.
Stylish organic interior design.
Fully equipped kitchen and modern conveniences including air conditioning, fiber-optic internet, sound system, and satellite TV.
Alfresco dining area, private swimming pool, and landscaped garden.
Secure parking for 4 cars with a private gate.
LOCATION

Cap Martinet is esteemed as one of Ibiza's most exclusive locales, prized for its proximity to the vibrant Ibiza Town and renowned nightlife. Yet, it offers a serene escape with secluded beaches like Talamanca and Cala Roja just minutes away. The villa's location ensures easy access to a plethora of amenities including beach clubs, marinas, golf courses, and more, guaranteeing an unforgettable stay on the island.

name: Villa Pardis
tagline: Modern Ibiza Villa with Private Pool & Rooftop Terrace
summary: Welcome to your private Ibiza retreat — a beautifully renovated villa designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable moments.
description: Welcome to your private Ibiza retreat — a beautifully renovated villa designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable moments.

With 3 spacious en-suite bedrooms, everyone enjoys their own private space while still being together under one roof. The modern kitchen is fully equipped with top-quality appliances, making it easy to prepare anything from a light breakfast to a sunset dinner with friends.

Step outside and you’ll discover the true magic of this villa. A sparkling saltwater pool sits at the heart of the lush garden, offering total privacy and plenty of room to relax. Scattered throughout the property are 7 outdoor lounge areas, including a BBQ space — perfect for lazy afternoons, outdoor dining, or starlit evenings.
Head up to the rooftop terrace, where two cozy lounge areas and a pergola invite you to soak up mountain views with a morning coffee or evening cocktail.

Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the villa features floor-to-ceiling sliding doors that bring the sunshine and fresh air inside. And with private parking for 3 cars, getting around the island couldn’t be easier.
Whether you’re here to relax by the pool, explore Ibiza’s stunning coastline, or enjoy vibrant evenings in town, this villa is the perfect place to call home during your stay.

name: Villa Perla Blanca
tagline: Quality throughout and panoramic views
summary: Glittering in the sunlight, Perla Blanca sits on the summit of Can Furnet, a private community, less than ten minutes from the vibrant Ibiza Town center.
description: Glittering in the sunlight, Perla Blanca sits on the summit of Can Furnet, a private community, less than ten minutes from the vibrant Ibiza Town center.

First-time visitors get astonished by the endless expanse of the view. The location of Villa Pearla Blanca will make sunrise and sunset a guaranteed natural spectacle on your daily base. Ibiza reveals itself to the villa guests from its best side: magical colors draw beautiful pictures and a surreal beauty into the evening sky.

The pool deck with its expansive size is suitable for celebrations of all kinds. Whether birthdays, corporate receptions or seated wedding dinners: there is enough space for you and your guests. The pool is equipped with a LED multicolor system. Let yourself sink into the soft cushions of the large white balinese sun bed and indulge yourself with the breathtaking panoramic views to the Ibiza Town and Mediterranean.

This two-floor property with 400 m2 living area impresses upon entering with its new and ultra-modern kitchen. Fully equipped and completed in autumn 2019, its minimal design shows both style and class.

The adjoining open living and dining area is equipped with large windows allowing the flow of the natural light. The large living room with a fireplace invites you to linger on summer evenings and is ideal for an aperitif with guests before dinner or a ramble through Ibiza’s famous nightlife.
The property has 3 bedrooms with modern en suite bathrooms. All rooms have sea views and private access to the terrace or pool deck.
Enjoy pure relaxation at this property with unique views of the sea, Formentera and the south side of Ibiza.

name: Villa Petunia
tagline: Breathtaking natural surroundings in a idilic ibiza villa
summary: Welcome to this charming Ibiza villa, a perfect blend of traditional rural architecture and stunning natural beauty. Perched on a mountaintop, the home offers breathtaking panoramic views over the valley, providing a…
description: Welcome to this charming Ibiza villa, a perfect blend of traditional rural architecture and stunning natural beauty. Perched on a mountaintop, the home offers breathtaking panoramic views over the valley, providing a serene and private retreat ideal for families seeking peace and privacy.

The main house features three spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms, offering a comfortable and practical layout for families or small groups. Each space has been thoughtfully designed to ensure a balance of rustic charm and modern convenience.
Whether you're enjoying a quiet family holiday or spending quality time with loved ones, the villa’s cozy layout and warm ambiance cater perfectly to relaxed island living.

Its elevated position provides a unique vantage point to soak in the surrounding landscapes, creating a true sense of escape. Traditional Ibicencan elements are blended with modern finishes to create a home that feels both authentic and welcoming.
Unwind by the pool, enjoy outdoor meals with a view, or explore the natural beauty around you—this villa is a peaceful sanctuary where lasting memories are made.
Distances:
Ibiza Airport – 19 km (approx. 23 minutes)
Ibiza Town – 13 km (approx. 18 minutes)

name: Villa Solaire
tagline: Conveniently located in Sa Carroca, ideal for families or friends
summary: Situated in the well-connected residential area of Sa Carroca, Villa Solaire provides a comfortable and convenient base for enjoying Ibiza, ideally located near Ibiza Town, the airport, and the island’s southern…
description: Situated in the well-connected residential area of Sa Carroca, Villa Solaire provides a comfortable and convenient base for enjoying Ibiza, ideally located near Ibiza Town, the airport, and the island’s southern beaches. Recently renovated, the property combines clean contemporary interiors with subtle traditional touches, creating a relaxed and practical holiday home suited to guests seeking both comfort and accessibility.

The villa features five bedrooms designed with simplicity and comfort in mind, while the occupancy is arranged for up to six guests, offering generous personal space and flexibility in sleeping arrangements. Bright living areas benefit from abundant natural light, and the layout is functional and easy to live in, supporting both privacy and shared living. A fully equipped kitchen connects seamlessly with the main dining and lounge areas, making the home particularly suitable for extended stays.

Outdoor spaces are arranged for full enjoyment of the Mediterranean climate. Large covered porches provide shaded areas for dining and relaxation, while the swimming pool serves as the natural focal point of the exterior. From the terraces, the property enjoys pleasant open views across the surrounding landscape with distant glimpses toward the sea.
Overall, Villa Solaire represents a balanced combination of location, space, and practicality — an excellent choice for a relaxed Ibiza stay with enhanced comfort and room distribution.

name: Villa Vinya Morna
tagline: Peaceful Getaway in Ibiza: Luxurious Retreat in a Mediterranean Atmosphere
summary: This luxurious detached villa in Ibiza accommodates up to 6 people and offers a serene Mediterranean atmosphere. It boasts a prime location on the northeast coast near San Carlos.
description: This luxurious detached villa in Ibiza accommodates up to 6 people and offers a serene Mediterranean atmosphere. It boasts a prime location on the northeast coast near San Carlos.
Villa for sophisticated guests!

Within a short distance, you'll find beautiful beaches such as S'Aigua Blanca, Playa Es Figueral, Cala Nova, and Cala Boix. The villa is surrounded by a 12,000 m² plot of Mediterranean land adorned with tall pine trees and native plants. Enjoy the cozy sun terrace for delightful moments with family or friends. There are also shaded areas around the house and a spacious pool terrace with an outdoor shower, perfect for relaxation, sunbathing, and conversations.
This two-story villa spans 300 m² and offers breathtaking landscape views, spacious rooms, and exquisite furnishings. The first-floor rooms provide distant sea views.

On the ground floor, you'll find a spacious kitchen equipped with a coffee machine, dishwasher, gas stove, oven, toaster, juicer, kettle, mixer, and all essential kitchen utensils. The kitchen opens to the dining area featuring a large maple wood dining table for 8 people. You can also make use of the JBL Bluetooth speaker in this area.

The ground floor further comprises a shower room/WC and a living room with ample seating for relaxation. The living room is equipped with a flat-screen HD TV, satellite receiver, DVD player, and a selection of DVDs, board games, and books.

The first floor is home to the large master bedroom with a Hästens super king-size bed (210x210) and a stunning garden view. The luxurious bathroom offers a bathtub, shower, bidet, and a captivating view of the pool area and the typical vegetation of the Balearic Islands. The second bedroom, suitable for children, features two queen-size beds (140x200) and grants access to one of the two balconies. This bedroom has its own separate shower room, while the wardrobes for both bedrooms are located in the hallway.

The apartment has a separate entrance and comprises a bedroom with a double bed (180x200) from Ligne Roset and a shower room/WC on the first floor. On the ground floor, a cozy living room provides access to the east terrace, offering a perfect spot to enjoy the sunrise with a cup of coffee.

All bedrooms are air-conditioned to ensure comfortable sleep during hot summer nights. For the transitional months and winter, underfloor heating maintains pleasant temperatures. Additionally, a closed fireplace in the living area sets the mood for cozy evenings.
The living area features double-wing glass doors that can be opened, seamlessly blending the indoors with the large covered terrace and pool terrace.

Surrounded by a well-maintained garden adorned with diverse Mediterranean plants, the villa offers multiple terraces for relaxation. The shaded terrace beneath the majestic pine tree is particularly inviting.

name: Casa Valldaura 1
tagline: Urban villa with private pool just a few minutes minutes from Ibiza Town and Talamanca.
summary:
This welcoming villa, spread over two floors and perfect for families or groups of friends, offers a comfortable and functional environment where everyone will feel at home. 
Location is one of the property's strongest…
description:
This welcoming villa, spread over two floors and perfect for families or groups of friends, offers a comfortable and functional environment where everyone will feel at home. 
Location is one of the property's strongest points: situated in Puig d'en Valls, it enjoys a peaceful yet convenient setting. Ibiza Town, the stunning Talamanca beach, and the elegant and sophisticated Marina Botafoch area, with its restaurants, boutiques, and exclusive clubs, are just minutes away. This combination of tranquility and proximity to the island's most vibrant hubs makes the villa perfect for families seeking a peaceful environment without sacrificing the convenience of having everything within easy reach.

Outside, the villa immediately invites you to socialize thanks to its splendid private pool, ideal for cooling off, playing with the children, or enjoying moments of pure relaxation under the Ibizan sun, and its barbecue area. The well-maintained and private outdoor space is perfect for spending peaceful afternoons with family or summer
evenings with friends. Free parking on the property adds even more convenience, especially for those who wish to explore the island by car.
The interiors are bright and well organized: The fully equipped kitchen allows you to prepare meals at home, while the living room offers a comfortable space for meetings, relaxing and sharing.
- Room 1: large, bright room with direct access to the terrace, TV and double bed.
- Room 2: room with double bed, views of the villa, large and bright for greater comfort.
- Room 3: with a single bed, ideal for children.
The two bathrooms, conveniently located on both floors, guarantee practicality and comfort even when traveling with several people.

Definitely, a cozy and convenient option for those seeking to be close to Ibiza's capital city but enjoying the tranquility and advantages of living in a small village, with fast an easy access to everything.

description: Villa Cala Tarida Pueblo is a contemporary retreat that harmoniously blends the charm of a traditional Ibizan finca with modern comforts. This elegant villa is ideally situated near the coastline of Cala Tarida.

The recently completed property boasts a fully redesigned interior, featuring natural materials and a soothing color palette throughout. The kitchen and dining area are housed in a separate annex, creating a unique layout that enhances privacy and functionality.

Villa Cala Tarida Pueblo includes multiple terraces, some of which offer picturesque views of Cala Tarida and the sea. Surrounded by the serene beauty of Mediterranean nature, the villa provides sun decks, a 9 x 5 m swimming pool, a spacious lounge bed, and an expansive chill-out zone, making it an ideal setting for relaxation and rejuvenation.
An outdoor dining area with seating for six and a dedicated play area for children add extra appeal to the villa's offerings.

All bedrooms are equipped with king-size beds, ensuring comfort and luxury for every guest. For those seeking a peaceful retreat to unwind by the pool, Villa Cala Tarida Pueblo provides the perfect sanctuary.

name: Villa Cooko
tagline: Close To Cala Bassa
summary: Experience the enchantment of Can Cooko, a magnificent 3-bedroom villa nestled within private grounds, offering breathtaking vistas of Conejera Island and the azure Mediterranean. This villa harmoniously blends…
description: Experience the enchantment of Can Cooko, a magnificent 3-bedroom villa nestled within private grounds, offering breathtaking vistas of Conejera Island and the azure Mediterranean. This villa harmoniously blends traditional charm with modern comforts, providing a well-equipped haven for those seeking relaxation and proximity to the island's finest beaches, including Cala Bassa, Conta, and Tarida. Within walking distance, discover a variety of restaurants, local bars, and the idyllic Port des Torrent beach, just a leisurely 20-25 minutes away.

Indulge in the spaciousness of the villa's interior, where you'll be greeted by a generous lounge area adorned with plush sofas, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, and an indoor dining table. Two sets of patio doors beckon you to the main pool area or the adjacent breakfast terrace, each offering their own scenic vistas. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking views while lounging in the comfort of the lounge.

Separated from the lounge by a breakfast bar, the well-appointed kitchen boasts modern appliances, including a dishwasher, fridge/freezer, hob, oven, microwave, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, and blender. Additionally, a convenient storage/utility pantry area is equipped with an iron and ironing board.

Journey down the hallway to discover two twin bedrooms, a shared bathroom, and at the end, the master bedroom complete with an en-suite bathroom. All bedrooms feature ample wardrobe space and are fully air-conditioned (supplement of €100 upon arrival if required). The tasteful decor throughout showcases high-quality solid wood furniture.

Bedroom 1: Master Suite with a king-size bed
Bedroom 2: 2 x Single beds
Bedroom 3: 2 x Single beds

Bathroom 1: En-suite to the master room, featuring a bath, shower, toilet, and bidet
Bathroom 2: Shared by bedrooms 2 and 3, comprising a bath, shower, toilet, and bidet

The villa comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests in its 3 bedrooms. For larger groups of 7 or 8, an additional bed can be added to the master suite, and the sofa bed in the lounge can also be utilized.

Can Cooko's outdoor spaces are a true delight, sprawled across 2500 square meters of land. The pool terrace provides a picturesque backdrop of the countryside and sea, inviting you to bask in the sun throughout the day. Meandering through the low-maintenance cactus gardens, you'll find various chill-out and dining areas, including a BBQ spot with an outdoor sink, perfect for al fresco meals.
Conveniently, there is parking available for up to 3 cars on-site, secured by a gate.

The pool itself measures 9m x 4.2m, with a maximum depth of 2m, complemented by a small step or seat as you enter. However, the pièce de résistance is the expansive roof terrace, an idyllic retreat where you can unwind, relax, and savour the breathtaking views of Conejera Island and the Mediterranean Sea. The roof terrace, adorned with artificial grass, offers comfortable chill-out furniture, creating the ultimate sanctuary to relish a glass of wine while marvelling at the radiant sunset.

summary: Introducing an exquisite villa that epitomizes elegance with breathtaking front-line sea views. Nestled in the prestigious and secure community of Vista Alegre, this charming holiday retreat offers a unique blend of…
description: Introducing an exquisite villa that epitomizes elegance with breathtaking front-line sea views. Nestled in the prestigious and secure community of Vista Alegre, this charming holiday retreat offers a unique blend of tranquility and luxury, making it a perfect getaway.

The villa boasts an inviting exterior dining area complete with a BBQ, situated on an elevated terrace that wraps around the property. Lush, meticulously arranged gardens frame the space, while both exterior and interior lounges provide panoramic views of the azure sea, creating an extraordinary atmosphere where simplicity meets sophistication.

With direct access to the shimmering waters, this stunning villa features frontal sea views that will leave you mesmerized. Guests can enjoy the community swimming pool, complemented by modern amenities including a Bose sound system and a ping pong table for added entertainment.

Here’s a closer look at what makes this property so special:
Prime Location
- Vista Alegre Community: Nestled in one of Ibiza's most prestigious neighborhoods, the villa offers both security and privacy, allowing guests to unwind in a serene environment while being close to the island’s vibrant attractions.

Stunning Design and Amenities
- Exterior Dining Area: The inviting outdoor dining space with a BBQ is perfect for alfresco meals, allowing guests to enjoy delicious food while surrounded by breathtaking views. The elevated terrace enhances the dining experience, providing a picturesque backdrop of the sea.

description: Ideally located close to the golden sands of Talamanca and the cobbled streets of Ibiza Town, Casa Monique is an elegant two-bedroom villa that puts the very best of the island within easy reach. The beach and its relaxed cafés are just a short trip away, as are Ibiza Town’s acclaimed restaurants, bars and music scene, making this a wonderfully convenient retreat for two couples or a family with young children.

Inside, natural light fills every room, highlighting the villa’s stylish contemporary finishes. The open-plan living and dining area is arranged around a welcoming fireplace, offering a cool escape from the midday sun and a cosy setting for relaxed evenings and entertaining. The beautifully designed kitchen is fully equipped for everything from a light breakfast to a dinner party.

Two spacious double bedrooms, each with an elegant en-suite shower room, provide comfort and privacy for four guests. Both open directly onto the garden, terraces and pool, so a morning swim is never more than a few steps away.

Outdoors, the private pool is surrounded by lush tropical planting and comfortable sun loungers. From here, guests can take in spectacular views of the historic walls of Dalt Vila, the UNESCO-listed old town, while early risers are rewarded with breathtaking sunrises over the bay. Casa Monique offers a rare combination of privacy, beauty and a superb central location in Ibiza.
